CFDLean.Assembly.constant_state_closed.name: CFDLean.Assembly.constant_state_closed
CFDLean.Assembly.constant_state_closed.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : Real) (U : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3))
  (S : E → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (T : B → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (i : N),
  Eq (CFDLean.Assembly.metricDefect m S T i) (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
    Eq
      (CFDLean.Assembly.residual m (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ (fun x => U) S)
        (fun b => DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (T b)) i)
      (OfNat.ofNat 0)
CFDLean.Assembly.constant_state_closed.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3)
  (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Assembly.metricDefect m S T i = 0 →
    CFDLean.Assembly.residual m (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ (fun x => U) S)
        (fun b => (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (T b)) i =
      0

  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : Real) (U : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3))
  (S : E → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (T : B → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (i : N),
  Eq
    (CFDLean.Assembly.residual m (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ (fun x => U) S)
      (fun b => DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (T b)) i)
    (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U (CFDLean.Assembly.metricDefect m S T i)))
CFDLean.Assembly.constant_state_residual.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3)
  (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Assembly.residual m (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ (fun x => U) S)
      (fun b => (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (T b)) i =
    CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U (CFDLean.Assembly.metricDefect m S T i))

∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (e : E),
  Eq (CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m (m.head e) e) (Neg.neg (OfNat.ofNat 1))
CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_head.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (e : E),
  CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m (m.head e) e = -1

CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_other.name: CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_other
CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_other.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (i : N)
  (e : E), Ne (m.tail e) i → Ne (m.head e) i → Eq (CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e) (OfNat.ofNat 0)
CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_other.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (i : N)
  (e : E), m.tail e ≠ i → m.head e ≠ i → CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e = 0

CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_reverse.name: CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_reverse
CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_reverse.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B)
  (rev : E → Prop) [inst_1 : DecidablePred rev] (i : N) (e : E),
  Eq (CFDLean.Assembly.incidence (m.reverse rev) i e)
    (ite (rev e) (Neg.neg (CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e)) (CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e))
CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_reverse.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B)
  (rev : E → Prop) [inst_1 : DecidablePred rev] (i : N) (e : E),
  CFDLean.Assembly.incidence (m.reverse rev) i e =
    if rev e then -CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e else CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e

CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_smul.name: CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_smul
CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_smul.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] {d : Nat} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B)
  (i : N) (e : E) (v : CFDLean.Vector d),
  Eq (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e) v)
    (HSub.hSub (ite (Eq (m.tail e) i) v (OfNat.ofNat 0)) (ite (Eq (m.head e) i) v (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_smul.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] {d : ℕ} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B)
  (i : N) (e : E) (v : CFDLean.Vector d),
  CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e • v = (if m.tail e = i then v else 0) - if m.head e = i then v else 0

CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_sum.name: CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_sum
CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_sum.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype N]
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (e : E),
  Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e) (OfNat.ofNat 0)
CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_sum.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype N]
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (e : E), ∑ i, CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e = 0

CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_tail.name: CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_tail
CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_tail.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (e : E),
  Eq (CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m (m.tail e) e) (OfNat.ofNat 1)
CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_tail.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (e : E),
  CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m (m.tail e) e = 1

CFDLean.Assembly.metricDefect.name: CFDLean.Assembly.metricDefect
CFDLean.Assembly.metricDefect.type:
{N : Type u_1} →
  {E : Type u_2} →
    {B : Type u_3} →
      [DecidableEq N] →
        [Fintype E] →
          [Fintype B] →
            CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B → (E → CFDLean.Vector 3) → (B → CFDLean.Vector 3) → N → CFDLean.Vector 3

CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer.name: CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer
CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer.type:
{N : Type u_1} →
  {E : Type u_2} →
    {B : Type u_3} →
      [DecidableEq N] →
        CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B →
          ℝ → (N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) → (E → CFDLean.Vector 3) → N → E → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates

CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer.eq_1
CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : Real)
  (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (i : N) (e : E),
  Eq (CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer m γ U S i e)
    (ite (Eq (m.tail e) i)
      (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ (U (m.tail e)) (U (m.head e)) (S e)))
      (ite (Eq (m.head e) i)
        (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ (U (m.head e)) (U (m.tail e)) (Neg.neg (S e))))
        (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer.eq_1.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ)
  (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : N) (e : E),
  CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer m γ U S i e =
    if m.tail e = i then CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ (U (m.tail e)) (U (m.head e)) (S e))
    else
      if m.head e = i then CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ (U (m.head e)) (U (m.tail e)) (-S e))
      else 0

CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer_eq.name: CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer_eq
CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer_eq.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : Real)
  (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (i : N) (e : E),
  Eq (CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer m γ U S i e)
    (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e) (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ U S e))
CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer_eq.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ)
  (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : N) (e : E),
  CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer m γ U S i e =
    CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e • CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ U S e

CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer._proof.name: CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer._proof_1
CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer._proof.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (U : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (S T : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U (HAdd.hAdd S T)))
    (HAdd.hAdd (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S))
      (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U T)))
CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer._proof.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U (S + T)) =
    CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S) + CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U T)

CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer._proof.name: CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer._proof_2
CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer._proof.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (U : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (a : Real) (S : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U (HSMul.hSMul a S)))
    (HSMul.hSMul (DFunLike.coe (RingHom.id Real) a) (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S)))
CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer._proof.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (a : ℝ) (S : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U (a • S)) =
    (RingHom.id ℝ) a • CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S)

CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer.eq_1

CFDLean.Assembly.residual.name: CFDLean.Assembly.residual
CFDLean.Assembly.residual.type:
{N : Type u_1} →
  {E : Type u_2} →
    {B : Type u_3} →
      [DecidableEq N] →
        [Fintype E] →
          [Fintype B] →
            {d : ℕ} →
              CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B → (E → CFDLean.Vector d) → (B → CFDLean.Vector d) → N → CFDLean.Vector d

CFDLean.Assembly.residual.congr_simp.name: CFDLean.Assembly.residual.congr_simp
CFDLean.Assembly.residual.congr_simp.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} {inst : DecidableEq N} [inst_1 : DecidableEq N] [inst_2 : Fintype E]
  [inst_3 : Fintype B] {d : Nat} (m m_1 : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B),
  Eq m m_1 →
    ∀ (f f_1 : E → CFDLean.Vector d),
      Eq f f_1 →
        ∀ (g g_1 : B → CFDLean.Vector d),
          Eq g g_1 →
            ∀ (i i_1 : N),
              Eq i i_1 →
                ∀ (a a_1 : Fin d),
                  Eq a a_1 → Eq (CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i a) (CFDLean.Assembly.residual m_1 f_1 g_1 i_1 a_1)
CFDLean.Assembly.residual.congr_simp.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} {inst : DecidableEq N} [inst_1 : DecidableEq N] [inst_2 : Fintype E]
  [inst_3 : Fintype B] {d : ℕ} (m m_1 : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B),
  m = m_1 →
    ∀ (f f_1 : E → CFDLean.Vector d),
      f = f_1 →
        ∀ (g g_1 : B → CFDLean.Vector d),
          g = g_1 →
            ∀ (i i_1 : N),
              i = i_1 →
                ∀ (a a_1 : Fin d),
                  a = a_1 → CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i a = CFDLean.Assembly.residual m_1 f_1 g_1 i_1 a_1

CFDLean.Assembly.residual.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Assembly.residual.eq_1
CFDLean.Assembly.residual.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  {d : Nat} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (f : E → CFDLean.Vector d) (g : B → CFDLean.Vector d) (i : N),
  Eq (CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i)
    (HAdd.hAdd (Finset.univ.sum fun e => HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e) (f e))
      (Finset.univ.sum fun b => ite (Eq (m.owner b) i) (g b) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
CFDLean.Assembly.residual.eq_1.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B] {d : ℕ}
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (f : E → CFDLean.Vector d) (g : B → CFDLean.Vector d) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i =
    ∑ e, CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e • f e + ∑ b, if m.owner b = i then g b else 0

CFDLean.Assembly.residual_map.name: CFDLean.Assembly.residual_map
CFDLean.Assembly.residual_map.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  {d k : Nat} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B)
  (L : LinearMap (RingHom.id Real) (CFDLean.Vector d) (CFDLean.Vector k)) (f : E → CFDLean.Vector d)
  (g : B → CFDLean.Vector d) (i : N),
  Eq (CFDLean.Assembly.residual m (fun e => DFunLike.coe L (f e)) (fun b => DFunLike.coe L (g b)) i)
    (DFunLike.coe L (CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i))
CFDLean.Assembly.residual_map.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  {d k : ℕ} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (L : CFDLean.Vector d →ₗ[ℝ] CFDLean.Vector k)
  (f : E → CFDLean.Vector d) (g : B → CFDLean.Vector d) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Assembly.residual m (fun e => L (f e)) (fun b => L (g b)) i = L (CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i)

CFDLean.Assembly.residual_outgoing.name: CFDLean.Assembly.residual_outgoing
CFDLean.Assembly.residual_outgoing.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  {d : Nat} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (f : E → CFDLean.Vector d) (g : B → CFDLean.Vector d) (i : N),
  Eq (CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i)
    (HAdd.hAdd
      (HSub.hSub ((Finset.filter (fun e => Eq (m.tail e) i) Finset.univ).sum fun e => f e)
        ((Finset.filter (fun e => Eq (m.head e) i) Finset.univ).sum fun e => f e))
      ((Finset.filter (fun b => Eq (m.owner b) i) Finset.univ).sum fun b => g b))
CFDLean.Assembly.residual_outgoing.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B] {d : ℕ}
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (f : E → CFDLean.Vector d) (g : B → CFDLean.Vector d) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i =
    ∑ e with m.tail e = i, f e - ∑ e with m.head e = i, f e + ∑ b with m.owner b = i, g b

CFDLean.Assembly.residual_reindex.name: CFDLean.Assembly.residual_reindex
CFDLean.Assembly.residual_reindex.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  {d : Nat} {N' : Type u_4} {E' : Type u_5} {B' : Type u_6} [inst_3 : DecidableEq N'] [inst_4 : Fintype E']
  [inst_5 : Fintype B'] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (n : Equiv N N') (e : Equiv E E') (b : Equiv B B')
  (f : E → CFDLean.Vector d) (g : B → CFDLean.Vector d) (i : N),
  Eq
    (CFDLean.Assembly.residual (m.reindex n e b) (fun j => f (DFunLike.coe e.symm j))
      (fun j => g (DFunLike.coe b.symm j)) (DFunLike.coe n i))
    (CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i)
CFDLean.Assembly.residual_reindex.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B] {d : ℕ}
  {N' : Type u_4} {E' : Type u_5} {B' : Type u_6} [inst_3 : DecidableEq N'] [inst_4 : Fintype E'] [inst_5 : Fintype B']
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (n : N ≃ N') (e : E ≃ E') (b : B ≃ B') (f : E → CFDLean.Vector d)
  (g : B → CFDLean.Vector d) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Assembly.residual (m.reindex n e b) (fun j => f (e.symm j)) (fun j => g (b.symm j)) (n i) =
    CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i

CFDLean.Assembly.residual_reverse.name: CFDLean.Assembly.residual_reverse
CFDLean.Assembly.residual_reverse.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  {d : Nat} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (rev : E → Prop) [inst_3 : DecidablePred rev]
  (f : E → CFDLean.Vector d) (g : B → CFDLean.Vector d) (i : N),
  Eq (CFDLean.Assembly.residual (m.reverse rev) (fun e => ite (rev e) (Neg.neg (f e)) (f e)) g i)
    (CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i)
CFDLean.Assembly.residual_reverse.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B] {d : ℕ}
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (rev : E → Prop) [inst_3 : DecidablePred rev] (f : E → CFDLean.Vector d)
  (g : B → CFDLean.Vector d) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Assembly.residual (m.reverse rev) (fun e => if rev e then -f e else f e) g i =
    CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i

CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer.name: CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer
CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer.type:
{N : Type u_1} →
  {E : Type u_2} →
    {B : Type u_3} →
      CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B →
        ℝ → (N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) → (E → CFDLean.Vector 3) → E → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates

CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer.eq_1
CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : Real)
  (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (e : E),
  Eq (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ U S e)
    (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ (U (m.tail e)) (U (m.head e)) (S e)))
CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer.eq_1.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ)
  (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3) (e : E),
  CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ U S e =
    CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ (U (m.tail e)) (U (m.head e)) (S e))

CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer_consistency.name: CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer_consistency
CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer_consistency.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : Real)
  (U : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (e : E),
  Eq (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ (fun x => U) S e) (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (S e))
CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer_consistency.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ)
  (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3) (e : E),
  CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ (fun x => U) S e = (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (S e)

CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer_zero.name: CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer_zero
CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer_zero.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : Real)
  (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (e : E),
  Eq (S e) (OfNat.ofNat 0) → Eq (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ U S e) (OfNat.ofNat 0)
CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer_zero.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ)
  (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3) (e : E),
  S e = 0 → CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ U S e = 0

CFDLean.Assembly.roe_global_balance.name: CFDLean.Assembly.roe_global_balance
CFDLean.Assembly.roe_global_balance.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : Real) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3))
  (S : E → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (g : B → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => CFDLean.Assembly.residual m (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ U S) g i)
    (Finset.univ.sum fun b => g b)
CFDLean.Assembly.roe_global_balance.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3)
  (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3) (g : B → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  ∑ i, CFDLean.Assembly.residual m (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ U S) g i = ∑ b, g b

CFDLean.Assembly.roe_residual_reindex.name: CFDLean.Assembly.roe_residual_reindex

    (CFDLean.Boundary.constructedTransfer m γ k V U T (DFunLike.coe b.symm j))

CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual_eq.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : Real) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3))
  (i : Fin n),
  Eq (CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V U i)
    (CFDLean.Assembly.residual M.interfaces (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer M.interfaces γ U M.edgeArea)
      (CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V U) i)
CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual_eq.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)

CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_common_correction.name: CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_common_correction
CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_common_correction.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m),
  M.Conforming →
    ∀ (γ : Real) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
      (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (U : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3))
      (i : Fin n),
      Eq (CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V (fun x => U) i)
        (Finset.univ.sum fun b =>
          ite (Eq (M.interfaces.owner b) i)
            (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V (fun x => U) b)
              (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (M.boundaryArea b)))
            (OfNat.ofNat 0))
CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_common_correction.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m),
  M.Conforming →
    ∀ (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3)
      (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (i : Fin n),
      CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V (fun x => U) i =
        ∑ b,
          if M.interfaces.owner b = i then
            CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V (fun x => U) b -
              (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (M.boundaryArea b)
          else 0

CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_constant_state.name: CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_constant_state
CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_constant_state.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m),
  M.Conforming →
    ∀ (γ : Real),
      LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
        ∀ (U : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
          CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ U →
            ∀ (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3))
              (i : Fin n),
              (∀ (b : M.Boundary),
                  Ne (CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b) CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe →
                    Eq (CFDLean.dot U.momentum (M.boundaryArea b)) (OfNat.ofNat 0)) →
                (∀ (b : M.Boundary),
                    Eq (CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b) CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe →
                      Eq (CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V b) U) →
                  Eq (CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V (fun x => U) i) (OfNat.ofNat 0)
CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_constant_state.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m),
  M.Conforming →
    ∀ (γ : ℝ),
      1 < γ →
        ∀ (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3),
          CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ U →
            ∀ (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (i : Fin n),
              (∀ (b : M.Boundary),
                  CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b ≠ CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe →
                    CFDLean.dot U.momentum (M.boundaryArea b) = 0) →
                (∀ (b : M.Boundary),
                    CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe →
                      CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V b = U) →
                  CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V (fun x => U) i = 0

CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_global_balance.name: CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_global_balance
CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_global_balance.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : Real) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V U i)
    (Finset.univ.sum fun b => CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V U b)
CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_global_balance.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3),
  ∑ i, CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V U i = ∑ b, CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V U b

CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_residual_reindex.name: CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_residual_reindex
CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_residual_reindex.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} {N' : Type u_4} {E' : Type u_5} {B' : Type u_6} [inst : DecidableEq N'] [inst_1 : Fintype E']
  [inst_2 : Fintype B'] (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (nodeEq : Equiv (Fin n) N') (e : Equiv M.Edge E')
  (b : Equiv M.Boundary B') (γ : Real) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3))
  (i : Fin n),
  Eq
    (CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual (M.interfaces.reindex nodeEq e b) γ
      (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k (DFunLike.coe b.symm x))
      (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V (DFunLike.coe b.symm x)) (fun x => U (DFunLike.coe nodeEq.symm x))
      (fun x => M.edgeArea (DFunLike.coe e.symm x)) (fun x => M.boundaryArea (DFunLike.coe b.symm x))
      (DFunLike.coe nodeEq i))
    (CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V U i)
CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_residual_reindex.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} {N' : Type u_4} {E' : Type u_5} {B' : Type u_6} [inst : DecidableEq N'] [inst_1 : Fintype E']
  [inst_2 : Fintype B'] (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (nodeEq : Fin n ≃ N') (e : M.Edge ≃ E')
  (b : M.Boundary ≃ B') (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (i : Fin n),
  CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual (M.interfaces.reindex nodeEq e b) γ
      (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k (b.symm x)) (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V (b.symm x))
      (fun x => U (nodeEq.symm x)) (fun x => M.edgeArea (e.symm x)) (fun x => M.boundaryArea (b.symm x)) (nodeEq i) =
    CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V U i

                (CFDLean.Coordinates.unitNormal T))

CFDLean.Boundary.residual_boundary_diffe.raw_type:

  (g h : B → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (i : N),
  Eq (CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i)
    (HAdd.hAdd (CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f h i)
      (Finset.univ.sum fun b => ite (Eq (m.owner b) i) (HSub.hSub (g b) (h b)) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
CFDLean.Boundary.residual_boundary_diffe.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]

  (g h : B → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i = CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f h i + ∑ b, if m.owner b = i then g b - h b else 0

  (S : E → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (T : B → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (i : N),
  (∀ (b : B),
      Ne (k b) CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe → Eq (CFDLean.dot U.momentum (T b)) (OfNat.ofNat 0)) →
    (∀ (b : B), Eq (k b) CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe → Eq (V b) U) →
      Eq (CFDLean.Assembly.metricDefect m S T i) (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
        Eq (CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V (fun x => U) S T i) (OfNat.ofNat 0)
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_common_close.type:

  (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3) (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : N),
  (∀ (b : B), k b ≠ CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe → CFDLean.dot U.momentum (T b) = 0) →
    (∀ (b : B), k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe → V b = U) →
      CFDLean.Assembly.metricDefect m S T i = 0 → CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V (fun x => U) S T i = 0

CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_common_corre.name: CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_common_correction
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_common_corre.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : Real) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (U : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3))
  (S : E → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (T : B → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (i : N),
  Eq (CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V (fun x => U) S T i)
    (HAdd.hAdd (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U (CFDLean.Assembly.metricDefect m S T i)))
      (Finset.univ.sum fun b =>
        ite (Eq (m.owner b) i)
          (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Boundary.constructedTransfer m γ k V (fun x => U) T b)
            (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (T b)))
          (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_common_corre.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative 3)
  (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3) (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V (fun x => U) S T i =
    CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U (CFDLean.Assembly.metricDefect m S T i)) +
      ∑ b,
        if m.owner b = i then
          CFDLean.Boundary.constructedTransfer m γ k V (fun x => U) T b - (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (T b)
        else 0

∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : Real) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3))
  (S : E → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (T : B → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V U S T i)
    (HAdd.hAdd
      (Finset.univ.sum fun b =>
        ite (Eq (k b) CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe)
          (CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ (U (m.owner b)) (V b) (T b)) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
      (Finset.univ.sum fun b =>
        ite (Eq (k b) CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe) (OfNat.ofNat 0)
          (CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ (U (m.owner b)) (T b))))
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_mixed_balanc.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3)
  (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3),
  ∑ i, CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V U S T i =
    (∑ b,
        if k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe then
          CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ (U (m.owner b)) (V b) (T b)
        else 0) +
      ∑ b,
        if k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe then 0
        else CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ (U (m.owner b)) (T b)

CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_momentum_bal.name: CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_momentum_balance
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_momentum_bal.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : Real) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3))
  (S : E → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (T : B → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (j : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq
    (Finset.univ.sum fun i =>
      (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode (CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V U S T i)).momentum j)
    (Finset.univ.sum fun b =>
      ite (Eq (k b) CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe)
        ((CFDLean.Coordinates.decode
              (CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ (U (m.owner b)) (V b) (T b))).momentum
          j)
        (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ (U (m.owner b))) (T b j)))
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_momentum_bal.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3)
  (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3) (j : Fin 3),
  ∑ i, (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode (CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V U S T i)).momentum j =
    ∑ b,
      if k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe then
        (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode
              (CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ (U (m.owner b)) (V b) (T b))).momentum
          j
      else CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ (U (m.owner b)) * T b j

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_momentum.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_momentum
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_momentum.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (U : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (T : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq ((CFDLean.Coordinates.decode (CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T)).momentum i)
    (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ U) (T i))
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_momentum.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : Fin 3),
  (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode (CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T)).momentum i =
    CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ U * T i

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_pressure_pos.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_pressure_pos
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_pressure_pos.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (U : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ U → LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ U)
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_pressure_pos.type: ∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3), CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ U → 0 < CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ U

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_reverse.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_reverse
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_reverse.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (U : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (T : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U (Neg.neg T)) (Neg.neg (CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T))
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_reverse.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U (-T) = -CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_smul.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_smul
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_smul.raw_type:
∀ (γ a : Real) (U : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (T : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U (HSMul.hSMul a T)) (HSMul.hSMul a (CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T))
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_smul.type:
∀ (γ a : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U (a • T) = a • CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T

CFDLean.Burgers.EntropyConservativeFlux..name: CFDLean.Burgers.EntropyConservativeFlux.eval.eq_1
CFDLean.Burgers.EntropyConservativeFlux..raw_type:
∀ (a b : Real),
  Eq (CFDLean.Burgers.EntropyConservativeFlux.eval a b)
    (HDiv.hDiv (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd (HPow.hPow a (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (HMul.hMul a b)) (HPow.hPow b (OfNat.ofNat 2)))
      (OfNat.ofNat 6))
CFDLean.Burgers.EntropyConservativeFlux..type: ∀ (a b : ℝ), CFDLean.Burgers.EntropyConservativeFlux.eval a b = (a ^ 2 + a * b + b ^ 2) / 6

CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.abs_le_max_of_bo.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.abs_le_max_of_bounds
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.abs_le_max_of_bo.raw_type: ∀ (m M x : Real), And (LE.le m x) (LE.le x M) → LE.le (abs x) (max (abs m) (abs M))
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.abs_le_max_of_bo.type: ∀ (m M x : ℝ), m ≤ x ∧ x ≤ M → |x| ≤ max |m| |M|

CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.abs_mean_le_wave.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.abs_mean_le_waveSpeed
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.abs_mean_le_wave.raw_type: ∀ (a b : Real), LE.le (abs (HDiv.hDiv (HAdd.hAdd a b) (OfNat.ofNat 2))) (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.waveSpeed a b)
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.abs_mean_le_wave.type: ∀ (a b : ℝ), |(a + b) / 2| ≤ CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.waveSpeed a b

CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.cell_entropy_ine.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.cell_entropy_inequality
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.cell_entropy_ine.raw_type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx : Real),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) dx →
    ∀ (u : I → Real) (i : I),
      LE.le (HMul.hMul (u i) (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.rhs g dx CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.numericalFlux u i))
        (HDiv.hDiv
          (Neg.neg
            (HSub.hSub
              (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.entropyFlux g CFDLean.Burgers.entropyVariable
                CFDLean.Burgers.entropyPotential CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.numericalFlux u i)
              (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.entropyFlux g CFDLean.Burgers.entropyVariable
                CFDLean.Burgers.entropyPotential CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.numericalFlux u (g.prev i))))
          dx)
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.cell_entropy_ine.type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx : ℝ),
  0 < dx →
    ∀ (u : I → ℝ) (i : I),
      u i * CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.rhs g dx CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.numericalFlux u i ≤
        -(CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.entropyFlux g CFDLean.Burgers.entropyVariable CFDLean.Burgers.entropyPotential
                CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.numericalFlux u i -
              CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.entropyFlux g CFDLean.Burgers.entropyVariable CFDLean.Burgers.entropyPotential
                CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.numericalFlux u (g.prev i)) /
          dx

CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.cfl_of_bounded.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.cfl_of_bounded
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.cfl_of_bounded.raw_type:
∀ (dx dt m M θ : Real),
  LE.le (HMul.hMul (HAdd.hAdd (OfNat.ofNat 4) (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) θ)) (HMul.hMul dt (max (abs m) (abs M)))) dx →
    LE.le
      (HMul.hMul dt
        (HMul.hMul (HAdd.hAdd (OfNat.ofNat 1) (HDiv.hDiv θ (OfNat.ofNat 2)))
          (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) (max (abs m) (abs M)))
            (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) (max (abs m) (abs M))))))
      dx
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.cfl_of_bounded.type:
∀ (dx dt m M θ : ℝ),
  (4 + 2 * θ) * (dt * max |m| |M|) ≤ dx → dt * ((1 + θ / 2) * (2 * max |m| |M| + 2 * max |m| |M|)) ≤ dx

CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.cfl_of_six.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.cfl_of_six
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.cfl_of_six.raw_type:
∀ (dx dt m M : Real),
  LE.le (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 6) (HMul.hMul dt (max (abs m) (abs M)))) dx →
    LE.le
      (HMul.hMul dt
        (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 3) (OfNat.ofNat 2))
          (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) (max (abs m) (abs M)))
            (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) (max (abs m) (abs M))))))
      dx
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.cfl_of_six.type: ∀ (dx dt m M : ℝ), 6 * (dt * max |m| |M|) ≤ dx → dt * (3 / 2 * (2 * max |m| |M| + 2 * max |m| |M|)) ≤ dx

CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.energy_productio.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.energy_production_nonpos
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.energy_productio.raw_type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx : Real),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) dx →
    ∀ (u : I → Real),
      LE.le
        (Finset.univ.sum fun i =>
          HMul.hMul (u i) (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.rhs g dx CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.numericalFlux u i))
        (OfNat.ofNat 0)
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.energy_productio.type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx : ℝ),
  0 < dx → ∀ (u : I → ℝ), ∑ i, u i * CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.rhs g dx CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.numericalFlux u i ≤ 0

CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep.type: {I : Type u_1} → CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I → ℝ → ℝ → (I → ℝ) → I → ℝ

CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep.eq_1
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx dt : Real),
  Eq (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep g dx dt)
    (CFDLean.Time.ForwardEuler.step dt (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.rhs g dx CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.numericalFlux))
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep.eq_1.type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx dt : ℝ),
  CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep g dx dt =
    CFDLean.Time.ForwardEuler.step dt (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.rhs g dx CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.numericalFlux)

CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep_consta.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep_constant
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep_consta.raw_type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx dt c : Real),
  Eq (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep g dx dt fun x => c) fun x => c
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep_consta.type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx dt c : ℝ),
  (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep g dx dt fun x => c) = fun x => c

CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep_iterat.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep_iterate_stable
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep_iterat.raw_type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx dt m M : Real),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) dx →
    LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) dt →
      LE.le (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) (HMul.hMul dt (max (abs m) (abs M)))) dx →
        ∀ (u : I → Real),
          Membership.mem (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.boundedStates m M) u →
            ∀ (n : Nat),
              And
                (Membership.mem (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.boundedStates m M)
                  (Nat.iterate (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep g dx dt) n u))
                (LE.le
                  (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.totalVariation g
                    (Nat.iterate (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep g dx dt) n u))
                  (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.totalVariation g u))
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep_iterat.type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx dt m M : ℝ),
  0 < dx →
    0 ≤ dt →
      2 * (dt * max |m| |M|) ≤ dx →
        ∀ u ∈ CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.boundedStates m M,
          ∀ (n : ℕ),
            (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep g dx dt)^[n] u ∈ CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.boundedStates m M ∧
              CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.totalVariation g ((CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep g dx dt)^[n] u) ≤
                CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.totalVariation g u

CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep_mem.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep_mem
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep_mem.raw_type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx dt m M : Real),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) dx →
    LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) dt →
      LE.le (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) (HMul.hMul dt (max (abs m) (abs M)))) dx →
        ∀ (u : I → Real),
          Membership.mem (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.boundedStates m M) u →
            Membership.mem (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.boundedStates m M) (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep g dx dt u)
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep_mem.type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx dt m M : ℝ),
  0 < dx →
    0 ≤ dt →
      2 * (dt * max |m| |M|) ≤ dx →
        ∀ u ∈ CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.boundedStates m M,
          CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep g dx dt u ∈ CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.boundedStates m M

CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep_sum.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep_sum
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep_sum.raw_type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx dt : Real),
  Ne dx (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
    ∀ (u : I → Real),
      Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep g dx dt u i) (Finset.univ.sum fun i => u i)
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep_sum.type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx dt : ℝ),
  dx ≠ 0 → ∀ (u : I → ℝ), ∑ i, CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep g dx dt u i = ∑ i, u i

CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep_totalV.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep_totalVariation_le
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep_totalV.raw_type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx dt m M : Real),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) dx →
    LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) dt →
      LE.le (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) (HMul.hMul dt (max (abs m) (abs M)))) dx →
        ∀ (u : I → Real),
          Membership.mem (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.boundedStates m M) u →
            LE.le (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.totalVariation g (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep g dx dt u))
              (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.totalVariation g u)
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep_totalV.type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx dt m M : ℝ),
  0 < dx →
    0 ≤ dt →
      2 * (dt * max |m| |M|) ≤ dx →
        ∀ u ∈ CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.boundedStates m M,
          CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.totalVariation g (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep g dx dt u) ≤
            CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.totalVariation g u

CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval.eq_1
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (uL uR : Real),
  Eq (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval uL uR)
    (HSub.hSub
      (HDiv.hDiv (HAdd.hAdd (CFDLean.Burgers.physicalFlux uL) (CFDLean.Burgers.physicalFlux uR)) (OfNat.ofNat 2))
      (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.waveSpeed uL uR) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (HSub.hSub uR uL)))
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval.eq_1.type:
∀ (uL uR : ℝ),
  CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval uL uR =
    (CFDLean.Burgers.physicalFlux uL + CFDLean.Burgers.physicalFlux uR) / 2 -
      CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.waveSpeed uL uR / 2 * (uR - uL)

CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval_anti_right.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval_anti_right
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval_anti_right.raw_type: ∀ (a b b' : Real), LE.le b b' → LE.le (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval a b') (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval a b)
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval_anti_right.type: ∀ (a b b' : ℝ), b ≤ b' → CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval a b' ≤ CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval a b

CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval_eq_entropyC.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval_eq_entropyConservative_sub
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval_eq_entropyC.raw_type:
∀ (a b : Real),
  Eq (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval a b)
    (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Burgers.EntropyConservativeFlux.eval a b)
      (HMul.hMul
        (HSub.hSub (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.waveSpeed a b) (OfNat.ofNat 2))
          (HDiv.hDiv (HSub.hSub b a) (OfNat.ofNat 12)))
        (HSub.hSub b a)))
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval_eq_entropyC.type:
∀ (a b : ℝ),
  CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval a b =
    CFDLean.Burgers.EntropyConservativeFlux.eval a b -
      (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.waveSpeed a b / 2 - (b - a) / 12) * (b - a)

CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval_lipschitz_l.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval_lipschitz_left
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval_lipschitz_l.raw_type:
∀ (A a a' b : Real),
  LE.le (abs a) A →
    LE.le (abs a') A →
      LE.le (abs b) A →
        LE.le (abs (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval a b) (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval a' b)))
          (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) A) (abs (HSub.hSub a a')))
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval_lipschitz_l.type:
∀ (A a a' b : ℝ),
  |a| ≤ A →
    |a'| ≤ A → |b| ≤ A → |CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval a b - CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval a' b| ≤ 2 * A * |a - a'|

CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval_lipschitz_r.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval_lipschitz_right
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval_lipschitz_r.raw_type:
∀ (A a b b' : Real),
  LE.le (abs a) A →
    LE.le (abs b) A →
      LE.le (abs b') A →
        LE.le (abs (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval a b) (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval a b')))
          (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) A) (abs (HSub.hSub b b')))
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval_lipschitz_r.type:
∀ (A a b b' : ℝ),
  |a| ≤ A →
    |b| ≤ A → |b'| ≤ A → |CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval a b - CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval a b'| ≤ 2 * A * |b - b'|

CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval_mono_left.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval_mono_left
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval_mono_left.raw_type: ∀ (a a' b : Real), LE.le a a' → LE.le (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval a b) (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval a' b)
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval_mono_left.type: ∀ (a a' b : ℝ), a ≤ a' → CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval a b ≤ CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval a' b

CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.incrementC.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.incrementC
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.incrementC.type: {I : Type u_1} → CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I → ℝ → ℝ → (I → ℝ) → I → ℝ

CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.incrementC.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.incrementC.eq_1
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.incrementC.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx dt : Real) (u : I → Real) (i : I),
  Eq (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.incrementC g dx dt u i)
    (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv dt dx)
      (HDiv.hDiv
        (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.waveSpeed (u i) (u (DFunLike.coe g.next i)))
          (HDiv.hDiv (HAdd.hAdd (u i) (u (DFunLike.coe g.next i))) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))
        (OfNat.ofNat 2)))
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.incrementC.eq_1.type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx dt : ℝ) (u : I → ℝ) (i : I),
  CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.incrementC g dx dt u i =
    dt / dx * ((CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.waveSpeed (u i) (u (g.next i)) - (u i + u (g.next i)) / 2) / 2)

CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.incrementC_add_i.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.incrementC_add_incrementD
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.incrementC_add_i.raw_type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx dt : Real) (u : I → Real) (i : I),
  Eq (HAdd.hAdd (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.incrementC g dx dt u i) (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.incrementD g dx dt u i))
    (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul dt (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.waveSpeed (u i) (u (DFunLike.coe g.next i)))) dx)
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.incrementC_add_i.type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx dt : ℝ) (u : I → ℝ) (i : I),
  CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.incrementC g dx dt u i + CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.incrementD g dx dt u i =
    dt * CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.waveSpeed (u i) (u (g.next i)) / dx

CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.incrementC_nonne.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.incrementC_nonneg
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.incrementC_nonne.raw_type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx dt : Real),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) dx →
    LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) dt →

CFDLean.Exec.eulerStepArray.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Exec.eulerStepArray.eq_1
CFDLean.Exec.eulerStepArray.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ {α : Type} [inst : CFDLean.Exec.Scalar α] (dx dt : α) (u : Array α),
  Eq (CFDLean.Exec.eulerStepArray dx dt u)
    (Array.ofFn fun i =>
      HAdd.hAdd (getElem u i ⋯)
        (HMul.hMul dt
          (HDiv.hDiv
            (Neg.neg
              (HSub.hSub
                (CFDLean.Exec.Scalar.rusanov (getElem u i ⋯)
                  (getElem u (HMod.hMod (HAdd.hAdd i.val (OfNat.ofNat 1)) u.size) ⋯))
                (CFDLean.Exec.Scalar.rusanov
                  (getElem u (HMod.hMod (HSub.hSub (HAdd.hAdd i.val u.size) (OfNat.ofNat 1)) u.size) ⋯)
                  (getElem u i ⋯))))
            dx)))

∀ {α : Type} [inst : CFDLean.Exec.Scalar α] (dx dt : α) (u : Array α),
  CFDLean.Exec.eulerStepArray dx dt u =
    Array.ofFn fun i =>
      u[i] +
        dt *
          (-(CFDLean.Exec.Scalar.rusanov u[i] u[(↑i + 1) % u.size] -
                CFDLean.Exec.Scalar.rusanov u[(↑i + u.size - 1) % u.size] u[i]) /

CFDLean.Exec.instScalarReal_standard.raw_type:
∀ (x y : Real),
  And (Eq (Add.add x y) (HAdd.hAdd x y))
    (And (Eq (Sub.sub x y) (HSub.hSub x y))
      (And (Eq (Mul.mul x y) (HMul.hMul x y))
        (And (Eq (Div.div x y) (HDiv.hDiv x y))
          (And (Eq (Neg.neg x) (Neg.neg x))
            (And (Eq Zero.zero (OfNat.ofNat 0))
              (And (Eq (CFDLean.Exec.Scalar.abs x) (abs x))
                (And (Eq (CFDLean.Exec.Scalar.max x y) (max x y))
                  (And (Eq CFDLean.Exec.Scalar.two (OfNat.ofNat 2))
                    (And (Eq CFDLean.Exec.Scalar.half (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))
                      (And (Eq CFDLean.Exec.Scalar.third (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 3)))
                        (And (Eq CFDLean.Exec.Scalar.twoThirds (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 2) (OfNat.ofNat 3)))
                          (And (Eq CFDLean.Exec.Scalar.quarter (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 4)))
                            (Eq CFDLean.Exec.Scalar.threeQuarters
                              (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 3) (OfNat.ofNat 4)))))))))))))))
CFDLean.Exec.instScalarReal_standard.type:
∀ (x y : ℝ),
  Add.add x y = x + y ∧
    Sub.sub x y = x - y ∧
      Mul.mul x y = x * y ∧
        Div.div x y = x / y ∧
          -x = -x ∧
            Zero.zero = 0 ∧
              CFDLean.Exec.Scalar.abs x = |x| ∧
                CFDLean.Exec.Scalar.max x y = max x y ∧
                  CFDLean.Exec.Scalar.two = 2 ∧
                    CFDLean.Exec.Scalar.half = 1 / 2 ∧
                      CFDLean.Exec.Scalar.third = 1 / 3 ∧
                        CFDLean.Exec.Scalar.twoThirds = 2 / 3 ∧
                          CFDLean.Exec.Scalar.quarter = 1 / 4 ∧ CFDLean.Exec.Scalar.threeQuarters = 3 / 4

  (u : Array α),
  Eq (CFDLean.Exec.limiterEulerStepArray L dx dt u)
    (Array.ofFn fun i =>
      HAdd.hAdd (getElem u i ⋯)
        (HMul.hMul dt
          (HDiv.hDiv
            (Neg.neg
              (HSub.hSub
                (CFDLean.Exec.Scalar.rusanov (CFDLean.Exec.limFacePlus L u i)
                  (CFDLean.Exec.limFaceMinus L u (CFDLean.Exec.nextIdx i)))
                (CFDLean.Exec.Scalar.rusanov (CFDLean.Exec.limFacePlus L u (CFDLean.Exec.prevIdx i))
                  (CFDLean.Exec.limFaceMinus L u i))))
            dx)))

  (u : Array α),
  CFDLean.Exec.limiterEulerStepArray L dx dt u =
    Array.ofFn fun i =>
      u[i] +
        dt *
          (-(CFDLean.Exec.Scalar.rusanov (CFDLean.Exec.limFacePlus L u i)
                  (CFDLean.Exec.limFaceMinus L u (CFDLean.Exec.nextIdx i)) -
                CFDLean.Exec.Scalar.rusanov (CFDLean.Exec.limFacePlus L u (CFDLean.Exec.prevIdx i))
                  (CFDLean.Exec.limFaceMinus L u i)) /
            dx)

CFDLean.Exec.musclEulerStepArray.name: CFDLean.Exec.musclEulerStepArray
CFDLean.Exec.musclEulerStepArray.type: {α : Type} → [CFDLean.Exec.Scalar α] → α → α → Array α → Array α

CFDLean.Exec.musclEulerStepArray.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Exec.musclEulerStepArray.eq_1
CFDLean.Exec.musclEulerStepArray.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ {α : Type} [inst : CFDLean.Exec.Scalar α] (dx dt : α) (u : Array α),
  Eq (CFDLean.Exec.musclEulerStepArray dx dt u)
    (Array.ofFn fun i =>
      HAdd.hAdd (getElem u i ⋯)
        (HMul.hMul dt
          (HDiv.hDiv
            (Neg.neg
              (HSub.hSub
                (CFDLean.Exec.Scalar.rusanov (CFDLean.Exec.facePlus u i)
                  (CFDLean.Exec.faceMinus u (CFDLean.Exec.nextIdx i)))
                (CFDLean.Exec.Scalar.rusanov (CFDLean.Exec.facePlus u (CFDLean.Exec.prevIdx i))
                  (CFDLean.Exec.faceMinus u i))))
            dx)))
CFDLean.Exec.musclEulerStepArray.eq_1.type:
∀ {α : Type} [inst : CFDLean.Exec.Scalar α] (dx dt : α) (u : Array α),
  CFDLean.Exec.musclEulerStepArray dx dt u =
    Array.ofFn fun i =>
      u[i] +
        dt *
          (-(CFDLean.Exec.Scalar.rusanov (CFDLean.Exec.facePlus u i)
                  (CFDLean.Exec.faceMinus u (CFDLean.Exec.nextIdx i)) -
                CFDLean.Exec.Scalar.rusanov (CFDLean.Exec.facePlus u (CFDLean.Exec.prevIdx i))
                  (CFDLean.Exec.faceMinus u i)) /
            dx)

        ∀ (a : Array Real),
          CFDLean.Exec.EntriesBetween m M a →

        ∀ (a : Array ℝ),

            ∀ (k : ℕ),

  (∀ (a : Array Real), Eq (step a).size a.size) →
    CFDLean.Exec.RefinedBy step T →
      ∀ {m M : Real},
        (∀ (n : Nat) [inst : NeZero n] (u : Fin n → Real) (k : Nat),
            Membership.mem (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.boundedStates m M) u →
              LE.le (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.totalVariation (CFDLean.Exec.finGrid n) (Nat.iterate (T n) k u))
                (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.totalVariation (CFDLean.Exec.finGrid n) u)) →
          ∀ {a : Array Real},
            CFDLean.Exec.EntriesBetween m M a →
              ∀ (k : Nat),
                LE.le (CFDLean.Exec.totalVariationArray (CFDLean.Exec.run step k a))
                  (CFDLean.Exec.totalVariationArray a)
CFDLean.Exec.run_totalVariationArray_le.type:
∀ {step : Array ℝ → Array ℝ} {T : (n : ℕ) → [NeZero n] → (Fin n → ℝ) → Fin n → ℝ},

    CFDLean.Exec.RefinedBy step T →
      ∀ {m M : ℝ},
        (∀ (n : ℕ) [inst : NeZero n] (u : Fin n → ℝ) (k : ℕ),
            u ∈ CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.boundedStates m M →
              CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.totalVariation (CFDLean.Exec.finGrid n) ((T n)^[k] u) ≤

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Ad2W.sharp_core.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Ad2W.sharp_core
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Ad2W.sharp_core.raw_type:
∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] {d : Nat} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d)
  (K : Matrix κ (Fin d) Real → Matrix κ (Fin d) Real),
  IsLinearMap Real K →
    ∀ (P : Matrix κ κ Real) (gw : κ → Real) (o : Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1))) (c : Real) (e b : κ → Real),
      LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 1) d →
        T.Nondeg →
          Eq (P.mulVec (HSub.hSub (HAdd.hAdd b e) gw)) e →
            Eq
              (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.Dgal T K (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Ad2W.wit T o e b))
                (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.PiW T K P gw (singleton o) c (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Ad2W.wit T o e b)))
              (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub c (OfNat.ofNat 1))
                (HDiv.hDiv
                  (HMul.hMul (HPow.hPow (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.area T o) (OfNat.ofNat 2))
                    (CFDLean.Num.frob (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.outerK e (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.normal T o))
                      (K (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.outerK e (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.normal T o)))))
                  T.vol))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Ad2W.sharp_core.type:
∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] {d : ℕ} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d) (K : Matrix κ (Fin d) ℝ → Matrix κ (Fin d) ℝ),
  IsLinearMap ℝ K →
    ∀ (P : Matrix κ κ ℝ) (gw : κ → ℝ) (o : Fin (d + 1)) (c : ℝ) (e b : κ → ℝ),
      1 ≤ d →
        T.Nondeg →
          P.mulVec (b + e - gw) = e →
            CFDLean.JST1.Wall.Dgal T K (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Ad2W.wit T o e b) -
                CFDLean.JST1.Wall.PiW T K P gw {o} c (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Ad2W.wit T o e b) =
              (c - 1) *
                (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.area T o ^ 2 *
                    CFDLean.Num.frob (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.outerK e (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.normal T o))
                      (K (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.outerK e (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.normal T o))) /
                  T.vol)

                      (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sg
                        (CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.sideOf (M.pos i0) (M.pos i1) (M.pos i2)

          (CFDLean.JST1.Spec.tetFaces t).all fun f =>

            (Finset.univ.sum fun k => CFDLean.JST1.Scheme.central S u i k)))
      (Finset.univ.sum fun i => CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.fluxPot (u i)) (S.M.beta i))

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Cmp14.closure_part.raw_type:
∀ {ι C Q : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype C] [inst_3 : Fintype Q] {d : Nat}
  (S : CFDLean.JST1.Scheme.Data ι C Q d) (u : ι → CFDLean.JST1.State d),
  (∀ (i : ι), CFDLean.JST1.Admissible S.g (u i)) →
    (∀ (q : Q), CFDLean.JST1.Admissible S.g (S.ut q)) →
      (∀ (q : Q), Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun k => S.φ q k) (OfNat.ofNat 1)) →
        (∀ (q : Q),
            Eq (CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars S.g (S.ut q))
              (Finset.univ.sum fun k => HSMul.hSMul (S.φ q k) (CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars S.g (u k)))) →
          Eq
            (Neg.neg
              (Finset.univ.sum fun i =>
                CFDLean.Num.pairF (CFDLean.JST1.Scheme.w S u i) (CFDLean.JST1.Scheme.closure S u i)))
            (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.JST1.Scheme.Bterm S)
              (Finset.univ.sum fun i =>
                CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.fluxPot (u i)) (Finset.univ.sum fun q => HSMul.hSMul (S.φ q i) (S.N q))))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Cmp14.closure_part.type:
∀ {ι C Q : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype C] [inst_3 : Fintype Q] {d : ℕ}
  (S : CFDLean.JST1.Scheme.Data ι C Q d) (u : ι → CFDLean.JST1.State d),
  (∀ (i : ι), CFDLean.JST1.Admissible S.g (u i)) →
    (∀ (q : Q), CFDLean.JST1.Admissible S.g (S.ut q)) →
      (∀ (q : Q), ∑ k, S.φ q k = 1) →
        (∀ (q : Q), CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars S.g (S.ut q) = ∑ k, S.φ q k • CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars S.g (u k)) →
          -∑ i, CFDLean.Num.pairF (CFDLean.JST1.Scheme.w S u i) (CFDLean.JST1.Scheme.closure S u i) =
            CFDLean.JST1.Scheme.Bterm S - ∑ i, CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.fluxPot (u i)) (∑ q, S.φ q i • S.N q)

∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : Nat} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)

  M.Valid →
    LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 1) d →
      M.FacetBalanced bd →
        (∀ (q : Q), Eq (bd (fq q)) true) →
          (∀ (q : Q) (k : ι), Not (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes (fq q)) k) → Eq (φ q k) (OfNat.ofNat 0)) →
            (∀ (p : Prod C (Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1)))),
                Eq (bd p) true →
                  ∀ (i : ι),
                    Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) i →
                      Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun q => ite (Eq (fq q) p) (HMul.hMul (aq q) (φ q i)) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
                        (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) d.cast)) →
              (∀ (q : Q), Eq (N q) (HSMul.hSMul (aq q) (M.areaVec (fq q)))) →
                ∀ (i : ι), Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun q => HSMul.hSMul (φ q i) (N q)) (M.beta i)

  (φ : Q → ι → ℝ) (N : Q → CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  M.Valid →
    1 ≤ d →
      M.FacetBalanced bd →
        (∀ (q : Q), bd (fq q) = true) →
          (∀ (q : Q), ∀ k ∉ M.facetNodes (fq q), φ q k = 0) →
            (∀ (p : C × Fin (d + 1)),
                bd p = true → ∀ i ∈ M.facetNodes p, (∑ q, if fq q = p then aq q * φ q i else 0) = 1 / ↑d) →
              (∀ (q : Q), N q = aq q • M.areaVec (fq q)) → ∀ (i : ι), ∑ q, φ q i • N q = M.beta i

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.Q_eq.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.Q_eq
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.Q_eq.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (r0 : Real) (v E : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (p0 k : Real),
  Ne p0 (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
    Eq
      (CFDLean.Num.pairF (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW g.γ r0 p0 (CFDLean.Num.dot v v) (CFDLean.Num.dot v E) k v E)
        (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF g.γ r0 p0 (CFDLean.Num.dot v v) (CFDLean.Num.dot v E) (CFDLean.Num.dot E E) k v
          E))
      (HMul.hMul r0
        (HAdd.hAdd
          (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul g.γ (CFDLean.Num.dot v E))
            (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv r0 p0) (HPow.hPow k (OfNat.ofNat 2))) (CFDLean.Num.dot E E))
              (CFDLean.Num.dot v E)))
          (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) g.γ) k) (CFDLean.Num.dot E E))))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.Q_eq.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (r0 : ℝ) (v E : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (p0 k : ℝ),
  p0 ≠ 0 →
    CFDLean.Num.pairF (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW g.γ r0 p0 (CFDLean.Num.dot v v) (CFDLean.Num.dot v E) k v E)
        (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF g.γ r0 p0 (CFDLean.Num.dot v v) (CFDLean.Num.dot v E) (CFDLean.Num.dot E E) k v
          E) =
      r0 *
        (g.γ * CFDLean.Num.dot v E + r0 / p0 * k ^ 2 * CFDLean.Num.dot E E * CFDLean.Num.dot v E +
          2 * g.γ * k * CFDLean.Num.dot E E)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF.type: {d : ℕ} → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → CFDLean.Num.Vec d → CFDLean.Num.Vec d → CFDLean.JST1.State d

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF.eq_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF.eq_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (γ r0 p0 A vn L2 k : Real) (v E : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  Eq (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF γ r0 p0 A vn L2 k v E CFDLean.JST1.Channel.mass)
    (HMul.hMul r0 (HAdd.hAdd vn (HMul.hMul k L2)))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF.eq_1.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ r0 p0 A vn L2 k : ℝ) (v E : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF γ r0 p0 A vn L2 k v E CFDLean.JST1.Channel.mass = r0 * (vn + k * L2)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF.eq_2.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF.eq_2
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF.eq_2.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (γ r0 p0 A vn L2 k : Real) (v E : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (α : Fin d),
  Eq (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF γ r0 p0 A vn L2 k v E (CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α))
    (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul r0 vn) (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul r0 k) L2)) (v α))
      (HMul.hMul (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul r0 k) vn) (HMul.hMul p0 γ)) (E α)))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF.eq_2.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ r0 p0 A vn L2 k : ℝ) (v E : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (α : Fin d),
  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF γ r0 p0 A vn L2 k v E (CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α) =
    (r0 * vn + r0 * k * L2) * v α + (r0 * k * vn + p0 * γ) * E α

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF.eq_3.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF.eq_3
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF.eq_3.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (γ r0 p0 A vn L2 k : Real) (v E : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  Eq (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF γ r0 p0 A vn L2 k v E CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy)
    (HAdd.hAdd
      (HMul.hMul
        (HAdd.hAdd
          (HAdd.hAdd
            (HAdd.hAdd (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul p0 γ) (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
              (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul r0 A) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))
            (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul r0 k) vn))
          (HMul.hMul p0 γ))
        vn)
      (HMul.hMul
        (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd (HDiv.hDiv p0 (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1))) (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul r0 A) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))
          p0)
        (HMul.hMul k L2)))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF.eq_3.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ r0 p0 A vn L2 k : ℝ) (v E : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dF γ r0 p0 A vn L2 k v E CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy =
    (p0 * γ / (γ - 1) + r0 * A / 2 + r0 * k * vn + p0 * γ) * vn + (p0 / (γ - 1) + r0 * A / 2 + p0) * (k * L2)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW.type: {d : ℕ} → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → CFDLean.Num.Vec d → CFDLean.Num.Vec d → CFDLean.JST1.State d

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW.eq_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW.eq_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (γ r0 p0 A vn k : Real) (v E : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  Eq (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW γ r0 p0 A vn k v E CFDLean.JST1.Channel.mass)
    (HDiv.hDiv
      (Neg.neg
        (HMul.hMul r0
          (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ) A) (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) k) vn))))
      (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) p0))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW.eq_1.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ r0 p0 A vn k : ℝ) (v E : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW γ r0 p0 A vn k v E CFDLean.JST1.Channel.mass =
    -(r0 * ((1 - γ) * A + 2 * k * vn)) / (2 * p0)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW.eq_2.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW.eq_2
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW.eq_2.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (γ r0 p0 A vn k : Real) (v E : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (α : Fin d),
  Eq (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW γ r0 p0 A vn k v E (CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α))
    (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul r0 (HSub.hSub (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ)) p0) (v α))
      (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul r0 k) p0) (E α)))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW.eq_2.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ r0 p0 A vn k : ℝ) (v E : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (α : Fin d),
  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW γ r0 p0 A vn k v E (CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α) =
    r0 * (1 - γ) / p0 * v α + r0 * k / p0 * E α

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW.eq_3.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW.eq_3
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW.eq_3.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (γ r0 p0 A vn k : Real) (v E : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  Eq (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW γ r0 p0 A vn k v E CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy)
    (HDiv.hDiv (Neg.neg (HMul.hMul r0 (HSub.hSub (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ))) p0)
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW.eq_3.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ r0 p0 A vn k : ℝ) (v E : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW γ r0 p0 A vn k v E CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy = -(r0 * (1 - γ)) / p0

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW.match_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.dW.match_1

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.exists_near.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.exists_near
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.exists_near.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (U : CFDLean.JST1.State d) (E : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.JST1.Admissible g U →
    ∀ (k : Real) {ε : Real},
      LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) ε →
        ∀ {S : Set Real},
          IsOpen S →
            Membership.mem S
                (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.JST1.rho U)
                  (HAdd.hAdd
                    (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul g.γ (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel U) E))
                      (HMul.hMul
                        (HMul.hMul
                          (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.JST1.rho U) (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U))
                            (HPow.hPow k (OfNat.ofNat 2)))
                          (CFDLean.Num.dot E E))
                        (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel U) E)))
                    (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) g.γ) k) (CFDLean.Num.dot E E)))) →
              Exists fun t =>
                And (Ne t (OfNat.ofNat 0))
                  (And
                    (CFDLean.JST1.Admissible g
                      (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.path g (CFDLean.JST1.rho U) (CFDLean.JST1.vel U) E
                        (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U) k t))
                    (And
                      (LT.lt
                        (norm
                          (HSub.hSub
                            (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.path g (CFDLean.JST1.rho U) (CFDLean.JST1.vel U) E
                              (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U) k t)
                            U))
                        ε)
                      (Membership.mem S
                        (HDiv.hDiv
                          (CFDLean.Num.pairF
                            (HSub.hSub
                              (CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g
                                (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.path g (CFDLean.JST1.rho U) (CFDLean.JST1.vel U) E
                                  (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U) k t))
                              (CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g U))
                            (HSub.hSub
                              (CFDLean.JST1.physFlux g
                                (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.path g (CFDLean.JST1.rho U) (CFDLean.JST1.vel U) E
                                  (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U) k t)
                                E)
                              (CFDLean.JST1.physFlux g U E)))
                          (HPow.hPow t (OfNat.ofNat 2))))))

∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (U : CFDLean.JST1.State d) (E : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.JST1.Admissible g U →
    ∀ (k : ℝ) {ε : ℝ},
      0 < ε →
        ∀ {S : Set ℝ},
          IsOpen S →
            CFDLean.JST1.rho U *
                  (g.γ * CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel U) E +
                      CFDLean.JST1.rho U / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U * k ^ 2 * CFDLean.Num.dot E E *
                        CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel U) E +
                    2 * g.γ * k * CFDLean.Num.dot E E) ∈
                S →

                      (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.path g (CFDLean.JST1.rho U) (CFDLean.JST1.vel U) E
                        (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U) k t) ∧

                            (CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g
                                (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.path g (CFDLean.JST1.rho U) (CFDLean.JST1.vel U) E
                                  (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U) k t) -
                              CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g U)
                            (CFDLean.JST1.physFlux g
                                (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.path g (CFDLean.JST1.rho U) (CFDLean.JST1.vel U) E
                                  (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U) k t)

  Eq
    (Finset.univ.sum fun α =>
      HMul.hMul (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul x (v α)) (HMul.hMul y (E α))) (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul z (v α)) (HMul.hMul u (E α))))
    (HAdd.hAdd
      (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul x z) (CFDLean.Num.dot v v))
        (HMul.hMul (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul x u) (HMul.hMul y z)) (CFDLean.Num.dot v E)))
      (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul y u) (CFDLean.Num.dot E E)))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.sum_lin.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (v E : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (x y z u : ℝ),
  ∑ α, (x * v α + y * E α) * (z * v α + u * E α) =
    x * z * CFDLean.Num.dot v v + (x * u + y * z) * CFDLean.Num.dot v E + y * u * CFDLean.Num.dot E E

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.sum_lin._simp_.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} {s : Finset ι} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] {f g : ι → M},
  ∑ x ∈ s, f x + ∑ x ∈ s, g x = ∑ x ∈ s, (f x + g x)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DissGeom.dot_c.raw_type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : Nat} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (i k : ι)
  (v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  Eq (CFDLean.Num.dot (M.c i k) v)
    (Finset.univ.sum fun T =>
      Finset.univ.sum fun a =>
        Finset.univ.sum fun b =>
          ite (And (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) a) i) (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) b) k))
            (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (M.ω T) (M.m T)) (CFDLean.Num.dot (M.g T b) v)) (OfNat.ofNat 0))

∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (i k : ι)
  (v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.Num.dot (M.c i k) v =
    ∑ T, ∑ a, ∑ b, if (M.vert T) a = i ∧ (M.vert T) b = k then M.ω T * M.m T * CFDLean.Num.dot (M.g T b) v else 0

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.facet_cross.raw_type:

  T.Nondeg →
    (List.cons o (List.cons a (List.cons b (List.cons c List.nil)))).Nodup →
      Eq (T.facet o)
        (HSMul.hSMul
          (ite
            (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0)
              (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (HSub.hSub (T.x b) (T.x a)) (HSub.hSub (T.x c) (T.x a)))
                (HSub.hSub (T.x o) (T.x a))))
            (Neg.neg (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2))) (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))
          (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (HSub.hSub (T.x b) (T.x a)) (HSub.hSub (T.x c) (T.x a))))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.facet_cross.type:
∀ (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex 3) (o a b c : Fin 4),
  T.Nondeg →
    [o, a, b, c].Nodup →
      T.facet o =
        (if 0 < CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (T.x b - T.x a) (T.x c - T.x a)) (T.x o - T.x a) then -(1 / 2)
          else 1 / 2) •
          CFDLean.Num.cross3 (T.x b - T.x a) (T.x c - T.x a)

∀ (p : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4) → CFDLean.Num.Vec (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (o a b c : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  (List.cons o (List.cons a (List.cons b (List.cons c List.nil)))).Nodup →
    Or
      (Eq (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (HSub.hSub (p b) (p a)) (HSub.hSub (p c) (p a))) (HSub.hSub (p o) (p a)))
        (CFDLean.Num.dot
          (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (HSub.hSub (p ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (p ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
            (HSub.hSub (p ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (p ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
          (HSub.hSub (p ⟨3, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (p ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩))))
      (Eq (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (HSub.hSub (p b) (p a)) (HSub.hSub (p c) (p a))) (HSub.hSub (p o) (p a)))
        (Neg.neg
          (CFDLean.Num.dot
            (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (HSub.hSub (p ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (p ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
              (HSub.hSub (p ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (p ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
            (HSub.hSub (p ⟨3, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (p ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))))

∀ (p : Fin 4 → CFDLean.Num.Vec 3) (o a b c : Fin 4),
  [o, a, b, c].Nodup →
    CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (p b - p a) (p c - p a)) (p o - p a) =
        CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (p 1 - p 0) (p 2 - p 0)) (p 3 - p 0) ∨
      CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (p b - p a) (p c - p a)) (p o - p a) =
        -CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (p 1 - p 0) (p 2 - p 0)) (p 3 - p 0)

        (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) s) (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Hess18.sA u δ)))

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Hess18.hasDerivAt_li.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Hess18.hasDerivAt_lineF
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Hess18.hasDerivAt_li.raw_type:
∀ {γ r A0 A1 A2 p dr dE : Real},
  Ne (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)) (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
    LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) r →
      LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) p →
        HasDerivAt
          (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Hess18.lineF γ r A0 A1 A2
            (HAdd.hAdd (HDiv.hDiv p (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1))) (HDiv.hDiv A0 (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) r))) dr dE)
          (HAdd.hAdd
            (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv r (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
              (CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ (HDiv.hDiv dr r)
                (HDiv.hDiv
                  (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1))
                    (HAdd.hAdd (HSub.hSub dE (HDiv.hDiv A1 r))
                      (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv A0 (HPow.hPow r (OfNat.ofNat 2))) dr) (OfNat.ofNat 2))))
                  p)))
            (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (HPow.hPow r (OfNat.ofNat 2)) p)
              (HDiv.hDiv
                (HAdd.hAdd (HSub.hSub A2 (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) dr) (HDiv.hDiv A1 r)))
                  (HMul.hMul (HPow.hPow dr (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (HDiv.hDiv A0 (HPow.hPow r (OfNat.ofNat 2)))))
                (HPow.hPow r (OfNat.ofNat 2)))))
          (OfNat.ofNat 0)
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Hess18.hasDerivAt_li.type:
∀ {γ r A0 A1 A2 p dr dE : ℝ},
  γ - 1 ≠ 0 →
    0 < r →
      0 < p →
        HasDerivAt (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Hess18.lineF γ r A0 A1 A2 (p / (γ - 1) + A0 / (2 * r)) dr dE)
          (r / (γ - 1) * CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ (dr / r) ((γ - 1) * (dE - A1 / r + A0 / r ^ 2 * dr / 2) / p) +
            r ^ 2 / p * ((A2 - 2 * dr * (A1 / r) + dr ^ 2 * (A0 / r ^ 2)) / r ^ 2))
          0

                  (OfNat.ofNat 2))))
            (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g u))))
      (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (HPow.hPow (CFDLean.JST1.rho u) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g u))
        (CFDLean.Num.dot

            (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.JST1.mom δ) (HSMul.hSMul (δ CFDLean.JST1.Channel.mass) (CFDLean.JST1.vel u))))
          (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (CFDLean.JST1.rho u))

    CFDLean.JST1.rho u / (g.γ - 1) *
        CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ g.γ (δ CFDLean.JST1.Channel.mass / CFDLean.JST1.rho u)
          ((g.γ - 1) *
              (δ CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy - CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel u) (CFDLean.JST1.mom δ) +
                CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel u) (CFDLean.JST1.vel u) * δ CFDLean.JST1.Channel.mass / 2) /
            CFDLean.JST1.pressure g u) +
      CFDLean.JST1.rho u ^ 2 / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g u *
        CFDLean.Num.dot
          ((1 / CFDLean.JST1.rho u) • (CFDLean.JST1.mom δ - δ CFDLean.JST1.Channel.mass • CFDLean.JST1.vel u))
          ((1 / CFDLean.JST1.rho u) • (CFDLean.JST1.mom δ - δ CFDLean.JST1.Channel.mass • CFDLean.JST1.vel u))
