∀ {d : Nat} {E : Type} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (n : Nat)
  (f : E → CFDLean.JST1.State d),
  ContDiff Real n.cast f →
    ∀ (s : Set E),
      (∀ (x : E), Membership.mem s x → Ne (CFDLean.JST1.rho (f x)) (OfNat.ofNat 0)) →
        ContDiffOn Real n.cast (fun x => CFDLean.JST1.pressure g (f x)) s
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.IR19.pressure_contDi.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} {E : Type} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (n : ℕ)
  (f : E → CFDLean.JST1.State d),
  ContDiff ℝ (↑n) f →
    ∀ (s : Set E), (∀ x ∈ s, CFDLean.JST1.rho (f x) ≠ 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ (↑n) (fun x => CFDLean.JST1.pressure g (f x)) s

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.IR19.pressure_eq.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.IR19.pressure_eq
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.IR19.pressure_eq.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (U : CFDLean.JST1.State d),
  Eq (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U)
    (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub g.γ (OfNat.ofNat 1))
      (HSub.hSub (U CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy)
        (HDiv.hDiv
          (Finset.univ.sum fun α =>
            HMul.hMul (U (CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α)) (U (CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α)))
          (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) (U CFDLean.JST1.Channel.mass)))))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.IR19.pressure_eq.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (U : CFDLean.JST1.State d),
  CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U =
    (g.γ - 1) *
      (U CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy -
        (∑ α, U (CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α) * U (CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α)) /
          (2 * U CFDLean.JST1.Channel.mass))

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Int21.bary_swap.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Int21.bary_swap
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Int21.bary_swap.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d),
  T.Nondeg →
    ∀ (a b c : Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1))) (x : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
      Eq (CFDLean.JST1.Spec.bary T c (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Int21.swapMap T a b x))
        (HAdd.hAdd (CFDLean.JST1.Spec.bary T c x)
          (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.JST1.Spec.bary T a x) (CFDLean.JST1.Spec.bary T b x))
            (HSub.hSub (ite (Eq c b) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0)) (ite (Eq c a) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Int21.bary_swap.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d),
  T.Nondeg →
    ∀ (a b c : Fin (d + 1)) (x : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
      CFDLean.JST1.Spec.bary T c (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Int21.swapMap T a b x) =
        CFDLean.JST1.Spec.bary T c x +
          (CFDLean.JST1.Spec.bary T a x - CFDLean.JST1.Spec.bary T b x) *
            ((if c = b then 1 else 0) - if c = a then 1 else 0)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Pde17.pair_vEta_expa.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Pde17.pair_vEta_expand
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Pde17.pair_vEta_expa.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (V X : CFDLean.JST1.SState d),
  Eq (CFDLean.Num.pairF (CFDLean.JST1.vEta g V) X)
    (HAdd.hAdd
      (HSub.hSub
        (HAdd.hAdd
          (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.JST1.vEta g V (CFDLean.JST1.SChan.flow CFDLean.JST1.Channel.mass))
            (X (CFDLean.JST1.SChan.flow CFDLean.JST1.Channel.mass)))
          (Finset.univ.sum fun α =>
            HMul.hMul
              (HMul.hMul
                (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.JST1.rho (CFDLean.JST1.hatState V))
                  (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g (CFDLean.JST1.hatState V)))
                (CFDLean.JST1.vel (CFDLean.JST1.hatState V) α))
              (X (CFDLean.JST1.SChan.flow (CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α)))))
        (HMul.hMul
          (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.JST1.rho (CFDLean.JST1.hatState V)) (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g (CFDLean.JST1.hatState V)))
          (X (CFDLean.JST1.SChan.flow CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy))))
      (HMul.hMul
        (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.JST1.rho (CFDLean.JST1.hatState V)) (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g (CFDLean.JST1.hatState V)))
        (X CFDLean.JST1.SChan.tke)))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Pde17.pair_vEta_expa.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (V X : CFDLean.JST1.SState d),
  CFDLean.Num.pairF (CFDLean.JST1.vEta g V) X =
    CFDLean.JST1.vEta g V (CFDLean.JST1.SChan.flow CFDLean.JST1.Channel.mass) *
            X (CFDLean.JST1.SChan.flow CFDLean.JST1.Channel.mass) +
          ∑ α,
            CFDLean.JST1.rho (CFDLean.JST1.hatState V) / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g (CFDLean.JST1.hatState V) *
                CFDLean.JST1.vel (CFDLean.JST1.hatState V) α *
              X (CFDLean.JST1.SChan.flow (CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α)) -
        CFDLean.JST1.rho (CFDLean.JST1.hatState V) / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g (CFDLean.JST1.hatState V) *
          X (CFDLean.JST1.SChan.flow CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy) +
      CFDLean.JST1.rho (CFDLean.JST1.hatState V) / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g (CFDLean.JST1.hatState V) *
        X CFDLean.JST1.SChan.tke

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.Gv_tau.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.Gv_tau
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.Gv_tau.raw_type:

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.Pi_form.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.Pi_form
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.Pi_form.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (D : CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Data d),
  Ne D.R (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
    Ne D.T (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
      Eq (CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Pi D)
        (HAdd.hAdd
          (HSub.hSub
            (HMul.hMul (Neg.neg (CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.theta D))
              (HAdd.hAdd
                (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul D.μ (CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Q D))
                  (HSub.hSub (HMul.hMul D.μt (CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Q D)) D.Pk))
                D.ε))
            (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul D.κ (CFDLean.Num.dot D.GT D.GT)) (HMul.hMul D.R (HPow.hPow D.T (OfNat.ofNat 2)))))
          (ite (Eq D.withDk true) (OfNat.ofNat 0)
            (Neg.neg (HMul.hMul D.Dk (CFDLean.Num.dot D.Gk (CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Gtheta D))))))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.Pi_form.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (D : CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Data d),
  D.R ≠ 0 →
    D.T ≠ 0 →
      CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Pi D =
        -CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.theta D *
              (D.μ * CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Q D + (D.μt * CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Q D - D.Pk) + D.ε) -
            D.κ * CFDLean.Num.dot D.GT D.GT / (D.R * D.T ^ 2) +
          if D.withDk = true then 0 else -(D.Dk * CFDLean.Num.dot D.Gk (CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Gtheta D))

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.Q_form.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.Q_form
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.Q_form.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (D : CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Data d),
  Eq (CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Q D)
    (HSub.hSub
      (Finset.univ.sum fun α => Finset.univ.sum fun β => HMul.hMul (D.Gv α β) (HAdd.hAdd (D.Gv α β) (D.Gv β α)))
      (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 2) (OfNat.ofNat 3))
        (HPow.hPow (Finset.univ.sum fun γ => D.Gv γ γ) (OfNat.ofNat 2))))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.Q_form.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (D : CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Data d),
  CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Q D = ∑ α, ∑ β, D.Gv α β * (D.Gv α β + D.Gv β α) - 2 / 3 * (∑ γ, D.Gv γ γ) ^ 2

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.persp_le.raw_type:

  LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) a →
    LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) b →
      LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) r1 →
        LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) r2 →
          LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul a r1) (HMul.hMul b r2)) →
            LE.le
              (HDiv.hDiv
                (HMul.hMul (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul a x) (HMul.hMul b y)) (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul a x) (HMul.hMul b y)))
                (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul a r1) (HMul.hMul b r2))))
              (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul a (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul x x) (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) r1)))
                (HMul.hMul b (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul y y) (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) r2))))

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wall15.taylor2_bound.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wall15.taylor2_bound
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wall15.taylor2_bound.raw_type:
∀ (f : Real → Real),
  ContDiff Real (OfNat.ofNat 3) f →
    ∀ (R : Real),
      Exists fun C =>
        And (LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) C)
          (∀ (x0 x : Real),
            Membership.mem (Set.Icc (Neg.neg R) R) x0 →
              Membership.mem (Set.Icc (Neg.neg R) R) x →
                LE.le
                  (abs
                    (HSub.hSub (f x)
                      (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd (f x0) (HMul.hMul (deriv f x0) (HSub.hSub x x0)))
                        (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul (deriv (deriv f) x0) (HPow.hPow (HSub.hSub x x0) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))
                          (OfNat.ofNat 2)))))
                  (HMul.hMul C (HPow.hPow (abs (HSub.hSub x x0)) (OfNat.ofNat 3))))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wall15.taylor2_bound.type:
∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ),
  ContDiff ℝ 3 f →
    ∀ (R : ℝ),
      ∃ C,
        0 ≤ C ∧
          ∀ (x0 x : ℝ),
            x0 ∈ Set.Icc (-R) R →
              x ∈ Set.Icc (-R) R →
                |f x - (f x0 + deriv f x0 * (x - x0) + deriv (deriv f) x0 * (x - x0) ^ 2 / 2)| ≤ C * |x - x0| ^ 3

    ∀ {x0 x : Real},
      Ne x0 x →
        Eq (taylorWithinEval f (OfNat.ofNat 2) (Set.uIcc x0 x) x0 x)
          (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd (f x0) (HMul.hMul (deriv f x0) (HSub.hSub x x0)))
            (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul (deriv (deriv f) x0) (HPow.hPow (HSub.hSub x x0) (OfNat.ofNat 2))) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Wall15.taylor2_eval.type:
∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ),

    ∀ {x0 x : ℝ},

        taylorWithinEval f 2 (Set.uIcc x0 x) x0 x = f x0 + deriv f x0 * (x - x0) + deriv (deriv f) x0 * (x - x0) ^ 2 / 2

                (K (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.outerK (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.eW P gw w b) (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.normal T o))))))

    LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) p1 →
      LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) r2 →

          have Ui := CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.restState g r1 p1;

            (Eq
              (CFDLean.Num.pairF (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g Uk) (CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g Ui))
                (HSub.hSub Uk Ui))
              (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ g.γ r1 p1 r2 p2))
            (Eq
              (CFDLean.Num.pairF (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g Uk) (CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g Ui))
                (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.JST1.enthalpyState g Uk) (CFDLean.JST1.enthalpyState g Ui)))

          have Ui := CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.restState g r1 p1;

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.deriv_alg.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.deriv_alg
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.deriv_alg.raw_type:
∀ (γ μ ν ds db B R : Real),
  Ne B (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
    Ne (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)) (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
      Eq
        (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv R (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
          (HAdd.hAdd
            (HMul.hMul μ
              (CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ
                (HDiv.hDiv (Neg.neg (HAdd.hAdd ds (HDiv.hDiv db B))) (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
                (HSub.hSub (HDiv.hDiv (Neg.neg (HAdd.hAdd ds (HDiv.hDiv db B))) (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
                  (HDiv.hDiv db B))))
            (HMul.hMul ν
              (CFDLean.JST1.thermoQt γ
                (HDiv.hDiv (Neg.neg (HAdd.hAdd ds (HDiv.hDiv db B))) (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
                (HSub.hSub (HDiv.hDiv (Neg.neg (HAdd.hAdd ds (HDiv.hDiv db B))) (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
                  (HDiv.hDiv db B))))))
        (HDiv.hDiv
          (Neg.neg
            (HAdd.hAdd
              (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (HAdd.hAdd μ ν) ds)
                (HMul.hMul R (HDiv.hDiv (Neg.neg (HAdd.hAdd ds (HDiv.hDiv db B))) (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)))))
              (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (HAdd.hAdd μ (HMul.hMul γ ν)) db)
                (HDiv.hDiv
                  (HSub.hSub
                    (HMul.hMul
                      (HMul.hMul R (HDiv.hDiv (Neg.neg (HAdd.hAdd ds (HDiv.hDiv db B))) (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1))))
                      B)
                    (HMul.hMul R db))
                  (HPow.hPow B (OfNat.ofNat 2))))))
          (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.deriv_alg.type:
∀ (γ μ ν ds db B R : ℝ),
  B ≠ 0 →
    γ - 1 ≠ 0 →
      R / (γ - 1) *
          (μ * CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ (-(ds + db / B) / (γ - 1)) (-(ds + db / B) / (γ - 1) - db / B) +
            ν * CFDLean.JST1.thermoQt γ (-(ds + db / B) / (γ - 1)) (-(ds + db / B) / (γ - 1) - db / B)) =
        -((μ + ν) * ds * (R * (-(ds + db / B) / (γ - 1))) +
              (μ + γ * ν) * db * ((R * (-(ds + db / B) / (γ - 1)) * B - R * db) / B ^ 2)) /
          (γ - 1)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.exists_jump.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.exists_jump
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.exists_jump.raw_type:
∀ {γ a b c ε : Real},
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ a b) →
      Eq (CFDLean.JST1.thermoQt γ a b) (HMul.hMul c (CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ a b)) →
        LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) ε →
          Exists fun h =>
            And
              (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0)
                (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ γ (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h a))
                  (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h b))))
              (And
                (LT.lt
                  (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQt γ (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h a))
                    (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h b)))
                  (HMul.hMul (HAdd.hAdd c ε)
                    (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ γ (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h a))
                      (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h b)))))
                (LT.lt
                  (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub c ε)
                    (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ γ (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h a))
                      (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h b))))
                  (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQt γ (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h a))
                    (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h b)))))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.exists_jump.type:
∀ {γ a b c ε : ℝ},
  1 < γ →
    0 < CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ a b →
      CFDLean.JST1.thermoQt γ a b = c * CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ a b →
        0 < ε →
          ∃ h,
            0 < CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ γ 1 1 (Real.exp (h * a)) (Real.exp (h * b)) ∧
              CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQt γ 1 1 (Real.exp (h * a)) (Real.exp (h * b)) <
                  (c + ε) * CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ γ 1 1 (Real.exp (h * a)) (Real.exp (h * b)) ∧
                (c - ε) * CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ γ 1 1 (Real.exp (h * a)) (Real.exp (h * b)) <
                  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQt γ 1 1 (Real.exp (h * a)) (Real.exp (h * b))

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.frob_visc.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.frob_visc
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.frob_visc.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (P : CFDLean.JST1.ViscParams) (wb : CFDLean.JST1.State d)
  (G H : Matrix (CFDLean.JST1.Channel d) (Fin d) Real),
  Ne (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thetaF wb) (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
    Eq (CFDLean.Num.frob G (CFDLean.JST1.viscFlux P wb H))
      (HAdd.hAdd
        (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thetaF wb)
          (Finset.univ.sum fun α =>
            Finset.univ.sum fun β =>
              HMul.hMul (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DvF wb G α β) (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF P wb H α β)))
        (HMul.hMul P.κ
          (Finset.univ.sum fun β => HMul.hMul (G CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy β) (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DTF P wb H β))))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.frob_visc.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (P : CFDLean.JST1.ViscParams) (wb : CFDLean.JST1.State d) (G H : Matrix (CFDLean.JST1.Channel d) (Fin d) ℝ),
  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thetaF wb ≠ 0 →
    CFDLean.Num.frob G (CFDLean.JST1.viscFlux P wb H) =
      CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thetaF wb * ∑ α, ∑ β, CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DvF wb G α β * CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF P wb H α β +
        P.κ * ∑ β, G CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy β * CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DTF P wb H β

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.hasDerivAt_pK.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.hasDerivAt_pK
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.hasDerivAt_pK.raw_type:
∀ {γ μ ν s1 ds β1 db t : Real},
  Ne (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)) (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
    LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pβ β1 db t) →
      HasDerivAt (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pK γ μ ν s1 ds β1 db)
        (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pρ γ s1 ds β1 db t) (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
          (HAdd.hAdd
            (HMul.hMul μ
              (CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ
                (HDiv.hDiv (Neg.neg (HAdd.hAdd ds (HDiv.hDiv db (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pβ β1 db t))))
                  (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
                (HSub.hSub
                  (HDiv.hDiv (Neg.neg (HAdd.hAdd ds (HDiv.hDiv db (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pβ β1 db t))))
                    (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
                  (HDiv.hDiv db (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pβ β1 db t)))))
            (HMul.hMul ν
              (CFDLean.JST1.thermoQt γ
                (HDiv.hDiv (Neg.neg (HAdd.hAdd ds (HDiv.hDiv db (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pβ β1 db t))))
                  (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
                (HSub.hSub
                  (HDiv.hDiv (Neg.neg (HAdd.hAdd ds (HDiv.hDiv db (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pβ β1 db t))))
                    (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
                  (HDiv.hDiv db (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pβ β1 db t)))))))
        t
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.hasDerivAt_pK.type:
∀ {γ μ ν s1 ds β1 db t : ℝ},
  γ - 1 ≠ 0 →
    0 < CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pβ β1 db t →
      HasDerivAt (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pK γ μ ν s1 ds β1 db)
        (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pρ γ s1 ds β1 db t / (γ - 1) *
          (μ *
              CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ (-(ds + db / CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pβ β1 db t) / (γ - 1))
                (-(ds + db / CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pβ β1 db t) / (γ - 1) - db / CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pβ β1 db t) +
            ν *
              CFDLean.JST1.thermoQt γ (-(ds + db / CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pβ β1 db t) / (γ - 1))
                (-(ds + db / CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pβ β1 db t) / (γ - 1) - db / CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pβ β1 db t)))
        t

            (HMul.hMul (HAdd.hAdd γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)) (CFDLean.JST1.lamLow γ)))

          (HSub.hSub (HPow.hPow (CFDLean.JST1.lamHigh γ) (OfNat.ofNat 2))

      CFDLean.JST1.lamHigh γ ^ 2 - (γ + 1) * CFDLean.JST1.lamHigh γ + (3 * γ + 1) / 4 = 0

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.mom_sum.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) {Ui Uk : CFDLean.JST1.State d},
  Ne (CFDLean.JST1.rho Ui) (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
    Ne (CFDLean.JST1.rho Uk) (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
      Eq
        (Finset.univ.sum fun α =>
          HMul.hMul
            (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g Uk) (CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g Ui)
              (CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α))
            (HSub.hSub Uk Ui (CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α)))
        (HAdd.hAdd
          (HSub.hSub
            (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.JST1.rho Uk) (CFDLean.JST1.rho Uk)) (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Uk))
              (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel Uk) (CFDLean.JST1.vel Uk)))
            (HMul.hMul
              (HAdd.hAdd
                (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.JST1.rho Uk) (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Uk)) (CFDLean.JST1.rho Ui))
                (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.JST1.rho Ui) (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ui)) (CFDLean.JST1.rho Uk)))
              (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel Uk) (CFDLean.JST1.vel Ui))))
          (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.JST1.rho Ui) (CFDLean.JST1.rho Ui)) (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ui))
            (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel Ui) (CFDLean.JST1.vel Ui))))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.mom_sum.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) {Ui Uk : CFDLean.JST1.State d},
  CFDLean.JST1.rho Ui ≠ 0 →
    CFDLean.JST1.rho Uk ≠ 0 →
      ∑ α,
          (CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g Uk - CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g Ui) (CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α) *
            (Uk - Ui) (CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α) =
        CFDLean.JST1.rho Uk * CFDLean.JST1.rho Uk / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Uk *
              CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel Uk) (CFDLean.JST1.vel Uk) -
            (CFDLean.JST1.rho Uk / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Uk * CFDLean.JST1.rho Ui +
                CFDLean.JST1.rho Ui / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ui * CFDLean.JST1.rho Uk) *
              CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel Uk) (CFDLean.JST1.vel Ui) +
          CFDLean.JST1.rho Ui * CFDLean.JST1.rho Ui / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ui *
            CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel Ui) (CFDLean.JST1.vel Ui)

            (Eq

                (HSub.hSub T.centroid
                  (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (HAdd.hAdd (T.x i) (T.x k)))))

          (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) ∧
            CFDLean.Num.rot90 (T.centroid - (1 / 2) • (T.x i + T.x k)) =

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_smul.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_smul
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_smul.raw_type:

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_smul.type:

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_smul._simp_1_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_smul._simp_1_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_smul._simp_1_1.raw_type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_4} [inst : NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) (a : R),
  Eq (s.sum fun i => HMul.hMul a (f i)) (HMul.hMul a (s.sum fun i => f i))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_smul._simp_1_1.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_4} [inst : NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) (a : R),

∀ {d : Nat} (P : CFDLean.JST1.ViscParams) (wb : CFDLean.JST1.State d) (G : Matrix (CFDLean.JST1.Channel d) (Fin d) Real)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_symm.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (P : CFDLean.JST1.ViscParams) (wb : CFDLean.JST1.State d) (G : Matrix (CFDLean.JST1.Channel d) (Fin d) ℝ)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tau_form.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tau_form
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tau_form.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (D : Fin d → Fin d → Real) (μ : Real),
  Eq
    (Finset.univ.sum fun α =>
      Finset.univ.sum fun β =>
        HMul.hMul (D α β)
          (HSub.hSub (HMul.hMul μ (HAdd.hAdd (D α β) (D β α)))
            (HMul.hMul
              (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 2) (OfNat.ofNat 3)) μ) (Finset.univ.sum fun γ => D γ γ))
              (ite (Eq α β) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))))
    (HMul.hMul μ
      (HSub.hSub (Finset.univ.sum fun α => Finset.univ.sum fun β => HMul.hMul (D α β) (HAdd.hAdd (D α β) (D β α)))
        (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 2) (OfNat.ofNat 3))
          (HPow.hPow (Finset.univ.sum fun γ => D γ γ) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tau_form.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (D : Fin d → Fin d → ℝ) (μ : ℝ),
  ∑ α, ∑ β, D α β * (μ * (D α β + D β α) - (2 / 3 * μ * ∑ γ, D γ γ) * if α = β then 1 else 0) =
    μ * (∑ α, ∑ β, D α β * (D α β + D β α) - 2 / 3 * (∑ γ, D γ γ) ^ 2)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tau_form._simp_1_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tau_form._simp_1_1

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tau_form._simp_1_1.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (x : α), (x ∈ Finset.univ) = True

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tau_form._simp_1_2.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tau_form._simp_1_2
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tau_form._simp_1_2.raw_type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_4} [inst : NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) (a : R),
  Eq (s.sum fun i => HMul.hMul (f i) a) (HMul.hMul (s.sum fun i => f i) a)
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tau_form._simp_1_2.type:

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tendsto_expSlope.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tendsto_expSlope
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tendsto_expSlope.raw_type:
∀ (k : Real),
  Filter.Tendsto (fun h => HDiv.hDiv (HSub.hSub (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h k)) (OfNat.ofNat 1)) h)
    (nhdsWithin (OfNat.ofNat 0) (compl (singleton (OfNat.ofNat 0)))) (nhds k)
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tendsto_expSlope.type: ∀ (k : ℝ), Filter.Tendsto (fun h => (Real.exp (h * k) - 1) / h) (nhdsWithin 0 {0}ᶜ) (nhds k)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ.type: ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ_scaled.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ_scaled
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ_scaled.raw_type:
∀ {γ a b h : Real},
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    Ne h (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
      And
        (Eq
          (HDiv.hDiv
            (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ γ (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h a))
              (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h b)))
            (HPow.hPow h (OfNat.ofNat 2)))
          (HDiv.hDiv
            (Neg.neg
              (HAdd.hAdd
                (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub b (HMul.hMul γ a))
                  (HDiv.hDiv (HSub.hSub (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h a)) (OfNat.ofNat 1)) h))
                (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (HSub.hSub (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h (HSub.hSub a b))) (OfNat.ofNat 1)) h)
                  (HDiv.hDiv (HSub.hSub (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h b)) (OfNat.ofNat 1)) h))))
            (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1))))
        (Eq
          (HDiv.hDiv
            (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQt γ (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h a))
              (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h b)))
            (HPow.hPow h (OfNat.ofNat 2)))
          (HDiv.hDiv
            (Neg.neg
              (HAdd.hAdd
                (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub b (HMul.hMul γ a))
                  (HDiv.hDiv (HSub.hSub (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h a)) (OfNat.ofNat 1)) h))
                (HMul.hMul
                  (HMul.hMul γ (HDiv.hDiv (HSub.hSub (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h (HSub.hSub a b))) (OfNat.ofNat 1)) h))
                  (HDiv.hDiv (HSub.hSub (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h b)) (OfNat.ofNat 1)) h))))
            (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1))))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ_scaled.type:
∀ {γ a b h : ℝ},
  1 < γ →
    h ≠ 0 →
      CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ γ 1 1 (Real.exp (h * a)) (Real.exp (h * b)) / h ^ 2 =
          -((b - γ * a) * ((Real.exp (h * a) - 1) / h) +
                (Real.exp (h * (a - b)) - 1) / h * ((Real.exp (h * b) - 1) / h)) /
            (γ - 1) ∧
        CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQt γ 1 1 (Real.exp (h * a)) (Real.exp (h * b)) / h ^ 2 =
          -((b - γ * a) * ((Real.exp (h * a) - 1) / h) +
                γ * ((Real.exp (h * (a - b)) - 1) / h) * ((Real.exp (h * b) - 1) / h)) /
            (γ - 1)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQt.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQt
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQt.type: ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermoQ_eq.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermoQ_eq
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermoQ_eq.raw_type:
∀ (γ a b : Real),
  Eq (CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ a b)
    (HAdd.hAdd (HPow.hPow (HSub.hSub b a) (OfNat.ofNat 2))
      (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)) (HPow.hPow a (OfNat.ofNat 2))))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermoQ_eq.type: ∀ (γ a b : ℝ), CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ a b = (b - a) ^ 2 + (γ - 1) * a ^ 2

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermoQ_nonneg.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermoQ_nonneg
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermoQ_nonneg.raw_type: ∀ {γ : Real}, LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ → ∀ (a b : Real), LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) (CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ a b)
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermoQ_nonneg.type: ∀ {γ : ℝ}, 1 < γ → ∀ (a b : ℝ), 0 ≤ CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ a b

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermoQ_pos.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermoQ_pos
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermoQ_pos.raw_type:
∀ {γ : Real},
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    ∀ {a : Real}, Ne a (OfNat.ofNat 0) → ∀ (b : Real), LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ a b)
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermoQ_pos.type: ∀ {γ : ℝ}, 1 < γ → ∀ {a : ℝ}, a ≠ 0 → ∀ (b : ℝ), 0 < CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ a b

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermo_path.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermo_path
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermo_path.raw_type:
∀ {γ μ ν : Real},
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    (∀ (a b : Real),
        LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0)
          (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul μ (CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ a b)) (HMul.hMul ν (CFDLean.JST1.thermoQt γ a b)))) →
      ∀ {r1 p1 r2 p2 : Real},
        LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) r1 →
          LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) p1 →
            LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) r2 →
              LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) p2 →
                LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0)
                  (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul μ (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ γ r1 p1 r2 p2))
                    (HMul.hMul ν (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQt γ r1 p1 r2 p2)))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermo_path.type:
∀ {γ μ ν : ℝ},
  1 < γ →
    (∀ (a b : ℝ), 0 ≤ μ * CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ a b + ν * CFDLean.JST1.thermoQt γ a b) →
      ∀ {r1 p1 r2 p2 : ℝ},
        0 < r1 →
          0 < p1 →
            0 < r2 → 0 < p2 → 0 ≤ μ * CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ γ r1 p1 r2 p2 + ν * CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQt γ r1 p1 r2 p2

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vF.type: {d : ℕ} → CFDLean.JST1.State d → Fin d → ℝ

            (CFDLean.Num.dot v (HSub.hSub (T.x a) (T.x (OfNat.ofNat 0))))) →
        Eq u v

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vec_expand.type:

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV.eq_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV.eq_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (Ui Uk : CFDLean.JST1.State d),
  Eq (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV g Ui Uk)
    (HDiv.hDiv
      (HMul.hMul
        (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.JST1.rho Uk) (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Uk)) (CFDLean.JST1.rho Ui))
          (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.JST1.rho Ui) (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ui)) (CFDLean.JST1.rho Uk)))
        (Finset.univ.sum fun α =>
          HPow.hPow (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.JST1.vel Uk α) (CFDLean.JST1.vel Ui α)) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))
      (OfNat.ofNat 2))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV.eq_1.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (Ui Uk : CFDLean.JST1.State d),
  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV g Ui Uk =
    ((CFDLean.JST1.rho Uk / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Uk * CFDLean.JST1.rho Ui +
          CFDLean.JST1.rho Ui / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ui * CFDLean.JST1.rho Uk) *
        ∑ α, (CFDLean.JST1.vel Uk α - CFDLean.JST1.vel Ui α) ^ 2) /
      2

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV_nonneg.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV_nonneg

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV_nonneg.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) {Ui Uk : CFDLean.JST1.State d},

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV_rest.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (r1 p1 r2 p2 : ℝ),

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vel_rest.raw_type:

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vel_sum.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vel_sum

              (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.JST1.rho U) (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U)).sqrt))
          (Eq (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U)
            (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.JST1.rho U) (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U)).sqrt
              (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.JST1.rho U) (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U)).sqrt))))

  (i : V),
  Eq (CFDLean.JST1.Spec.fourthOp adj isWall u i)
    (Finset.univ.sum fun k =>
      ite (And (adj i k) (Eq (isWall i) (isWall k)))
        (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.JST1.Spec.lapStar adj isWall u k) (CFDLean.JST1.Spec.lapStar adj isWall u i))

CFDLean.JST1.Spec.fourthOp.eq_1.type:

  (i : V),

    ∑ k,

      (HAdd.hAdd (Finset.univ.sum fun α => HMul.hMul (CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.tau D β α) (D.v α))

CFDLean.JST1.Wall.PiW.eq_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.Wall.PiW.eq_1
CFDLean.JST1.Wall.PiW.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] {d : Nat} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d)
  (K : Matrix κ (Fin d) Real → Matrix κ (Fin d) Real) (P : Matrix κ κ Real) (gw : κ → Real)
  (walls : Finset (Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1)))) (c : Real) (w : Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1)) → κ → Real),
  Eq (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.PiW T K P gw walls c w)
    (walls.sum fun o =>
      HSub.hSub
        (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.area T o) d.cast))
          ((Finset.univ.erase o).sum fun a =>
            CFDLean.Num.pairF (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.eW P gw w a)
              ((K (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.gradT T w)).mulVec (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.normal T o))))
        (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.sigmaF T walls c o) (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.Xf T K P gw w o)))
CFDLean.JST1.Wall.PiW.eq_1.type:
∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] {d : ℕ} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d) (K : Matrix κ (Fin d) ℝ → Matrix κ (Fin d) ℝ)
  (P : Matrix κ κ ℝ) (gw : κ → ℝ) (walls : Finset (Fin (d + 1))) (c : ℝ) (w : Fin (d + 1) → κ → ℝ),
  CFDLean.JST1.Wall.PiW T K P gw walls c w =
    ∑ o ∈ walls,
      (2 * (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.area T o / ↑d) *
          ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.erase o,
            CFDLean.Num.pairF (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.eW P gw w a)
              ((K (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.gradT T w)).mulVec (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.normal T o)) -
        CFDLean.JST1.Wall.sigmaF T walls c o * CFDLean.JST1.Wall.Xf T K P gw w o)

∀ {ι : Type} {d : Nat} (vb : ι → ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (cb : ι → ι → Real) (e : ι → ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d)
  (Lam : ι → Real) (a : Real) (n' : ι → ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (i k : ι),
  Eq (CFDLean.JST1.coefOn vb cb e Lam a n' i k)
    (HMul.hMul
      (CFDLean.JST1.phiF (CFDLean.JST1.psiF (Lam i) (CFDLean.JST1.lamHat (vb i k) (cb i k) (e i k) (n' i k)) a)

CFDLean.JST1.coefOn.eq_1.type:
∀ {ι : Type} {d : ℕ} (vb : ι → ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (cb : ι → ι → ℝ) (e : ι → ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (Lam : ι → ℝ)
  (a : ℝ) (n' : ι → ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (i k : ι),
  CFDLean.JST1.coefOn vb cb e Lam a n' i k =
    CFDLean.JST1.phiF (CFDLean.JST1.psiF (Lam i) (CFDLean.JST1.lamHat (vb i k) (cb i k) (e i k) (n' i k)) a)

CFDLean.JST1.ismailRoe.eq_1.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (Ua Ub : CFDLean.JST1.State d) (y : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.JST1.ismailRoe g Ua Ub y = fun c =>
    match c with
    | CFDLean.JST1.Channel.mass =>
      (√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) + √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) / 2 *
          CFDLean.Num.logMean √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua)
            √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub) *
        CFDLean.Num.dot
          (fun α =>
            (√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) * CFDLean.JST1.vel Ua α +
                  √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub) * CFDLean.JST1.vel Ub α) /
                2 /
              ((√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) +
                  √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) /
                2))
          y
    | CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α =>
      (√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) + √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) / 2 *
              CFDLean.Num.logMean √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua)
                √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub) *
            (fun α =>
                (√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) * CFDLean.JST1.vel Ua α +
                      √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub) * CFDLean.JST1.vel Ub α) /
                    2 /
                  ((√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) +
                      √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) /
                    2))
              α *
          CFDLean.Num.dot
            (fun α =>
              (√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) * CFDLean.JST1.vel Ua α +
                    √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub) * CFDLean.JST1.vel Ub α) /
                  2 /
                ((√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) +
                    √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) /
                  2))
            y +
        (√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) + √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) /
              2 /
            ((√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) +
                √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) /
              2) *
          y α
    | CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy =>
      (√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) + √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) / 2 *
            CFDLean.Num.logMean √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua)
              √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub) *
          (g.γ *
                ((g.γ + 1) / (2 * g.γ) *
                    (CFDLean.Num.logMean √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua)
                        √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub) /
                      CFDLean.Num.logMean √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua)
                        √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) +
                  (g.γ - 1) / (2 * g.γ) *
                    ((√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) +
                          √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) /
                        2 /
                      ((√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) +
                          √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) /
                        2))) /
              ((√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) +
                      √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) /
                    2 *
                  CFDLean.Num.logMean √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua)
                    √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub) *
                (g.γ - 1)) +
            (CFDLean.Num.dot
                (fun α =>
                  (√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) * CFDLean.JST1.vel Ua α +
                        √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub) * CFDLean.JST1.vel Ub α) /
                      2 /
                    ((√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) +
                        √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) /
                      2))
                fun α =>
                (√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) * CFDLean.JST1.vel Ua α +
                      √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub) * CFDLean.JST1.vel Ub α) /
                    2 /
                  ((√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) +
                      √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) /
                    2)) /
              2) *
        CFDLean.Num.dot
          (fun α =>
            (√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) * CFDLean.JST1.vel Ua α +
                  √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub) * CFDLean.JST1.vel Ub α) /
                2 /
              ((√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) +
                  √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) /
                2))
          y

    (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub g.γ (OfNat.ofNat 1))
      (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.JST1.energy U)
        (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.mom U) (CFDLean.JST1.mom U))
          (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) (CFDLean.JST1.rho U)))))

    (g.γ - 1) *
      (CFDLean.JST1.energy U - CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.mom U) (CFDLean.JST1.mom U) / (2 * CFDLean.JST1.rho U))

∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a b : Fin n),
  Eq (M.IsEdge a b)
    (And (LT.lt a b) (Exists fun t => And (Membership.mem (M.cellNodes t) a) (Membership.mem (M.cellNodes t) b)))
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.IsEdge.eq_1.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a b : Fin n),
  M.IsEdge a b = (a < b ∧ ∃ t, a ∈ M.cellNodes t ∧ b ∈ M.cellNodes t)

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.Occurrence.type: {n m : ℕ} → CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m → Type

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.Used.type: {n m : ℕ} → CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m → Fin n → Prop

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData._sizeOf_1.type: {n m : ℕ} → CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m → ℕ

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.all_patches_.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.all_patches_boundary
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.all_patches_.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m),
  M.Conforming →
    ∀ (i : Fin n),
      Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun a => M.ownedPatch a i)
        (Finset.univ.sum fun b => ite (Eq b.val.2 i) (M.boundaryArea b) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.all_patches_.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m),
  M.Conforming → ∀ (i : Fin n), ∑ a, M.ownedPatch a i = ∑ b, if (↑b).2 = i then M.boundaryArea b else 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.all_patches_.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.all_patches_boundary._proof_1_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.all_patches_.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : M.Occurrence),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (M.faceCount (M.faceID a)) →
    LE.le (M.faceCount (M.faceID a)) (OfNat.ofNat 2) →
      Not (Or (Eq (M.faceCount (M.faceID a)) (OfNat.ofNat 1)) (Eq (M.faceCount (M.faceID a)) (OfNat.ofNat 2))) → False
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.all_patches_.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : M.Occurrence),
  0 < M.faceCount (M.faceID a) →
    M.faceCount (M.faceID a) ≤ 2 → ¬(M.faceCount (M.faceID a) = 1 ∨ M.faceCount (M.faceID a) = 2) → False

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.all_patches_.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.all_patches_local
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.all_patches_.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : Fin n),
  Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun o => M.ownedPatch o a)
    (Finset.univ.sum fun t =>
      Finset.univ.sum fun i =>
        ite (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vertex t) i) a)
          (Finset.univ.sum fun j => CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch (M.points t) j i) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.all_patches_.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : Fin n),
  ∑ o, M.ownedPatch o a =
    ∑ t, ∑ i, if (M.vertex t) i = a then ∑ j, CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch (M.points t) j i else 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledAre.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledArea
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledAre.type: {n m : ℕ} → CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m → Fin n → Fin n → CFDLean.Vector 3

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledAre.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledArea.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledAre.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a b : Fin n),
  Eq (M.assembledArea a b)
    (Finset.univ.sum fun t =>
      Finset.univ.sum fun i =>
        Finset.univ.sum fun j =>
          ite (And (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vertex t) i) a) (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vertex t) j) b))
            (CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface (M.points t) i j) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledAre.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a b : Fin n),
  M.assembledArea a b =
    ∑ t,
      ∑ i,
        ∑ j, if (M.vertex t) i = a ∧ (M.vertex t) j = b then CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface (M.points t) i j else 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledAre.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledArea_reverse
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledAre.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a b : Fin n),
  Eq (M.assembledArea b a) (Neg.neg (M.assembledArea a b))
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledAre.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a b : Fin n), M.assembledArea b a = -M.assembledArea a b

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledAre.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledArea_reverse._simp_1_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledAre.raw_type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {G : Type u_5} {s : Finset ι} [inst : SubtractionCommMonoid G] (f : ι → G),
  Eq (Neg.neg (s.sum fun x => f x)) (s.sum fun x => Neg.neg (f x))
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledAre.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {G : Type u_5} {s : Finset ι} [inst : SubtractionCommMonoid G] (f : ι → G),
  -∑ x ∈ s, f x = ∑ x ∈ s, -f x

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledAre.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledArea_row
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledAre.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : Fin n),
  Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun b => M.assembledArea a b)
    (Finset.univ.sum fun t =>
      Finset.univ.sum fun i =>
        ite (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vertex t) i) a)
          (Finset.univ.sum fun j => CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface (M.points t) i j) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledAre.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : Fin n),
  ∑ b, M.assembledArea a b =
    ∑ t, ∑ i, if (M.vertex t) i = a then ∑ j, CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface (M.points t) i j else 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledAre.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledArea_self
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledAre.raw_type: ∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : Fin n), Eq (M.assembledArea a a) (OfNat.ofNat 0)
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledAre.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : Fin n), M.assembledArea a a = 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledAre.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledArea_support
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledAre.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a b : Fin n),
  Not (Exists fun t => And (Membership.mem (M.cellNodes t) a) (Membership.mem (M.cellNodes t) b)) →
    Eq (M.assembledArea a b) (OfNat.ofNat 0)
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledAre.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a b : Fin n),
  (¬∃ t, a ∈ M.cellNodes t ∧ b ∈ M.cellNodes t) → M.assembledArea a b = 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.baseNode.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.baseNode
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.baseNode.type: {n m : ℕ} → (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) → M.Occurrence → Fin n

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.baseNode.eq_.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.baseNode.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.baseNode.eq_.raw_type:

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.baseNode.eq_.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : M.Occurrence), M.baseNode a = (M.vertex a.1) (a.2.succAbove 0)

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.baseNode_mem.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.baseNode_mem
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.baseNode_mem.raw_type: ∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : M.Occurrence), Membership.mem (M.faceID a) (M.baseNode a)
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.baseNode_mem.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : M.Occurrence), M.baseNode a ∈ M.faceID a

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryArea.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryArea
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryArea.type: {n m : ℕ} → (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) → M.Boundary → CFDLean.Vector 3

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryArea.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryArea.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryArea.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (b : M.Boundary),
  Eq (M.boundaryArea b) (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (M.faceArea b.val.1))
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryArea.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (b : M.Boundary), M.boundaryArea b = (1 / 3) • M.faceArea (↑b).1

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryKey.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryKey
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryKey.type: {n m : ℕ} → (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) → M.Boundary → Finset (Fin n) × Fin n

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryKey..name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryKey.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryKey..raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (b : M.Boundary),
  Eq (M.boundaryKey b) (Prod.mk (M.faceID b.val.1) b.val.2)
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryKey..type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (b : M.Boundary), M.boundaryKey b = (M.faceID (↑b).1, (↑b).2)

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryKey_.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryKey_injective
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryKey_.raw_type: ∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m), Function.Injective M.boundaryKey
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryKey_.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m), Function.Injective M.boundaryKey

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryKey_.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryKey_range
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryKey_.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (F : Finset (Fin n)) (i : Fin n),
  Iff (Exists fun b => Eq (M.boundaryKey b) (Prod.mk F i))
    (And (Eq (M.faceCount F) (OfNat.ofNat 1)) (Membership.mem F i))
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryKey_.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (F : Finset (Fin n)) (i : Fin n),
  (∃ b, M.boundaryKey b = (F, i)) ↔ M.faceCount F = 1 ∧ i ∈ F

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryKey_.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryKey_range._proof_1_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryKey_.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (F : Finset (Fin n)),
  Eq (M.faceCount F) (OfNat.ofNat 1) → Not (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (M.faceCount F)) → False
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryKey_.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (F : Finset (Fin n)), M.faceCount F = 1 → ¬0 < M.faceCount F → False

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundary_sum.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundary_sum
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundary_sum.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (i : Fin n),
  Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun b => ite (Eq b.val.2 i) (M.boundaryArea b) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
    (Finset.univ.sum fun a => ite (Eq (M.faceCount (M.faceID a)) (OfNat.ofNat 1)) (M.ownedPatch a i) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundary_sum.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (i : Fin n),
  (∑ b, if (↑b).2 = i then M.boundaryArea b else 0) = ∑ a, if M.faceCount (M.faceID a) = 1 then M.ownedPatch a i else 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.casesOn.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.casesOn
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.casesOn.type:
{n m : ℕ} →
  {motive : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m → Sort u} →
    (t : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) →
      ((position : Fin n → CFDLean.Vector 3) →
          (vertex : Fin m → Fin 4 ↪ Fin n) →
            (positive : ∀ (t : Fin m), 0 < CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume fun i => position ((vertex t) i)) →
              motive { position := position, vertex := vertex, positive := positive }) →
        motive t

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.cellNodes.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.cellNodes
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.cellNodes.type: {n m : ℕ} → CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m → Fin m → Finset (Fin n)

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.cellNodes.eq.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.cellNodes.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.cellNodes.eq.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (t : Fin m),

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.cellNodes.eq.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (t : Fin m), M.cellNodes t = Finset.map (M.vertex t) Finset.univ

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.cellNodes_ca.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.cellNodes_card
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.cellNodes_ca.raw_type: ∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (t : Fin m), Eq (M.cellNodes t).card (OfNat.ofNat 4)
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.cellNodes_ca.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (t : Fin m), (M.cellNodes t).card = 4

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.cellVolume_p.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.cellVolume_pos
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.cellVolume_p.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (t : Fin m),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (CFDLean.MedianDual.volume (M.points t))
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.cellVolume_p.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (t : Fin m), 0 < CFDLean.MedianDual.volume (M.points t)

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.constant_sta.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.constant_state
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.constant_sta.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m),
  M.Conforming →
    ∀ (γ : Real) (U : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (a : Fin n),
      Eq
        (CFDLean.Assembly.residual M.interfaces (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer M.interfaces γ (fun x => U) M.edgeArea)
          (fun b => DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (M.boundaryArea b)) a)
        (OfNat.ofNat 0)
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.constant_sta.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m),
  M.Conforming →
    ∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (a : Fin n),
      CFDLean.Assembly.residual M.interfaces (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer M.interfaces γ (fun x => U) M.edgeArea)
          (fun b => (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (M.boundaryArea b)) a =
        0

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.ctorIdx.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.ctorIdx
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.ctorIdx.type: {n m : ℕ} → CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m → ℕ

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.dualVolume.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.dualVolume
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.dualVolume.type: {n m : ℕ} → CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m → Fin n → ℝ

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.dualVolume_f.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.dualVolume_formula
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.dualVolume_f.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : Fin n),
  Eq (M.dualVolume a)
    (Finset.univ.sum fun t =>
      ite (Membership.mem (M.cellNodes t) a) (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.MedianDual.volume (M.points t)) (OfNat.ofNat 4))
        (OfNat.ofNat 0))
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.dualVolume_f.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : Fin n),
  M.dualVolume a = ∑ t, if a ∈ M.cellNodes t then CFDLean.MedianDual.volume (M.points t) / 4 else 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.dualVolume_p.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.dualVolume_pos
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.dualVolume_p.raw_type: ∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : Fin n), M.Used a → LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (M.dualVolume a)
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.dualVolume_p.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : Fin n), M.Used a → 0 < M.dualVolume a

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.dualVolume_u.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.dualVolume_unused
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.dualVolume_u.raw_type: ∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : Fin n), Not (M.Used a) → Eq (M.dualVolume a) (OfNat.ofNat 0)
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.dualVolume_u.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : Fin n), ¬M.Used a → M.dualVolume a = 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.edgeArea.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.edgeArea
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.edgeArea.type: {n m : ℕ} → (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) → M.Edge → CFDLean.Vector 3

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.edge_inciden.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.edge_incidence_sum
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.edge_inciden.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : Fin n),
  Eq
    (Finset.univ.sum fun e =>
      HSMul.hSMul
        (HSub.hSub (ite (Eq e.val.1 a) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
          (ite (Eq e.val.2 a) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
        (M.edgeArea e))
    (Finset.univ.sum fun b => M.assembledArea a b)
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.edge_inciden.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : Fin n),
  ∑ e, ((if (↑e).1 = a then 1 else 0) - if (↑e).2 = a then 1 else 0) • M.edgeArea e = ∑ b, M.assembledArea a b

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.eq_or_neg_sy.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.eq_or_neg_symm
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.eq_or_neg_sy.raw_type: ∀ {a b : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)}, Or (Eq a b) (Eq a (Neg.neg b)) → Or (Eq b a) (Eq b (Neg.neg a))
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.eq_or_neg_sy.type: ∀ {a b : CFDLean.Vector 3}, a = b ∨ a = -b → b = a ∨ b = -a

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.eq_or_neg_tr.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.eq_or_neg_trans
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.eq_or_neg_tr.raw_type:
∀ {a b c : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)},
  Or (Eq a b) (Eq a (Neg.neg b)) → Or (Eq b c) (Eq b (Neg.neg c)) → Or (Eq a c) (Eq a (Neg.neg c))
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.eq_or_neg_tr.type: ∀ {a b c : CFDLean.Vector 3}, a = b ∨ a = -b → b = c ∨ b = -c → a = c ∨ a = -c

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceArea.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceArea
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceArea.type: {n m : ℕ} → (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) → M.Occurrence → CFDLean.Vector 3

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceArea.eq_.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceArea.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceArea.eq_.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : M.Occurrence),
  Eq (M.faceArea a) (CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector (M.points a.1) a.2)
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceArea.eq_.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (a : M.Occurrence),

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.triangle_sam.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.triangle_same_nodes
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.triangle_sam.raw_type:

  Eq (insert d (insert e (singleton f))) (insert a (insert b (singleton c))) →
    And (Ne d e) (And (Ne d f) (Ne e f)) →
      Or (Eq (CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (x d) (x e) (x f)) (CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (x a) (x b) (x c)))
        (Eq (CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (x d) (x e) (x f)) (Neg.neg (CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (x a) (x b) (x c))))
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.triangle_sam.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → CFDLean.Vector 3) (a b c d e f : Fin n),
  {d, e, f} = {a, b, c} →
    d ≠ e ∧ d ≠ f ∧ e ≠ f →
      CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (x d) (x e) (x f) = CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (x a) (x b) (x c) ∨
        CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (x d) (x e) (x f) = -CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (x a) (x b) (x c)

CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.averag.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.averages
CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.averag.raw_type:
And
  (Eq (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot)
    (OfNat.ofNat 0))
  (And
    (Eq
      (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy (OfNat.ofNat 2) CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold
        CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot)
      (OfNat.ofNat 5))
    (Eq
      (CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed (OfNat.ofNat 2) CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold
        CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot)
      (Real.sqrt (OfNat.ofNat 5))))
CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.averag.type:
CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot = 0 ∧
  CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy 2 CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot = 5 ∧
    CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed 2 CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot = √5

CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.dissip.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.dissipation_mass
CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.dissip.raw_type:
∀ (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.dot n n) (OfNat.ofNat 1) →
    Eq
      (DFunLike.coe
        (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation (OfNat.ofNat 2) CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold
          CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot n)
        CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.jump ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
      (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 3) (Real.sqrt (OfNat.ofNat 5))) (OfNat.ofNat 5))
CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.dissip.type:
∀ (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation 2 CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot n)
        CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.jump 0 =
      3 * √5 / 5

CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.mass_f.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.mass_formula
CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.mass_f.raw_type:
∀ (S : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Ne S (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
    Eq
      (CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates (OfNat.ofNat 2) CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold
        CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot S ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
      (HDiv.hDiv
        (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (Neg.neg (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (Real.sqrt (OfNat.ofNat 5))) (CFDLean.Coordinates.area S))
        (OfNat.ofNat 10))
CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.mass_f.type:
∀ (S : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  S ≠ 0 →
    CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates 2 CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot S 0 =
      -3 * √5 * CFDLean.Coordinates.area S / 10

CFDLean.MedianDual.barycentric_determina.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.barycentric_determinant
CFDLean.MedianDual.barycentric_determina.raw_type:
∀ (a b c d : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq
    (CFDLean.MedianDual.determinant
      (HSub.hSub (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (HAdd.hAdd a b)) a)
      (HSub.hSub (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd a b) c)) a)
      (HSub.hSub (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 4)) (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd a b) c) d))
        a))
    (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.MedianDual.determinant (HSub.hSub b a) (HSub.hSub c a) (HSub.hSub d a)) (OfNat.ofNat 24))
CFDLean.MedianDual.barycentric_determina.type:
∀ (a b c d : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.determinant ((1 / 2) • (a + b) - a) ((1 / 3) • (a + b + c) - a) ((1 / 4) • (a + b + c + d) - a) =
    CFDLean.MedianDual.determinant (b - a) (c - a) (d - a) / 24

CFDLean.MedianDual.barycentric_triangle_.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.barycentric_triangle_dot
CFDLean.MedianDual.barycentric_triangle_.raw_type:
∀ (a b c d : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),

    (CFDLean.dot
      (CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (HAdd.hAdd a b))
        (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd a b) c))
        (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 4)) (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd a b) c) d)))
      (HSub.hSub b a))
    (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.MedianDual.determinant (HSub.hSub b a) (HSub.hSub c a) (HSub.hSub d a)) (OfNat.ofNat 24))
CFDLean.MedianDual.barycentric_triangle_.type:
∀ (a b c d : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle ((1 / 2) • (a + b)) ((1 / 3) • (a + b + c)) ((1 / 4) • (a + b + c + d)))
      (b - a) =
    CFDLean.MedianDual.determinant (b - a) (c - a) (d - a) / 24

CFDLean.MedianDual.cross.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.cross.eq_1

        (HSub.hSub (HMul.hMul (a ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (b ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
          (HMul.hMul (a ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (b ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
        (Matrix.vecCons
          (HSub.hSub (HMul.hMul (a ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (b ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
            (HMul.hMul (a ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (b ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
          Matrix.vecEmpty)))
CFDLean.MedianDual.cross.eq_1.type:
∀ (a b : CFDLean.Vector 3),

CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),

CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector_opposite_d.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector_opposite_dot

CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector_triangle_o.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector_triangle_or_neg

        (p (i.succAbove ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩))))
    (Eq (CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector p i)
      (Neg.neg
        (CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (p (i.succAbove ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)) (p (i.succAbove ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
          (p (i.succAbove ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))))
CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector_triangle_o.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i : Fin 4),

      CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (p (i.succAbove 0)) (p (i.succAbove 1)) (p (i.succAbove 2)) ∨

CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary.eq_1.raw_type:

      (CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector (CFDLean.MedianDual.flagPoints p i j k l) r))
CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary.eq_1.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l r : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p i j k l r =
    CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j k l • CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector (CFDLean.MedianDual.flagPoints p i j k l) r

CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary_sum.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary_sum
CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary_sum.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun r => CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p i j k l r) (OfNat.ofNat 0)
CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary_sum.type: ∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin 4), ∑ r, CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p i j k l r = 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary_sum._sim.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary_sum._simp_1_2
CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary_sum._sim.raw_type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} {N : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} [inst : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_1 : DistribSMul M N] {r : M} {f : γ → N}
  {s : Finset γ}, Eq (s.sum fun x => HSMul.hSMul r (f x)) (HSMul.hSMul r (s.sum fun x => f x))
CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary_sum._sim.type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} {N : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} [inst : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_1 : DistribSMul M N] {r : M} {f : γ → N}
  {s : Finset γ}, ∑ x ∈ s, r • f x = r • ∑ x ∈ s, f x

CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary_three.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary_three
CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary_three.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  Eq (CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p i j k l ⟨3, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
    (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j k l)
      (Neg.neg
        (CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (p i) (CFDLean.MedianDual.midpoint p i j)
          (CFDLean.MedianDual.faceCenter p i j k))))
CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary_three.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p i j k l 3 =
    CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j k l •
      -CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (p i) (CFDLean.MedianDual.midpoint p i j) (CFDLean.MedianDual.faceCenter p i j k)

CFDLean.MedianDual.flagPoints.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.flagPoints
CFDLean.MedianDual.flagPoints.type: CFDLean.MedianDual.Points → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → CFDLean.MedianDual.Points

CFDLean.MedianDual.flag_boundaries_ident.raw_type:

    (Finset.univ.sum fun f =>
      Finset.univ.sum fun r => CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p i f.val.1 f.val.2.1 f.val.2.2 r)
    (CFDLean.MedianDual.localHullVector p i)
CFDLean.MedianDual.flag_boundaries_ident.type:

CFDLean.MedianDual.flag_determinant.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.flag_determinant
CFDLean.MedianDual.flag_determinant.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l →
    Eq (CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume (CFDLean.MedianDual.flagPoints p i j k l))
      (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j k l) (CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume p)) (OfNat.ofNat 24))
CFDLean.MedianDual.flag_determinant.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l →
    CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume (CFDLean.MedianDual.flagPoints p i j k l) =
      CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j k l * CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume p / 24

CFDLean.MedianDual.flag_volume.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.flag_volume
CFDLean.MedianDual.flag_volume.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l →
    Eq (CFDLean.MedianDual.volume (CFDLean.MedianDual.flagPoints p i j k l))
      (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.MedianDual.volume p) (OfNat.ofNat 24))
CFDLean.MedianDual.flag_volume.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l →
    CFDLean.MedianDual.volume (CFDLean.MedianDual.flagPoints p i j k l) = CFDLean.MedianDual.volume p / 24

CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (i j k l : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  Eq (CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j k l)
    (HPow.hPow (Neg.neg (OfNat.ofNat 1))
      (HAdd.hAdd
        (HAdd.hAdd
          (HAdd.hAdd
            (HAdd.hAdd
              (HAdd.hAdd (ite (GT.gt i.val j.val) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
                (ite (GT.gt i.val k.val) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
              (ite (GT.gt i.val l.val) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
            (ite (GT.gt j.val k.val) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
          (ite (GT.gt j.val l.val) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
        (ite (GT.gt k.val l.val) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0))))
CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign.eq_1.type:
∀ (i j k l : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j k l =
    (-1) ^
      ((((((if ↑i > ↑j then 1 else 0) + if ↑i > ↑k then 1 else 0) + if ↑i > ↑l then 1 else 0) +
            if ↑j > ↑k then 1 else 0) +
          if ↑j > ↑l then 1 else 0) +
        if ↑k > ↑l then 1 else 0)

CFDLean.MedianDual.instDecidableValid._p.type:
∀ (i j k l : Fin 4),

CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),

∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j : Fin 4),

CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface_eq.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface_eq
CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface_eq.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),

    (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 12))

∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface p i j =
    (1 / 12) • (CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector p i - CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector p j)

CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (opp owner : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  Eq (CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch p opp owner)
    (Finset.univ.sum fun j =>
      Finset.univ.sum fun k =>
        ite (CFDLean.MedianDual.valid owner j k opp)
          (CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p owner j k opp ⟨3, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (OfNat.ofNat 0))

∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (opp owner : Fin 4),

CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch_eq.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch_eq

CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch_eq.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (opp owner : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch p opp owner = if ↑owner = ↑opp then 0 else (1 / 3) • CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector p opp

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11.B_bd.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11.B_bd
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11.B_bd.raw_type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : Nat} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (bd : Prod C (Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1))) → Bool),
  M.FacetBalanced bd →
    LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 1) d →
      ∀ (i k : ι),
        Eq (M.B i k)
          (Finset.univ.sum fun p =>
            ite (And (Eq (bd p) true) (And (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) i) (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) k)))
              (HSMul.hSMul
                (HDiv.hDiv (HAdd.hAdd (OfNat.ofNat 1) (ite (Eq i k) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
                  (HMul.hMul d.cast (HAdd.hAdd d.cast (OfNat.ofNat 1))))
                (M.areaVec p))
              (OfNat.ofNat 0))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11.B_bd.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (bd : C × Fin (d + 1) → Bool),
  M.FacetBalanced bd →
    1 ≤ d →
      ∀ (i k : ι),
        M.B i k =
          ∑ p,
            if bd p = true ∧ i ∈ M.facetNodes p ∧ k ∈ M.facetNodes p then
              ((1 + if i = k then 1 else 0) / (↑d * (↑d + 1))) • M.areaVec p
            else 0

    LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 1) d →
      ∀ (i : ι),
        Eq (M.beta i)

            ite (And (Eq (bd p) true) (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) i))
              (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) d.cast) (M.areaVec p)) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11.beta_bd.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)

  M.FacetBalanced bd →
    1 ≤ d → ∀ (i : ι), M.beta i = ∑ p, if bd p = true ∧ i ∈ M.facetNodes p then (1 / ↑d) • M.areaVec p else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.facetVec_sid.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.facetVec_side
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.facetVec_sid.raw_type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : LinearOrder ι] [inst_3 : Fintype C]
  (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  M.Valid →
    ∀ (p : Prod C (Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4))) (i0 i1 i2 : ι),
      Eq ((M.facetNodes p).sort fun x1 x2 => LE.le x1 x2) (List.cons i0 (List.cons i1 (List.cons i2 List.nil))) →
        Eq (M.facetVec p)
          (HSMul.hSMul (HMul.hMul (Neg.neg (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2))) (CFDLean.Num.facetSide M p))
            (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (HSub.hSub (M.pos i1) (M.pos i0)) (HSub.hSub (M.pos i2) (M.pos i0))))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.facetVec_sid.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : LinearOrder ι] [inst_3 : Fintype C]
  (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C 3),
  M.Valid →
    ∀ (p : C × Fin 4) (i0 i1 i2 : ι),
      ((M.facetNodes p).sort fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2) = [i0, i1, i2] →
        M.facetVec p =
          (-(1 / 2) * CFDLean.Num.facetSide M p) • CFDLean.Num.cross3 (M.pos i1 - M.pos i0) (M.pos i2 - M.pos i0)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.facetVec_sid.raw_type:

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.facetVec_sid.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : LinearOrder ι] [inst_3 : Fintype C]
  (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C 2),

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.facet_perp.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.facet_perp
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.facet_perp.raw_type:
∀ (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (o a b : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  T.Nondeg →
    (List.cons o (List.cons a (List.cons b List.nil))).Nodup →
      Eq (T.facet o)
        (HSMul.hSMul
          (ite
            (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0)
              (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.perp2 (HSub.hSub (T.x b) (T.x a))) (HSub.hSub (T.x o) (T.x a))))
            (Neg.neg (OfNat.ofNat 1)) (OfNat.ofNat 1))
          (CFDLean.Num.perp2 (HSub.hSub (T.x b) (T.x a))))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.facet_perp.type:
∀ (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex 2) (o a b : Fin 3),
  T.Nondeg →
    [o, a, b].Nodup →
      T.facet o =
        (if 0 < CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.perp2 (T.x b - T.x a)) (T.x o - T.x a) then -1 else 1) •
          CFDLean.Num.perp2 (T.x b - T.x a)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Avg11b.triple_perm2.raw_type:

    Or
      (Eq (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.perp2 (HSub.hSub (p b) (p a))) (HSub.hSub (p o) (p a)))
        (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.perp2 (HSub.hSub (p ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (p ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
          (HSub.hSub (p ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (p ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩))))
      (Eq (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.perp2 (HSub.hSub (p b) (p a))) (HSub.hSub (p o) (p a)))
        (Neg.neg
          (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.perp2 (HSub.hSub (p ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (p ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
            (HSub.hSub (p ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (p ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))))

        CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.perp2 (p 1 - p 0)) (p 2 - p 0) ∨
      CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.perp2 (p b - p a)) (p o - p a) =

  (i k : ι),
  Eq (M.B i k)
    (Finset.univ.sum fun T =>
      Finset.univ.sum fun a =>
        Finset.univ.sum fun b =>
          ite (And (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) a) i) (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) b) k))
            (HSMul.hSMul (M.ω T) (HSMul.hSMul (M.m T) (HAdd.hAdd (M.g T a) (M.g T b)))) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.B_eq.type:

  M.B i k = ∑ T, ∑ a, ∑ b, if (M.vert T) a = i ∧ (M.vert T) b = k then M.ω T • M.m T • (M.g T a + M.g T b) else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.cell_identi.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.cell_identity
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.cell_identi.raw_type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [Fintype C] {d : Nat} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (T : C) (i k : ι),
  Eq
    (HSMul.hSMul (HMul.hMul d.cast (HAdd.hAdd d.cast (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
      (Finset.univ.sum fun a =>
        Finset.univ.sum fun b =>
          ite (And (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) a) i) (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) b) k))
            (HSMul.hSMul (M.m T) (HAdd.hAdd (M.g T a) (M.g T b))) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
    (HSMul.hSMul (ite (Eq i k) (OfNat.ofNat 2) (OfNat.ofNat 1))
      (Finset.univ.sum fun o =>
        ite (And (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes (Prod.mk T o)) i) (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes (Prod.mk T o)) k))
          (M.facetVec (Prod.mk T o)) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.cell_identi.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (T : C) (i k : ι),
  ((↑d * (↑d + 1)) • ∑ a, ∑ b, if (M.vert T) a = i ∧ (M.vert T) b = k then M.m T • (M.g T a + M.g T b) else 0) =
    (if i = k then 2 else 1) • ∑ o, if i ∈ M.facetNodes (T, o) ∧ k ∈ M.facetNodes (T, o) then M.facetVec (T, o) else 0

  Eq (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes (Prod.mk T o)) (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) a)) (Ne a o)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.cs.raw_type:

  Ne (CFDLean.Num.dot e e) (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
    And
      (LE.le (HPow.hPow (CFDLean.Num.dot y e) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Num.dot y y) (CFDLean.Num.dot e e)))
      (Eq (HPow.hPow (CFDLean.Num.dot y e) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Num.dot y y) (CFDLean.Num.dot e e)) →
        Eq y (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.Num.dot y e) (CFDLean.Num.dot e e)) e))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.cs.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (y e : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.Num.dot e e ≠ 0 →
    CFDLean.Num.dot y e ^ 2 ≤ CFDLean.Num.dot y y * CFDLean.Num.dot e e ∧
      (CFDLean.Num.dot y e ^ 2 = CFDLean.Num.dot y y * CFDLean.Num.dot e e →
        y = (CFDLean.Num.dot y e / CFDLean.Num.dot e e) • e)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_c.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_c
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_c.raw_type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : Nat} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (i k : ι)
  (v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  Eq (CFDLean.Num.dot (M.c i k) v)
    (Finset.univ.sum fun T =>
      Finset.univ.sum fun a =>
        Finset.univ.sum fun b =>
          ite (And (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) a) i) (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) b) k))
            (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (M.ω T) (M.m T)) (CFDLean.Num.dot (M.g T b) v)) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_c.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (i k : ι)
  (v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.Num.dot (M.c i k) v =
    ∑ T, ∑ a, ∑ b, if (M.vert T) a = i ∧ (M.vert T) b = k then M.ω T * M.m T * CFDLean.Num.dot (M.g T b) v else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.facet_cross.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.facet_cross
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.facet_cross.raw_type:
∀ (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (o a b c : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  T.Nondeg →
    (List.cons o (List.cons a (List.cons b (List.cons c List.nil)))).Nodup →
      Eq (T.facet o)
        (HSMul.hSMul
          (ite
            (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0)
              (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (HSub.hSub (T.x b) (T.x a)) (HSub.hSub (T.x c) (T.x a)))
                (HSub.hSub (T.x o) (T.x a))))
            (Neg.neg (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2))) (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))
          (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (HSub.hSub (T.x b) (T.x a)) (HSub.hSub (T.x c) (T.x a))))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.facet_cross.type:
∀ (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex 3) (o a b c : Fin 4),
  T.Nondeg →
    [o, a, b, c].Nodup →
      T.facet o =
        (if 0 < CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (T.x b - T.x a) (T.x c - T.x a)) (T.x o - T.x a) then -(1 / 2)
          else 1 / 2) •
          CFDLean.Num.cross3 (T.x b - T.x a) (T.x c - T.x a)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.facet_cross._s.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {a : α} {l : List α}, (a :: l).Nodup = (a ∉ l ∧ l.Nodup)
