CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.grads_of_dual.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d) (G : Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1)) → CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  (∀ (a j : Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1))),
      Eq (CFDLean.Num.dot (G a) (HSub.hSub (T.x j) (T.x (OfNat.ofNat 0))))
        (HSub.hSub (ite (Eq a j) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
          (ite (Eq a (OfNat.ofNat 0)) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))) →
    And T.Nondeg (∀ (a : Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1))), Eq (T.grad a) (G a))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.grads_of_dual.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d) (G : Fin (d + 1) → CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  (∀ (a j : Fin (d + 1)), CFDLean.Num.dot (G a) (T.x j - T.x 0) = (if a = j then 1 else 0) - if a = 0 then 1 else 0) →
    T.Nondeg ∧ ∀ (a : Fin (d + 1)), T.grad a = G a

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.grads_of_dual..name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.grads_of_dual._simp_1_1
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.grads_of_dual..raw_type: ∀ {n : Nat} {a b : Fin n}, Eq (Eq a.succ b.succ) (Eq a b)
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.grads_of_dual..type: ∀ {n : ℕ} {a b : Fin n}, (a.succ = b.succ) = (a = b)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.grads_of_dual..name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.grads_of_dual._simp_1_2
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.grads_of_dual..raw_type: ∀ {n : Nat} (k : Fin n), Eq (Eq k.succ (OfNat.ofNat 0)) False

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.lagrange.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.lagrange
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.lagrange.raw_type:
∀ (u v w g : CFDLean.Num.Vec (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq
    (HAdd.hAdd
      (HAdd.hAdd (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.Num.dot g w) (CFDLean.Num.cross3 u v))
        (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.Num.dot g u) (CFDLean.Num.cross3 v w)))
      (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.Num.dot g v) (CFDLean.Num.cross3 w u)))
    (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 u v) w) g)
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.lagrange.type:
∀ (u v w g : CFDLean.Num.Vec 3),
  CFDLean.Num.dot g w • CFDLean.Num.cross3 u v + CFDLean.Num.dot g u • CFDLean.Num.cross3 v w +
      CFDLean.Num.dot g v • CFDLean.Num.cross3 w u =
    CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 u v) w • g

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.pathG.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.pathG.eq_1
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.pathG.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3))) (h : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3) → Real),
  Eq (CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.pathG π h)
    (Matrix.vecCons (Neg.neg (CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
      (Matrix.vecCons
        (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
          (CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
        (Matrix.vecCons
          (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
            (CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
          (Matrix.vecCons (CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩) Matrix.vecEmpty))))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.pathG.eq_1.type:
∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (h : Fin 3 → ℝ),
  CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.pathG π h =
    ![-CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h 0, CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h 0 - CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h 1,
      CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h 1 - CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h 2, CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h 2]

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.path_coord.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.path_coord
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.path_coord.raw_type:
∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3))) (h : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3) → Real) (j : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4))
  (k : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq ((CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex π h).x j (DFunLike.coe π k))
    (ite (LT.lt k.val j.val) (h (DFunLike.coe π k)) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.path_coord.type:
∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (h : Fin 3 → ℝ) (j : Fin 4) (k : Fin 3),
  (CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex π h).x j (π k) = if ↑k < ↑j then h (π k) else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.path_grads.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.path_grads
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.path_grads.raw_type:
∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3))) (h : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3) → Real),
  (∀ (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)), LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (h i)) →
    And (CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex π h).Nondeg
      (∀ (a : Fin (HAdd.hAdd (OfNat.ofNat 3) (OfNat.ofNat 1))),
        Eq ((CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex π h).grad a) (CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.pathG π h a))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.path_grads.type:
∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (h : Fin 3 → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : Fin 3), 0 < h i) →
    (CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex π h).Nondeg ∧
      ∀ (a : Fin (3 + 1)), (CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex π h).grad a = CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.pathG π h a

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv.eq_1
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3))) (h : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3) → Real) (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h i) (Pi.single (DFunLike.coe π i) (Inv.inv (h (DFunLike.coe π i))))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv.eq_1.type: ∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (h : Fin 3 → ℝ) (i : Fin 3), CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h i = Pi.single (π i) (h (π i))⁻¹

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv_dot_sv.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv_dot_sv
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv_dot_sv.raw_type:
∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3))) (h : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3) → Real) (i k : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h i) (CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h k))
    (ite (Eq i k) (HMul.hMul (Inv.inv (h (DFunLike.coe π i))) (Inv.inv (h (DFunLike.coe π i)))) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv_dot_sv.type:
∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (h : Fin 3 → ℝ) (i k : Fin 3),
  CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h i) (CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h k) =
    if i = k then (h (π i))⁻¹ * (h (π i))⁻¹ else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv_dot_x.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv_dot_x
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv_dot_x.raw_type:
∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3))) (h : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3) → Real),
  (∀ (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)), LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (h i)) →
    ∀ (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (j : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
      Eq
        (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h i)
          (HSub.hSub ((CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex π h).x j) ((CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex π h).x ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
        (ite (LT.lt i.val j.val) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv_dot_x.type:
∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (h : Fin 3 → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : Fin 3), 0 < h i) →
    ∀ (i : Fin 3) (j : Fin 4),
      CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h i)
          ((CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex π h).x j - (CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex π h).x 0) =
        if ↑i < ↑j then 1 else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.triple_perm.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.triple_perm
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.triple_perm.raw_type:
∀ (p : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4) → CFDLean.Num.Vec (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (o a b c : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  (List.cons o (List.cons a (List.cons b (List.cons c List.nil)))).Nodup →
    Or
      (Eq (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (HSub.hSub (p b) (p a)) (HSub.hSub (p c) (p a))) (HSub.hSub (p o) (p a)))
        (CFDLean.Num.dot
          (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (HSub.hSub (p ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (p ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
            (HSub.hSub (p ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (p ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
          (HSub.hSub (p ⟨3, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (p ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩))))
      (Eq (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (HSub.hSub (p b) (p a)) (HSub.hSub (p c) (p a))) (HSub.hSub (p o) (p a)))
        (Neg.neg
          (CFDLean.Num.dot
            (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (HSub.hSub (p ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (p ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
              (HSub.hSub (p ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (p ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
            (HSub.hSub (p ⟨3, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (p ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.triple_perm.type:
∀ (p : Fin 4 → CFDLean.Num.Vec 3) (o a b c : Fin 4),
  [o, a, b, c].Nodup →
    CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (p b - p a) (p c - p a)) (p o - p a) =
        CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (p 1 - p 0) (p 2 - p 0)) (p 3 - p 0) ∨
      CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (p b - p a) (p c - p a)) (p o - p a) =
        -CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (p 1 - p 0) (p 2 - p 0)) (p 3 - p 0)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.triple_perm._s.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {b : α} {l : List α} {a : α}, (a ∈ b :: l) = (a = b ∨ a ∈ l)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.B_bd.raw_type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : Nat} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (bd : Prod C (Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1))) → Bool),
  M.Conforming bd →
    LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 1) d →
      ∀ (i k : ι),
        Eq (M.B i k)
          (Finset.univ.sum fun p =>
            ite (And (Eq (bd p) true) (And (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) i) (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) k)))
              (HSMul.hSMul
                (HDiv.hDiv (HAdd.hAdd (OfNat.ofNat 1) (ite (Eq i k) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
                  (HMul.hMul d.cast (HAdd.hAdd d.cast (OfNat.ofNat 1))))
                (M.areaVec p))
              (OfNat.ofNat 0))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.B_bd.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (bd : C × Fin (d + 1) → Bool),
  M.Conforming bd →
    1 ≤ d →
      ∀ (i k : ι),
        M.B i k =
          ∑ p,
            if bd p = true ∧ i ∈ M.facetNodes p ∧ k ∈ M.facetNodes p then
              ((1 + if i = k then 1 else 0) / (↑d * (↑d + 1))) • M.areaVec p
            else 0

    (HSMul.hSMul (ite (Eq i k) (OfNat.ofNat 2) (OfNat.ofNat 1))
      (Finset.univ.sum fun p =>
        ite (And (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) i) (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) k)) (M.areaVec p)

  Eq (M.cW W k i)
    (Finset.univ.sum fun T =>
      Finset.univ.sum fun a =>
        Finset.univ.sum fun b =>
          ite (And (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) a) i) (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) b) k))

  M.cW W k i = ∑ T, ∑ a, ∑ b, if (M.vert T) a = i ∧ (M.vert T) b = k then (M.ω T * W T b) • M.g T a else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.face_identity.raw_type:
∀ {ι κ : Type} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype κ] (d : Nat),
  LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 1) d →
    ∀ (s : Finset ι),
      Eq s.card d →
        ∀ (w F : ι → κ → Real),
          Eq (s.sum fun i => s.sum fun j => HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Num.stdWeight d i j) (CFDLean.Num.pairF (w i) (F j)))
            (HSub.hSub (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) d.cast) (s.sum fun i => CFDLean.Num.pairF (w i) (F i)))
              (HMul.hMul
                (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1)
                  (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 4) d.cast) (HAdd.hAdd d.cast (OfNat.ofNat 1))))
                (s.sum fun i => s.sum fun j => CFDLean.Num.pairF (HSub.hSub (w j) (w i)) (HSub.hSub (F j) (F i)))))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.face_identity.type:
∀ {ι κ : Type} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype κ] (d : ℕ),
  1 ≤ d →
    ∀ (s : Finset ι),
      s.card = d →
        ∀ (w F : ι → κ → ℝ),
          ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, CFDLean.Num.stdWeight d i j * CFDLean.Num.pairF (w i) (F j) =
            1 / ↑d * ∑ i ∈ s, CFDLean.Num.pairF (w i) (F i) -
              1 / (4 * ↑d * (↑d + 1)) * ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, CFDLean.Num.pairF (w j - w i) (F j - F i)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.split_bd.raw_type:

  [inst_2 : DecidablePred Q] (f : Prod C (Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1))) → X),
  Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun p => ite (Q p) (f p) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
    (HAdd.hAdd (Finset.univ.sum fun p => ite (And (Eq (bd p) true) (Q p)) (f p) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
      (Finset.univ.sum fun p => ite (And (Eq (bd p) false) (Q p)) (f p) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.split_bd.type:
∀ {C : Type} [inst : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} {X : Type} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup X] (bd : C × Fin (d + 1) → Bool)
  (Q : C × Fin (d + 1) → Prop) [inst_2 : DecidablePred Q] (f : C × Fin (d + 1) → X),
  (∑ p, if Q p then f p else 0) =
    (∑ p, if bd p = true ∧ Q p then f p else 0) + ∑ p, if bd p = false ∧ Q p then f p else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.sum_bd_mem.type:

CFDLean.Num.Internal.rot_eq.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.rot_eq
CFDLean.Num.Internal.rot_eq.raw_type:
∀ (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex (OfNat.ofNat 2)),
  T.Nondeg →
    ∀ (i k : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
      Ne i k →
        Exists fun σ =>
          And (Or (Eq σ (OfNat.ofNat 1)) (Eq σ (Neg.neg (OfNat.ofNat 1))))
            (Eq
              (CFDLean.Num.rot90
                (HSub.hSub T.centroid
                  (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (HAdd.hAdd (T.x i) (T.x k)))))
              (HSMul.hSMul (HMul.hMul σ (HDiv.hDiv T.edgeMat.det (OfNat.ofNat 6))) (HSub.hSub (T.grad k) (T.grad i))))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.rot_eq.type:
∀ (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex 2),
  T.Nondeg →
    ∀ (i k : Fin 3),
      i ≠ k →
        ∃ σ,
          (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) ∧
            CFDLean.Num.rot90 (T.centroid - (1 / 2) • (T.x i + T.x k)) =
              (σ * (T.edgeMat.det / 6)) • (T.grad k - T.grad i)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.sum_first.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.sum_first
CFDLean.Num.Internal.sum_first.raw_type:
∀ {ι C X : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid X] {d : Nat}
  (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (k : ι)
  (f : C → Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1)) → Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1)) → X),
  Eq
    (Finset.univ.sum fun i =>
      Finset.univ.sum fun T =>
        Finset.univ.sum fun a =>
          Finset.univ.sum fun b =>
            ite (And (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) a) i) (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) b) k)) (f T a b) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
    (Finset.univ.sum fun T =>
      Finset.univ.sum fun a =>
        Finset.univ.sum fun b => ite (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) b) k) (f T a b) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.sum_first.type:
∀ {ι C X : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid X] {d : ℕ}
  (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (k : ι) (f : C → Fin (d + 1) → Fin (d + 1) → X),
  (∑ i, ∑ T, ∑ a, ∑ b, if (M.vert T) a = i ∧ (M.vert T) b = k then f T a b else 0) =
    ∑ T, ∑ a, ∑ b, if (M.vert T) b = k then f T a b else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.sum_second.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.sum_second
CFDLean.Num.Internal.sum_second.raw_type:
∀ {ι C X : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid X] {d : Nat}
  (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (i : ι)
  (f : C → Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1)) → Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1)) → X),
  Eq
    (Finset.univ.sum fun k =>
      Finset.univ.sum fun T =>
        Finset.univ.sum fun a =>
          Finset.univ.sum fun b =>
            ite (And (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) a) i) (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) b) k)) (f T a b) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
    (Finset.univ.sum fun T =>
      Finset.univ.sum fun a =>
        Finset.univ.sum fun b => ite (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) a) i) (f T a b) (OfNat.ofNat 0))

CFDLean.Num.Simplex.calculus.raw_type:
∀ (d : Nat) (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d),
  T.Nondeg →
    And (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun a => T.grad a) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
      (And
        (∀ (a b c : Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1))),
          Eq (CFDLean.Num.dot (T.grad a) (HSub.hSub (T.x b) (T.x c)))
            (HSub.hSub (ite (Eq a b) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0)) (ite (Eq a c) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0))))
        (And (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun a => CFDLean.Num.outer (T.grad a) (T.x a)) (OfNat.ofNat 1))
          (And (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) T.vol) (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun o => T.facet o) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))))
CFDLean.Num.Simplex.calculus.type:
∀ (d : ℕ) (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d),
  T.Nondeg →
    ∑ a, T.grad a = 0 ∧
      (∀ (a b c : Fin (d + 1)),
          CFDLean.Num.dot (T.grad a) (T.x b - T.x c) = (if a = b then 1 else 0) - if a = c then 1 else 0) ∧
        ∑ a, CFDLean.Num.outer (T.grad a) (T.x a) = 1 ∧ 0 < T.vol ∧ ∑ o, T.facet o = 0

CFDLean.Num.Simplex.facet_cross3.name: CFDLean.Num.Simplex.facet_cross3
CFDLean.Num.Simplex.facet_cross3.raw_type:
And
  (∀ (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (o a b c : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
    T.Nondeg →
      (List.cons o (List.cons a (List.cons b (List.cons c List.nil)))).Nodup →
        let nv := CFDLean.Num.cross3 (HSub.hSub (T.x b) (T.x a)) (HSub.hSub (T.x c) (T.x a));
        Eq (T.facet o)
          (HSMul.hSMul
            (ite (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (CFDLean.Num.dot nv (HSub.hSub (T.x o) (T.x a))))
              (Neg.neg (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2))) (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))
            nv))
  (∀ (T T' : CFDLean.Num.Simplex (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (o a b c o' a' b' c' : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
    T.Nondeg →
      T'.Nondeg →
        (List.cons o (List.cons a (List.cons b (List.cons c List.nil)))).Nodup →
          (List.cons o' (List.cons a' (List.cons b' (List.cons c' List.nil)))).Nodup →
            Eq (T'.x a') (T.x a) →
              Eq (T'.x b') (T.x b) →
                Eq (T'.x c') (T.x c) →
                  let nv := CFDLean.Num.cross3 (HSub.hSub (T.x b) (T.x a)) (HSub.hSub (T.x c) (T.x a));
                  LT.lt
                      (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Num.dot nv (HSub.hSub (T.x o) (T.x a)))
                        (CFDLean.Num.dot nv (HSub.hSub (T'.x o') (T.x a))))
                      (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
                    Eq (T'.facet o') (Neg.neg (T.facet o)))
CFDLean.Num.Simplex.facet_cross3.type:
(∀ (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex 3) (o a b c : Fin 4),
    T.Nondeg →
      [o, a, b, c].Nodup →
        let nv := CFDLean.Num.cross3 (T.x b - T.x a) (T.x c - T.x a);
        T.facet o = (if 0 < CFDLean.Num.dot nv (T.x o - T.x a) then -(1 / 2) else 1 / 2) • nv) ∧
  ∀ (T T' : CFDLean.Num.Simplex 3) (o a b c o' a' b' c' : Fin 4),
    T.Nondeg →
      T'.Nondeg →
        [o, a, b, c].Nodup →
          [o', a', b', c'].Nodup →
            T'.x a' = T.x a →
              T'.x b' = T.x b →
                T'.x c' = T.x c →
                  let nv := CFDLean.Num.cross3 (T.x b - T.x a) (T.x c - T.x a);
                  CFDLean.Num.dot nv (T.x o - T.x a) * CFDLean.Num.dot nv (T'.x o' - T.x a) < 0 →
                    T'.facet o' = -T.facet o

CFDLean.Num.Simplex.facet_perp2.name: CFDLean.Num.Simplex.facet_perp2
CFDLean.Num.Simplex.facet_perp2.raw_type:
∀ (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (o a b : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  T.Nondeg →
    (List.cons o (List.cons a (List.cons b List.nil))).Nodup →
      Eq (T.facet o)
        (HSMul.hSMul
          (ite
            (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0)
              (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.perp2 (HSub.hSub (T.x b) (T.x a))) (HSub.hSub (T.x o) (T.x a))))
            (Neg.neg (OfNat.ofNat 1)) (OfNat.ofNat 1))
          (CFDLean.Num.perp2 (HSub.hSub (T.x b) (T.x a))))
CFDLean.Num.Simplex.facet_perp2.type:
∀ (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex 2) (o a b : Fin 3),
  T.Nondeg →
    [o, a, b].Nodup →
      T.facet o =
        (if 0 < CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.perp2 (T.x b - T.x a)) (T.x o - T.x a) then -1 else 1) •
          CFDLean.Num.perp2 (T.x b - T.x a)

CFDLean.Num.WMesh.closed_mean_galerkin.name: CFDLean.Num.WMesh.closed_mean_galerkin
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.closed_mean_galerkin.raw_type:
∀ (ι C κ : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] [Fintype κ] (d : Nat)
  (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (F : ι → Matrix κ (Fin d) Real) (i : ι),
  M.Valid →
    M.Closed i →
      And
        (Eq
          (Finset.univ.sum fun k =>
            (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (HAdd.hAdd (F i) (F k))).mulVec (M.n i k))
          (Finset.univ.sum fun k => (F k).mulVec (M.c i k)))
        (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun k => (F k).mulVec (M.c i k))
          (Finset.univ.sum fun T =>
            Finset.univ.sum fun a =>
              ite (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) a) i)
                (HSMul.hSMul (HMul.hMul (M.ω T) (M.m T))
                  (Finset.univ.sum fun b => (F (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) b)).mulVec (M.g T b)))
                (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.closed_mean_galerkin.type:
∀ (ι C κ : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] [Fintype κ] (d : ℕ)
  (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (F : ι → Matrix κ (Fin d) ℝ) (i : ι),
  M.Valid →
    M.Closed i →
      ∑ k, ((1 / 2) • (F i + F k)).mulVec (M.n i k) = ∑ k, (F k).mulVec (M.c i k) ∧
        ∑ k, (F k).mulVec (M.c i k) =
          ∑ T, ∑ a, if (M.vert T) a = i then (M.ω T * M.m T) • ∑ b, (F ((M.vert T) b)).mulVec (M.g T b) else 0

CFDLean.Num.WMesh.conforming_boundary.name: CFDLean.Num.WMesh.conforming_boundary
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.conforming_boundary.raw_type:
∀ (ι C : Type) [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] (d : Nat) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (bd : Prod C (Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1))) → Bool),
  M.Valid →
    LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 1) d →
      M.Conforming bd →
        And
          (∀ (i : ι),
            Eq (M.beta i)
              (Finset.univ.sum fun p =>
                ite (And (Eq (bd p) true) (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) i))
                  (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) d.cast) (M.areaVec p)) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
          (And
            (∀ (i k : ι),
              Eq (M.B i k)
                (Finset.univ.sum fun p =>
                  ite
                    (And (Eq (bd p) true) (And (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) i) (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) k)))
                    (HSMul.hSMul
                      (HDiv.hDiv (HAdd.hAdd (OfNat.ofNat 1) (ite (Eq i k) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
                        (HMul.hMul d.cast (HAdd.hAdd d.cast (OfNat.ofNat 1))))
                      (M.areaVec p))
                    (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
            (∀ (i : ι),
              (∀ (p : Prod C (Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1)))),
                  Eq (bd p) true → Not (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) i)) →
                M.Closed i))
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.conforming_boundary.type:
∀ (ι C : Type) [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] (d : ℕ) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (bd : C × Fin (d + 1) → Bool),
  M.Valid →
    1 ≤ d →
      M.Conforming bd →
        (∀ (i : ι), M.beta i = ∑ p, if bd p = true ∧ i ∈ M.facetNodes p then (1 / ↑d) • M.areaVec p else 0) ∧
          (∀ (i k : ι),
              M.B i k =
                ∑ p,
                  if bd p = true ∧ i ∈ M.facetNodes p ∧ k ∈ M.facetNodes p then
                    ((1 + if i = k then 1 else 0) / (↑d * (↑d + 1))) • M.areaVec p
                  else 0) ∧
            ∀ (i : ι), (∀ (p : C × Fin (d + 1)), bd p = true → i ∉ M.facetNodes p) → M.Closed i

CFDLean.Num.WMesh.dissGeom_calibration.name: CFDLean.Num.WMesh.dissGeom_calibration
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.dissGeom_calibration.raw_type:
∀ (ι C : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] (d : Nat) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid →
    And (∀ (i : ι), M.Closed i → Eq (M.Gtensor M.nu i).trace (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) d.cast) (M.V i)))
      (And
        (Eq
          (Finset.univ.sum fun i =>
            Finset.univ.sum fun k => HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Num.len (M.nu i k)) (CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k)))
          (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) d.cast) M.volΩ))
        (And
          (∀ (i : ι), M.Closed i → LE.le (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) d.cast) (M.V i)) (M.Gtensor M.n i).trace)
          (∀ (i : ι),
            M.Closed i →
              Iff (Eq (M.Gtensor M.n i).trace (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) d.cast) (M.V i)))
                (∀ (k : ι), Exists fun t => And (LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) t) (Eq (M.n i k) (HSMul.hSMul t (M.e i k)))))))
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.dissGeom_calibration.type:
∀ (ι C : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] (d : ℕ) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid →
    (∀ (i : ι), M.Closed i → (M.Gtensor M.nu i).trace = 2 * ↑d * M.V i) ∧
      ∑ i, ∑ k, CFDLean.Num.len (M.nu i k) * CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k) = 2 * ↑d * M.volΩ ∧
        (∀ (i : ι), M.Closed i → 2 * ↑d * M.V i ≤ (M.Gtensor M.n i).trace) ∧
          ∀ (i : ι),
            M.Closed i → ((M.Gtensor M.n i).trace = 2 * ↑d * M.V i ↔ ∀ (k : ι), ∃ t, 0 ≤ t ∧ M.n i k = t • M.e i k)

CFDLean.Num.WMesh.dissGeom_edge.name: CFDLean.Num.WMesh.dissGeom_edge
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.dissGeom_edge.raw_type:
∀ (ι C : Type) [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] (d : Nat) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid →
    And (∀ (i k : ι), Ne i k → Eq (CFDLean.Num.dot (M.n i k) (M.e i k)) (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) (M.mu i k)))
      (∀ (i k : ι),
        Ne i k →
          (Exists fun T =>
              Exists fun a =>
                Exists fun b =>
                  And (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) a) i)
                    (And (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) b) k) (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (M.ω T)))) →
            And (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (M.mu i k))
              (And (Exists fun t => And (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) t) (Eq (M.nu i k) (HSMul.hSMul t (M.e i k))))
                (Eq (CFDLean.Num.len (M.nu i k))
                  (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.Num.dot (M.n i k) (M.e i k)) (CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k))))))
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.dissGeom_edge.type:
∀ (ι C : Type) [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] (d : ℕ) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid →
    (∀ (i k : ι), i ≠ k → CFDLean.Num.dot (M.n i k) (M.e i k) = 2 * M.mu i k) ∧
      ∀ (i k : ι),
        i ≠ k →
          (∃ T a b, (M.vert T) a = i ∧ (M.vert T) b = k ∧ 0 < M.ω T) →
            0 < M.mu i k ∧
              (∃ t, 0 < t ∧ M.nu i k = t • M.e i k) ∧
                CFDLean.Num.len (M.nu i k) = CFDLean.Num.dot (M.n i k) (M.e i k) / CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k)

  M.Valid →
    And
      (∀ (i : ι),
        Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun k => CFDLean.Num.outer (M.c i k) (M.e i k)) (HSMul.hSMul (M.V i) (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
      (And
        (∀ (i : ι),
          M.Closed i →
            Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun k => CFDLean.Num.outer (M.n i k) (M.e i k))
              (HSMul.hSMul (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) (M.V i)) (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
        (And
          (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => Finset.univ.sum fun k => CFDLean.Num.outer (M.n i k) (M.e i k))
            (HSMul.hSMul (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) M.volΩ) (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
          (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => M.V i) M.volΩ)))

∀ (ι C : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] (d : ℕ) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid →
    (∀ (i : ι), ∑ k, CFDLean.Num.outer (M.c i k) (M.e i k) = M.V i • 1) ∧
      (∀ (i : ι), M.Closed i → ∑ k, CFDLean.Num.outer (M.n i k) (M.e i k) = (2 * M.V i) • 1) ∧
        ∑ i, ∑ k, CFDLean.Num.outer (M.n i k) (M.e i k) = (2 * M.volΩ) • 1 ∧ ∑ i, M.V i = M.volΩ

            HSMul.hSMul (HMul.hMul (σ i k) (CFDLean.Num.len (z i k))) (CFDLean.Num.outer (M.e i k) (M.e i k)));

          Eq (K y) (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv s (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 4) (M.V i))) (M.Gtensor y i)))
        (And
          ((∀ (k : ι), Ne k i → Eq (HMul.hMul (σ i k) (CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k))) s) →
            Eq (K M.nu).trace (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul d.cast s) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))
          ((∀ (k : ι), And (LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) (σ i k)) (LE.le (σ i k) σmax)) →
            (∀ (k : ι), Ne (M.n i k) (OfNat.ofNat 0) → LE.le (CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k)) h) →

  M.Valid →
    0 < M.V i →
      let K := fun z =>
        (1 / (4 * M.V i)) • ∑ k, (σ i k * CFDLean.Num.len (z i k)) • CFDLean.Num.outer (M.e i k) (M.e i k);
      ((∀ (k : ι), k ≠ i → σ i k * CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k) = s) → K y = (s / (4 * M.V i)) • M.Gtensor y i) ∧

            (∀ (k : ι), M.n i k ≠ 0 → CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k) ≤ h) → (K M.nu).trace ≤ ↑d / 2 * σmax * h)

CFDLean.Num.WMesh.faceRule_beta_B.raw_type:
∀ (ι C Q : Type) [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] [inst_2 : DecidableEq C] [inst_3 : Fintype Q]
  (d : Nat) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (bd : Prod C (Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1))) → Bool)
  (fq : Q → Prod C (Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1)))) (aq : Q → Real) (φ : Q → ι → Real),
  M.Valid →
    LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 1) d →
      M.Conforming bd →
        (∀ (q : Q), Eq (bd (fq q)) true) →
          (∀ (q : Q) (k : ι), Not (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes (fq q)) k) → Eq (φ q k) (OfNat.ofNat 0)) →
            (∀ (p : Prod C (Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1)))),
                Eq (bd p) true →
                  ∀ (i : ι),
                    Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) i →
                      Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun q => ite (Eq (fq q) p) (HMul.hMul (aq q) (φ q i)) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
                        (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) d.cast)) →
              (∀ (p : Prod C (Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1)))),
                  Eq (bd p) true →
                    ∀ (i : ι),
                      Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) i →
                        ∀ (k : ι),
                          Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) k →
                            Eq
                              (Finset.univ.sum fun q =>
                                ite (Eq (fq q) p) (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (aq q) (φ q i)) (φ q k)) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
                              (HDiv.hDiv (HAdd.hAdd (OfNat.ofNat 1) (ite (Eq i k) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
                                (HMul.hMul d.cast (HAdd.hAdd d.cast (OfNat.ofNat 1))))) →
                let N := fun q => HSMul.hSMul (aq q) (M.areaVec (fq q));
                And (∀ (i : ι), Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun q => HSMul.hSMul (φ q i) (N q)) (M.beta i))
                  (∀ (i k : ι), Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun q => HSMul.hSMul (HMul.hMul (φ q i) (φ q k)) (N q)) (M.B i k))
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.faceRule_beta_B.type:
∀ (ι C Q : Type) [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] [inst_2 : DecidableEq C] [inst_3 : Fintype Q]
  (d : ℕ) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (bd : C × Fin (d + 1) → Bool) (fq : Q → C × Fin (d + 1)) (aq : Q → ℝ)
  (φ : Q → ι → ℝ),
  M.Valid →
    1 ≤ d →
      M.Conforming bd →
        (∀ (q : Q), bd (fq q) = true) →
          (∀ (q : Q), ∀ k ∉ M.facetNodes (fq q), φ q k = 0) →
            (∀ (p : C × Fin (d + 1)),
                bd p = true → ∀ i ∈ M.facetNodes p, (∑ q, if fq q = p then aq q * φ q i else 0) = 1 / ↑d) →
              (∀ (p : C × Fin (d + 1)),
                  bd p = true →
                    ∀ i ∈ M.facetNodes p,
                      ∀ k ∈ M.facetNodes p,
                        (∑ q, if fq q = p then aq q * φ q i * φ q k else 0) =
                          (1 + if i = k then 1 else 0) / (↑d * (↑d + 1))) →
                let N := fun q => aq q • M.areaVec (fq q);
                (∀ (i : ι), ∑ q, φ q i • N q = M.beta i) ∧ ∀ (i k : ι), ∑ q, (φ q i * φ q k) • N q = M.B i k

CFDLean.Num.WMesh.facetBalanced_boundary.name: CFDLean.Num.WMesh.facetBalanced_boundary
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.facetBalanced_boundary.raw_type:
∀ (ι C : Type) [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] (d : Nat) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (bd : Prod C (Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1))) → Bool),
  M.Valid →
    LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 1) d →
      And (M.Conforming bd → M.FacetBalanced bd)
        (M.FacetBalanced bd →
          And
            (∀ (i : ι),
              Eq (M.beta i)
                (Finset.univ.sum fun p =>
                  ite (And (Eq (bd p) true) (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) i))
                    (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) d.cast) (M.areaVec p)) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
            (And
              (∀ (i k : ι),
                Eq (M.B i k)
                  (Finset.univ.sum fun p =>
                    ite
                      (And (Eq (bd p) true)
                        (And (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) i) (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) k)))
                      (HSMul.hSMul
                        (HDiv.hDiv (HAdd.hAdd (OfNat.ofNat 1) (ite (Eq i k) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
                          (HMul.hMul d.cast (HAdd.hAdd d.cast (OfNat.ofNat 1))))
                        (M.areaVec p))
                      (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
              (∀ (i : ι),
                (∀ (p : Prod C (Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1)))),
                    Eq (bd p) true → Not (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) i)) →
                  M.Closed i)))
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.facetBalanced_boundary.type:
∀ (ι C : Type) [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] (d : ℕ) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (bd : C × Fin (d + 1) → Bool),
  M.Valid →
    1 ≤ d →
      (M.Conforming bd → M.FacetBalanced bd) ∧
        (M.FacetBalanced bd →
          (∀ (i : ι), M.beta i = ∑ p, if bd p = true ∧ i ∈ M.facetNodes p then (1 / ↑d) • M.areaVec p else 0) ∧
            (∀ (i k : ι),
                M.B i k =
                  ∑ p,
                    if bd p = true ∧ i ∈ M.facetNodes p ∧ k ∈ M.facetNodes p then
                      ((1 + if i = k then 1 else 0) / (↑d * (↑d + 1))) • M.areaVec p
                    else 0) ∧
              ∀ (i : ι), (∀ (p : C × Fin (d + 1)), bd p = true → i ∉ M.facetNodes p) → M.Closed i)

∀ (ι C : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] (d : Nat) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (W : C → Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1)) → Real),
  (∀ (T : C), Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun a => W T a) (M.vol T)) →
    And
      (∀ (i k : ι),

      (And (∀ (i k : ι), Eq (M.EW W k i) (M.EW W i k))
        (And (∀ (i : ι), Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun k => M.EW W i k) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
          (And (∀ (i : ι), Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun k => M.cW W i k) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
            (∀ (k : ι), Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => M.cW W i k) (M.beta k)))))
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.sbp_defect.type:
∀ (ι C : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] (d : ℕ) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)

CFDLean.Num.WMesh.standardClosure_entrop.name: CFDLean.Num.WMesh.standardClosure_entropy
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.standardClosure_entrop.raw_type:
∀ (ι C κ : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] [inst_3 : Fintype κ] (d : Nat)
  (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (bd : Prod C (Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1))) → Bool) (w : ι → κ → Real)
  (ψ : ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (Fs : Prod C (Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1))) → ι → κ → Real),
  M.Valid →
    LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 1) d →
      M.Conforming bd →
        let b := fun i =>
          Finset.univ.sum fun p =>
            ite (And (Eq (bd p) true) (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) i))
              ((M.facetNodes p).sum fun j => HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.Num.stdWeight d i j) (Fs p j)) (OfNat.ofNat 0);
        Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Num.dot (ψ i) (M.beta i)) (CFDLean.Num.pairF (w i) (b i)))
          (Finset.univ.sum fun p =>
            ite (Eq (bd p) true)
              (HAdd.hAdd
                (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) d.cast)
                  ((M.facetNodes p).sum fun i =>
                    HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Num.dot (ψ i) (M.areaVec p)) (CFDLean.Num.pairF (w i) (Fs p i))))
                (HMul.hMul
                  (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1)
                    (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 4) d.cast) (HAdd.hAdd d.cast (OfNat.ofNat 1))))
                  ((M.facetNodes p).sum fun i =>
                    (M.facetNodes p).sum fun j =>
                      CFDLean.Num.pairF (HSub.hSub (w j) (w i)) (HSub.hSub (Fs p j) (Fs p i)))))
              (OfNat.ofNat 0))
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.standardClosure_entrop.type:
∀ (ι C κ : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] [inst_3 : Fintype κ] (d : ℕ)
  (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (bd : C × Fin (d + 1) → Bool) (w : ι → κ → ℝ) (ψ : ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d)
  (Fs : C × Fin (d + 1) → ι → κ → ℝ),
  M.Valid →
    1 ≤ d →
      M.Conforming bd →
        let b := fun i =>
          ∑ p,
            if bd p = true ∧ i ∈ M.facetNodes p then ∑ j ∈ M.facetNodes p, CFDLean.Num.stdWeight d i j • Fs p j else 0;
        ∑ i, (CFDLean.Num.dot (ψ i) (M.beta i) - CFDLean.Num.pairF (w i) (b i)) =
          ∑ p,
            if bd p = true then
              1 / ↑d * ∑ i ∈ M.facetNodes p, (CFDLean.Num.dot (ψ i) (M.areaVec p) - CFDLean.Num.pairF (w i) (Fs p i)) +
                1 / (4 * ↑d * (↑d + 1)) *
                  ∑ i ∈ M.facetNodes p, ∑ j ∈ M.facetNodes p, CFDLean.Num.pairF (w j - w i) (Fs p j - Fs p i)
            else 0

CFDLean.Num.WMesh.standardClosure_linear.name: CFDLean.Num.WMesh.standardClosure_linear
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.standardClosure_linear.raw_type:
∀ (ι C κ : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] [Fintype κ] (d : Nat)
  (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (bd : Prod C (Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1))) → Bool)
  (F : ι → Matrix κ (Fin d) Real),
  M.Valid →
    LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 1) d →
      M.Conforming bd →
        And
          (∀ (i : ι),
            Eq
              (Finset.univ.sum fun k =>
                (F k).mulVec
                  (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2))
                    (HAdd.hAdd (M.B i k) (ite (Eq i k) (M.beta i) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))))
              (Finset.univ.sum fun p =>
                ite (And (Eq (bd p) true) (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) i))
                  ((M.facetNodes p).sum fun j => HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.Num.stdWeight d i j) ((F j).mulVec (M.areaVec p)))
                  (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
          (∀ (i j : ι),
            Ne i j →
              Eq (CFDLean.Num.stdWeight d i i)
                (HMul.hMul (HAdd.hAdd d.cast (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (CFDLean.Num.stdWeight d i j)))
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.standardClosure_linear.type:
∀ (ι C κ : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] [Fintype κ] (d : ℕ)
  (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (bd : C × Fin (d + 1) → Bool) (F : ι → Matrix κ (Fin d) ℝ),
  M.Valid →
    1 ≤ d →
      M.Conforming bd →
        (∀ (i : ι),
            ∑ k, (F k).mulVec ((1 / 2) • (M.B i k + if i = k then M.beta i else 0)) =
              ∑ p,
                if bd p = true ∧ i ∈ M.facetNodes p then
                  ∑ j ∈ M.facetNodes p, CFDLean.Num.stdWeight d i j • (F j).mulVec (M.areaVec p)
                else 0) ∧
          ∀ (i j : ι), i ≠ j → CFDLean.Num.stdWeight d i i = (↑d + 3) * CFDLean.Num.stdWeight d i j

CFDLean.Num.dissTensor_loewner.name: CFDLean.Num.dissTensor_loewner
CFDLean.Num.dissTensor_loewner.raw_type:
∀ (ι : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] (d : Nat) (e y : ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (σ : ι → Real) (V : Real),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) V →
    (∀ (k : ι), LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) (σ k)) →
      (∀ (k : ι), LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (CFDLean.Num.dot (y k) (e k))) →
        let K := fun z =>
          HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 4) V))
            (Finset.univ.sum fun k =>
              HSMul.hSMul (HMul.hMul (σ k) (CFDLean.Num.len (z k))) (CFDLean.Num.outer (e k) (e k)));
        let ν := fun k => CFDLean.Num.WMesh.nuOf (y k) (e k);
        And
          (∀ (k : ι),
            And
              (Eq (CFDLean.Num.len (y k))
                (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Num.len (ν k))
                  (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Num.len (y k)) (CFDLean.Num.len (e k)))
                    (CFDLean.Num.dot (y k) (e k)))))
              (LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 1)
                (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Num.len (y k)) (CFDLean.Num.len (e k))) (CFDLean.Num.dot (y k) (e k)))))
          (And (HSub.hSub (K y) (K ν)).PosSemidef
            (Iff (Eq (K y) (K ν))
              (∀ (k : ι),
                LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (σ k) →
                  Exists fun t => And (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) t) (Eq (y k) (HSMul.hSMul t (e k))))))
CFDLean.Num.dissTensor_loewner.type:
∀ (ι : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] (d : ℕ) (e y : ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (σ : ι → ℝ) (V : ℝ),
  0 < V →
    (∀ (k : ι), 0 ≤ σ k) →
      (∀ (k : ι), 0 < CFDLean.Num.dot (y k) (e k)) →
        let K := fun z => (1 / (4 * V)) • ∑ k, (σ k * CFDLean.Num.len (z k)) • CFDLean.Num.outer (e k) (e k);
        let ν := fun k => CFDLean.Num.WMesh.nuOf (y k) (e k);
        (∀ (k : ι),
            CFDLean.Num.len (y k) =
                CFDLean.Num.len (ν k) * (CFDLean.Num.len (y k) * CFDLean.Num.len (e k) / CFDLean.Num.dot (y k) (e k)) ∧
              1 ≤ CFDLean.Num.len (y k) * CFDLean.Num.len (e k) / CFDLean.Num.dot (y k) (e k)) ∧
          (K y - K ν).PosSemidef ∧ (K y = K ν ↔ ∀ (k : ι), 0 < σ k → ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ y k = t • e k)

          (M.pos ((M.vert p.1) p.2) - M.pos (((M.facetNodes p).sort fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2).getD 0 ((M.vert p.1) p.2)))))

CFDLean.Num.logMean_properties.name: CFDLean.Num.logMean_properties
CFDLean.Num.logMean_properties.raw_type:
∀ (a b : Real),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) a →
    LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) b →
      And (Eq (CFDLean.Num.logMean a b) (CFDLean.Num.logMean b a))
        (And (Eq (CFDLean.Num.logMean a a) a)
          (And (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (CFDLean.Num.logMean a b))
            (Eq (HSub.hSub b a) (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Num.logMean a b) (HSub.hSub (Real.log b) (Real.log a))))))
CFDLean.Num.logMean_properties.type:
∀ (a b : ℝ),
  0 < a →
    0 < b →
      CFDLean.Num.logMean a b = CFDLean.Num.logMean b a ∧
        CFDLean.Num.logMean a a = a ∧
          0 < CFDLean.Num.logMean a b ∧ b - a = CFDLean.Num.logMean a b * (Real.log b - Real.log a)

CFDLean.Num.pair_production_integral.name: CFDLean.Num.pair_production_integral
CFDLean.Num.pair_production_integral.raw_type:
∀ (κ : Type) [inst : Fintype κ] (Φ : (κ → Real) → κ → Real)
  (B : (κ → Real) → ContinuousLinearMap (RingHom.id Real) (κ → Real) (κ → Real)) (wi wk : κ → Real),
  (∀ (s : Real),
      Membership.mem (Set.Icc (OfNat.ofNat 0) (OfNat.ofNat 1)) s →
        HasFDerivAt Φ (B (HAdd.hAdd wi (HSMul.hSMul s (HSub.hSub wk wi))))
          (HAdd.hAdd wi (HSMul.hSMul s (HSub.hSub wk wi)))) →
    ContinuousOn (fun s => DFunLike.coe (B (HAdd.hAdd wi (HSMul.hSMul s (HSub.hSub wk wi)))) (HSub.hSub wk wi))
        (Set.Icc (OfNat.ofNat 0) (OfNat.ofNat 1)) →
      And
        (Eq (HSub.hSub (Φ wk) (Φ wi))
          (intervalIntegral
            (fun s => DFunLike.coe (B (HAdd.hAdd wi (HSMul.hSMul s (HSub.hSub wk wi)))) (HSub.hSub wk wi))
            (OfNat.ofNat 0) (OfNat.ofNat 1) MeasureTheory.volume))
        (Eq (CFDLean.Num.pairF (HSub.hSub wk wi) (HSub.hSub (Φ wk) (Φ wi)))
          (intervalIntegral
            (fun s =>
              CFDLean.Num.pairF (HSub.hSub wk wi)
                (DFunLike.coe (B (HAdd.hAdd wi (HSMul.hSMul s (HSub.hSub wk wi)))) (HSub.hSub wk wi)))
            (OfNat.ofNat 0) (OfNat.ofNat 1) MeasureTheory.volume))
CFDLean.Num.pair_production_integral.type:
∀ (κ : Type) [inst : Fintype κ] (Φ : (κ → ℝ) → κ → ℝ) (B : (κ → ℝ) → (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] κ → ℝ) (wi wk : κ → ℝ),
  (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc 0 1, HasFDerivAt Φ (B (wi + s • (wk - wi))) (wi + s • (wk - wi))) →
    ContinuousOn (fun s => (B (wi + s • (wk - wi))) (wk - wi)) (Set.Icc 0 1) →
      Φ wk - Φ wi = ∫ (s : ℝ) in 0..1, (B (wi + s • (wk - wi))) (wk - wi) ∧
        CFDLean.Num.pairF (wk - wi) (Φ wk - Φ wi) =
          ∫ (s : ℝ) in 0..1, CFDLean.Num.pairF (wk - wi) ((B (wi + s • (wk - wi))) (wk - wi))

        Finset.univ.sum fun i =>
          ite (LT.lt i.val j.val) (HSMul.hSMul (h (DFunLike.coe π i)) (Pi.single (DFunLike.coe π i) (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
            (OfNat.ofNat 0) }
CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex.eq_1.type:
∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (h : Fin 3 → ℝ),
  CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex π h = { x := fun j => ∑ i, if ↑i < ↑j then h (π i) • Pi.single (π i) 1 else 0 }

CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex_nonobtuse.name: CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex_nonobtuse
CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex_nonobtuse.raw_type:

  (∀ (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)), LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (h i)) →

      (∀ (a b : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
        Ne a b →
          LE.le (CFDLean.Num.dot ((CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex π h).grad a) ((CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex π h).grad b))
            (OfNat.ofNat 0))
CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex_nonobtuse.type:
∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (h : Fin 3 → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : Fin 3), 0 < h i) →
    (CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex π h).Nondeg ∧

        a ≠ b → CFDLean.Num.dot ((CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex π h).grad a) ((CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex π h).grad b) ≤ 0

CFDLean.Num.quadratic_edge_expansion.name: CFDLean.Num.quadratic_edge_expansion
CFDLean.Num.quadratic_edge_expansion.raw_type:
∀ (ι : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] (d : Nat) (x : ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (i : ι) (lam : ι → Real) (V q0 : Real)
  (gq : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (H : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) Real),
  Ne V (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
    H.IsSymm →
      let q := fun z =>
        HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd q0 (CFDLean.Num.dot gq z))
          (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (CFDLean.Num.dot z (H.mulVec z)));
      let K :=
        HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 4) V))
          (Finset.univ.sum fun k =>
            HSMul.hSMul (lam k) (CFDLean.Num.outer (HSub.hSub (x k) (x i)) (HSub.hSub (x k) (x i))));
      Eq
        (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2))
          (Finset.univ.sum fun k => HMul.hMul (lam k) (HSub.hSub (q (x k)) (q (x i)))))
        (HAdd.hAdd
          (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2))
            (Finset.univ.sum fun k =>
              HMul.hMul (lam k) (CFDLean.Num.dot (HAdd.hAdd gq (H.mulVec (x i))) (HSub.hSub (x k) (x i)))))
          (HMul.hMul V (CFDLean.Num.frob K H)))
CFDLean.Num.quadratic_edge_expansion.type:
∀ (ι : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] (d : ℕ) (x : ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (i : ι) (lam : ι → ℝ) (V q0 : ℝ)
  (gq : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (H : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ),
  V ≠ 0 →
    H.IsSymm →
      let q := fun z => q0 + CFDLean.Num.dot gq z + 1 / 2 * CFDLean.Num.dot z (H.mulVec z);
      let K := (1 / (4 * V)) • ∑ k, lam k • CFDLean.Num.outer (x k - x i) (x k - x i);
      1 / 2 * ∑ k, lam k * (q (x k) - q (x i)) =
        1 / 2 * ∑ k, lam k * CFDLean.Num.dot (gq + H.mulVec (x i)) (x k - x i) + V * CFDLean.Num.frob K H

CFDLean.Num.quadratic_edge_expansion._ab.name: CFDLean.Num.quadratic_edge_expansion._abel_1_1

CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_entropy.name: CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_entropy
CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_entropy.raw_type:
∀ (ι Q S κ : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype Q] [inst_2 : Fintype κ] (d : Nat) (w : S → κ → Real)
  (ψ : S → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (Fec : S → S → CFDLean.Num.Vec d → κ → Real) (u : ι → S) (φ : Q → ι → Real)
  (N : Q → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (ut : Q → S) (Fs : Q → κ → Real),
  (∀ (a b : S) (y : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), Eq (Fec a b y) (Fec b a y)) →
    (∀ (a b : S) (y : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
        Eq (CFDLean.Num.pairF (HSub.hSub (w b) (w a)) (Fec a b y)) (CFDLean.Num.dot (HSub.hSub (ψ b) (ψ a)) y)) →
      (∀ (q : Q), Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun k => φ q k) (OfNat.ofNat 1)) →
        (∀ (q : Q), Eq (w (ut q)) (Finset.univ.sum fun k => HSMul.hSMul (φ q k) (w (u k)))) →
          let beta := fun i => Finset.univ.sum fun q => HSMul.hSMul (φ q i) (N q);
          let b := fun i =>
            Finset.univ.sum fun q =>
              HSMul.hSMul (φ q i)
                (HAdd.hAdd
                  (HSub.hSub (Fec (u i) (ut q) (N q))
                    (Finset.univ.sum fun k => HSMul.hSMul (φ q k) (Fec (ut q) (u k) (N q))))
                  (Fs q));
          And
            (Eq
              (Finset.univ.sum fun i =>
                HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Num.dot (ψ (u i)) (beta i)) (CFDLean.Num.pairF (w (u i)) (b i)))
              (Finset.univ.sum fun q =>
                HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Num.dot (ψ (ut q)) (N q)) (CFDLean.Num.pairF (w (ut q)) (Fs q))))
            (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => b i) (Finset.univ.sum fun q => Fs q))
CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_entropy.type:
∀ (ι Q S κ : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype Q] [inst_2 : Fintype κ] (d : ℕ) (w : S → κ → ℝ)
  (ψ : S → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (Fec : S → S → CFDLean.Num.Vec d → κ → ℝ) (u : ι → S) (φ : Q → ι → ℝ)
  (N : Q → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (ut : Q → S) (Fs : Q → κ → ℝ),
  (∀ (a b : S) (y : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), Fec a b y = Fec b a y) →
    (∀ (a b : S) (y : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), CFDLean.Num.pairF (w b - w a) (Fec a b y) = CFDLean.Num.dot (ψ b - ψ a) y) →
      (∀ (q : Q), ∑ k, φ q k = 1) →
        (∀ (q : Q), w (ut q) = ∑ k, φ q k • w (u k)) →
          let beta := fun i => ∑ q, φ q i • N q;
          let b := fun i => ∑ q, φ q i • (Fec (u i) (ut q) (N q) - ∑ k, φ q k • Fec (ut q) (u k) (N q) + Fs q);
          ∑ i, (CFDLean.Num.dot (ψ (u i)) (beta i) - CFDLean.Num.pairF (w (u i)) (b i)) =
              ∑ q, (CFDLean.Num.dot (ψ (ut q)) (N q) - CFDLean.Num.pairF (w (ut q)) (Fs q)) ∧
            ∑ i, b i = ∑ q, Fs q

CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_entropy._a.name: CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_entropy._abel_1_2
CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_entropy._a.raw_type:
∀ (ι Q S κ : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] (d : Nat) (Fec : S → S → CFDLean.Num.Vec d → κ → Real) (u : ι → S)
  (φ : Q → ι → Real) (N : Q → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (ut : Q → S) (Fs : Q → κ → Real) (q : Q),
  Eq
    (HAdd.hAdd
      (HSub.hSub (Finset.univ.sum fun x => HSMul.hSMul (φ q x) (Fec (ut q) (u x) (N q)))
        (Finset.univ.sum fun k => HSMul.hSMul (φ q k) (Fec (ut q) (u k) (N q))))
      (Fs q))

  (Fec : S → S → CFDLean.Num.Vec d → κ → Real) (Fl : S → Matrix κ (Fin d) Real) (u : ι → S) (φ : Q → ι → Real)
  (N : Q → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (ut : Q → S),
  (∀ (a b : S) (y : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
      Eq (Fec a b y) ((HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (HAdd.hAdd (Fl a) (Fl b))).mulVec y)) →
    (∀ (q : Q), Eq (Fl (ut q)) (Finset.univ.sum fun k => HSMul.hSMul (φ q k) (Fl (u k)))) →
      (∀ (q : Q), Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun k => φ q k) (OfNat.ofNat 1)) →
        let beta := fun i => Finset.univ.sum fun q => HSMul.hSMul (φ q i) (N q);
        let b := fun i =>
          Finset.univ.sum fun q =>
            HSMul.hSMul (φ q i)
              (HAdd.hAdd
                (HSub.hSub (Fec (u i) (ut q) (N q))
                  (Finset.univ.sum fun k => HSMul.hSMul (φ q k) (Fec (ut q) (u k) (N q))))
                ((Fl (ut q)).mulVec (N q)));
        ∀ (i : ι),
          Eq (b i)
            (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2))
              (HAdd.hAdd ((Fl (u i)).mulVec (beta i))
                (Finset.univ.sum fun k =>

  (∀ (a b : S) (y : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), Fec a b y = ((1 / 2) • (Fl a + Fl b)).mulVec y) →
    (∀ (q : Q), Fl (ut q) = ∑ k, φ q k • Fl (u k)) →
      (∀ (q : Q), ∑ k, φ q k = 1) →
        let beta := fun i => ∑ q, φ q i • N q;
        let b := fun i =>
          ∑ q, φ q i • (Fec (u i) (ut q) (N q) - ∑ k, φ q k • Fec (ut q) (u k) (N q) + (Fl (ut q)).mulVec (N q));
        ∀ (i : ι), b i = (1 / 2) • ((Fl (u i)).mulVec (beta i) + ∑ k, (Fl (u k)).mulVec (∑ q, (φ q i * φ q k) • N q))

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian.eq_1.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian.eq_1
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian γ x n)
    (ContinuousLinearMap.pi
      (Matrix.vecCons (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n)
        (Matrix.vecCons
          (HAdd.hAdd
            (HAdd.hAdd
              (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) n)
                (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
              (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
                (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement x n)))
            (HSMul.hSMul (n ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential γ x)))
          (Matrix.vecCons
            (HAdd.hAdd
              (HAdd.hAdd
                (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) n)
                  (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
                (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
                  (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement x n)))
              (HSMul.hSMul (n ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential γ x)))
            (Matrix.vecCons
              (HAdd.hAdd
                (HAdd.hAdd
                  (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) n)
                    (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨3, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
                  (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
                    (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement x n)))
                (HSMul.hSMul (n ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential γ x)))
              (Matrix.vecCons
                (HAdd.hAdd
                  (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) n)
                    (HAdd.hAdd (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨4, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
                      (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential γ x)))
                  (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.enthalpy γ x) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement x n)))
                Matrix.vecEmpty))))))
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian γ x n =
    ContinuousLinearMap.pi
      ![CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n,
        CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 +
            CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement x n +
          n 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential γ x,
        CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
            CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement x n +
          n 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential γ x,
        CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3 +
            CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement x n +
          n 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential γ x,
        CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) n •
            (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 + CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential γ x) +
          CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.enthalpy γ x • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement x n]

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement.eq_1
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement.raw_type:
∀ (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement x n)
    (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n)
      (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) n)
        (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement.type:

  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement x n =
    CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n -
      CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum..name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum.eq_1
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum..raw_type:
∀ (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n)
    (HAdd.hAdd
      (HAdd.hAdd (HSMul.hSMul (n ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
        (HSMul.hSMul (n ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
      (HSMul.hSMul (n ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨3, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum..type:
∀ (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n =
    n 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 + n 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
      n 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDiffere.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential.eq_1
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDiffere.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  Eq (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential γ x)
    (HSMul.hSMul (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1))
      (HAdd.hAdd
        (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨4, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
          (HAdd.hAdd
            (HAdd.hAdd
              (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
                (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
              (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
                (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
            (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
              (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨3, Fin.instOfNat⟩))))
        (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.squareSum (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x)) (OfNat.ofNat 2))
          (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩))))
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDiffere.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential γ x =
    (γ - 1) •
      (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 -
          (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 +
              CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
            CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3) +
        (CFDLean.squareSum (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) / 2) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0)

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressure_formul.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressure_formula
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressure_formul.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  Eq (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinatePressure γ x)
    (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1))
      (HSub.hSub (x ⟨4, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
        (HDiv.hDiv
          (HAdd.hAdd
            (HAdd.hAdd (HPow.hPow (x ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (OfNat.ofNat 2))
              (HPow.hPow (x ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))
            (HPow.hPow (x ⟨3, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))
          (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) (x ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))))
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressure_formul.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinatePressure γ x = (γ - 1) * (x 4 - (x 1 ^ 2 + x 2 ^ 2 + x 3 ^ 2) / (2 * x 0))

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity.eq_1.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity.eq_1

CFDLean.Roe.C.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (z : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  Eq (CFDLean.Roe.C γ n z)
    (ContinuousLinearMap.pi
      (Matrix.vecCons
        (HAdd.hAdd
          (HSMul.hSMul (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n) z)
            (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
          (HSMul.hSMul (z ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n)))
        (Matrix.vecCons
          (HAdd.hAdd
            (HAdd.hAdd
              (HSMul.hSMul (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n) z)
                (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
              (HSMul.hSMul (z ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n)))
            (HSMul.hSMul (n ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (CFDLean.Roe.pressureGradient γ z)))
          (Matrix.vecCons
            (HAdd.hAdd
              (HAdd.hAdd
                (HSMul.hSMul (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n) z)
                  (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
                (HSMul.hSMul (z ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n)))
              (HSMul.hSMul (n ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (CFDLean.Roe.pressureGradient γ z)))
            (Matrix.vecCons
              (HAdd.hAdd
                (HAdd.hAdd
                  (HSMul.hSMul (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n) z)
                    (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨3, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
                  (HSMul.hSMul (z ⟨3, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n)))
                (HSMul.hSMul (n ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (CFDLean.Roe.pressureGradient γ z)))
              (Matrix.vecCons
                (HAdd.hAdd
                  (HSMul.hSMul (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n) z)
                    (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨4, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
                  (HSMul.hSMul (z ⟨4, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n)))
                Matrix.vecEmpty))))))
CFDLean.Roe.C.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (z : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),

      ![(CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n) z • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0 +

            z 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n +
          n 1 • CFDLean.Roe.pressureGradient γ z,
        (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n) z • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3 +
            z 3 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n +
          n 2 • CFDLean.Roe.pressureGradient γ z,

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (u : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (H : Real) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (c : Real),
  Eq (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute γ u H n c)
    (HAdd.hAdd
      (HAdd.hAdd
        (HSMul.hSMul (abs (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus γ u H n c))
        (HSMul.hSMul (abs (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩)) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.zero γ u H n c)))
      (HSMul.hSMul (abs (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩)) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus γ u H n c)))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute γ u H n c =
    |CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c 0| • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus γ u H n c +
        |CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c 1| • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.zero γ u H n c +
      |CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c 2| • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus γ u H n c

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute_basis_repr.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute_basis_representation
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute_basis_repr.raw_type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (γ : Real) (u : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (H : Real)
  (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (c : Real),
  Eq (CFDLean.dot n n) (OfNat.ofNat 1) →
    Eq (HPow.hPow c (OfNat.ofNat 2))
        (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)) (HSub.hSub H (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.squareSum u) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))) →
      Ne c (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
        ∀ (bas : Module.Basis ι Real CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (μ : ι → Real),
          (∀ (i : ι),
              Eq (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n) (DFunLike.coe bas i))
                (HSMul.hSMul (μ i) (DFunLike.coe bas i))) →
            Eq (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute γ u H n c)
              (bas.equivFun.symm.comp
                ((CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.diagonal fun i => abs (μ i)).comp bas.equivFun.toLinearMap))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute_basis_repr.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    c ^ 2 = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) →
      c ≠ 0 →
        ∀ (bas : Module.Basis ι ℝ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (μ : ι → ℝ),
          (∀ (i : ι), (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n) (bas i) = μ i • bas i) →
            CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute γ u H n c =
              ↑bas.equivFun.symm ∘ₗ (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.diagonal fun i => |μ i|) ∘ₗ ↑bas.equivFun

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute_on_eigen.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (u : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (H : Real) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (c μ : Real),
  Eq (CFDLean.dot n n) (OfNat.ofNat 1) →
    Eq (HPow.hPow c (OfNat.ofNat 2))
        (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)) (HSub.hSub H (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.squareSum u) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))) →
      Ne c (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
        ∀ (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
          Ne v (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
            Eq (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n) v) (HSMul.hSMul μ v) →
              Eq (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute γ u H n c) v) (HSMul.hSMul (abs μ) v)
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute_on_eigen.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c μ : ℝ),

    c ^ 2 = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) →
      c ≠ 0 →
        ∀ (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
          v ≠ 0 → (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n) v = μ • v → (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.absolute γ u H n c) v = |μ| • v

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.complete_eigenbasis.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (u : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (H : Real) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (c : Real),
  Eq (CFDLean.dot n n) (OfNat.ofNat 1) →
    Eq (HPow.hPow c (OfNat.ofNat 2))
        (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)) (HSub.hSub H (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.squareSum u) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))) →
      LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) c →
        Ne (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)) (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
          Exists fun bas =>
            ∀ (j : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 5)),
              Exists fun i =>
                Eq (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n) (DFunLike.coe bas j))
                  (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c i) (DFunLike.coe bas j))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.complete_eigenbasis.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    c ^ 2 = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) →
      0 < c →
        γ - 1 ≠ 0 →
          ∃ bas,
            ∀ (j : Fin 5), ∃ i, (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n) (bas j) = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c i • bas j

            (Matrix.vecCons (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.squareSum u) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) Matrix.vecEmpty)))))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact.eq_1.type: ∀ (u : CFDLean.Vector 3), CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact u = ![1, u 0, u 1, u 2, CFDLean.squareSum u / 2]

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact_eigen.raw_type:

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.convective_decompos.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.convective_decomposition
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.convective_decompos.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (u : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (H : Real) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.dot n n) (OfNat.ofNat 1) →
    Ne (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)) (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
      ∀ (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
        Membership.mem ((CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n).eigenspace (CFDLean.dot u n)) v →
          Exists fun t =>
            And (Eq (CFDLean.dot t n) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
              (Eq v
                (HAdd.hAdd (HSMul.hSMul (v ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact u))
                  (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u t)))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.convective_decompos.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    γ - 1 ≠ 0 →
      ∀ v ∈ (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n).eigenspace (CFDLean.dot u n),
        ∃ t, CFDLean.dot t n = 0 ∧ v = v 0 • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact u + CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u t

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.convective_dimensio.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.convective_dimension._proof_1_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.convective_dimensio.raw_type:

      (HAdd.hAdd (OfNat.ofNat 2)

          (OfNat.ofNat 3)) →

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.convective_eq_kerne.raw_type:

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.convective_tangent_.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.convective_tangent_span
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.convective_tangent_.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (u : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (H : Real) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),

        (tb :
          Module.Basis (Fin (OfNat.ofNat 2)) Real (Subtype fun x => Membership.mem (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.tangent n) x)),
        Eq
          (Submodule.span Real
            (max (singleton (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact u))
              (Set.range fun i => CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u (DFunLike.coe tb i).val)))
          ((CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n).eigenspace (CFDLean.dot u n))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.convective_tangent_.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    γ - 1 ≠ 0 →
      ∀ (tb : Module.Basis (Fin 2) ℝ ↥(CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.tangent n)),
        Submodule.span ℝ ({CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact u} ∪ Set.range fun i => CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u ↑(tb i)) =
          (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n).eigenspace (CFDLean.dot u n)

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dot_reverse.raw_type: ∀ (u n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)), Eq (CFDLean.dot u (Neg.neg n)) (Neg.neg (CFDLean.dot u n))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dot_reverse.type: ∀ (u n : CFDLean.Vector 3), CFDLean.dot u (-n) = -CFDLean.dot u n

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (u : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp γ u)
    (HSMul.hSMul (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1))
        (HAdd.hAdd
          (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨4, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
            (HAdd.hAdd
              (HAdd.hAdd (HSMul.hSMul (u ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
                (HSMul.hSMul (u ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
              (HSMul.hSMul (u ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨3, Fin.instOfNat⟩))))
          (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.squareSum u) (OfNat.ofNat 2))
            (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))).toLinearMap
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp γ u =
    ↑((γ - 1) •
        (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 -
            (u 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 + u 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
              u 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3) +
          (CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0))

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp_energy.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp_energy
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp_energy.raw_type:

    Eq (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp γ u) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.energy γ)) (OfNat.ofNat 1)
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp_energy.type: ∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3), γ - 1 ≠ 0 → (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp γ u) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.energy γ) = 1

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp_shift.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp_shift
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp_shift.raw_type:

  (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
  Eq (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp γ u) (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n) v))
    (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)) (HSub.hSub H (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.squareSum u) (OfNat.ofNat 2))))
      (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b u n) v))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp_shift.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
  (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp γ u) ((CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n) v) =
    (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) * (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b u n) v

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp_vb.raw_type:

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp_vb.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ),
  (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp γ u) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vb u H) = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2)

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp_vp.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp_vp
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp_vp.raw_type:

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp_vp.type: ∀ (γ : ℝ) (u n : CFDLean.Vector 3), (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp γ u) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vp u n) = 0

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.eigenspace_dimensio.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.eigenspace_dimensions
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.eigenspace_dimensio.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (u : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (H : Real) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (c : Real),
  Eq (CFDLean.dot n n) (OfNat.ofNat 1) →
    Eq (HPow.hPow c (OfNat.ofNat 2))
        (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)) (HSub.hSub H (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.squareSum u) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))) →
      Ne c (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
        Ne (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)) (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
          ∀ (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
            Eq
              (Module.finrank Real
                (Subtype fun x =>
                  Membership.mem ((CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n).eigenspace (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c i)) x))
              (Matrix.vecCons (OfNat.ofNat 1)
                (Matrix.vecCons (OfNat.ofNat 3) (Matrix.vecCons (OfNat.ofNat 1) Matrix.vecEmpty)) i)
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.eigenspace_dimensio.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    c ^ 2 = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) →
      c ≠ 0 →
        γ - 1 ≠ 0 →
          ∀ (i : Fin 3),
            Module.finrank ℝ ↥((CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n).eigenspace (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c i)) =
              ![1, 3, 1] i

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.eigenspaces_span.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.eigenspaces_span
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.eigenspaces_span.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (u : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (H : Real) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (c : Real),
  Eq (CFDLean.dot n n) (OfNat.ofNat 1) →
    Eq (HPow.hPow c (OfNat.ofNat 2))
        (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)) (HSub.hSub H (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.squareSum u) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))) →
      Ne c (OfNat.ofNat 0) →

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_sum.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_sum
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_sum.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (u : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (H : Real) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (c : Real),
  Ne c (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
    Eq
      (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus γ u H n c) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.zero γ u H n c))
        (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus γ u H n c))
      (OfNat.ofNat 1)
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector_sum.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  c ≠ 0 →
    CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus γ u H n c + CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.zero γ u H n c + CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus γ u H n c = 1

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.rank_one_range.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.rank_one_range
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.rank_one_range.raw_type:
∀ (f : Module.End Real CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (r : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (a : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E → Real),

    Eq (DFunLike.coe f r) r → Eq (LinearMap.range f) (Submodule.span Real (singleton r))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.rank_one_range.type:
∀ (f : Module.End ℝ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (r : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (a : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E → ℝ),
  (∀ (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E), f v = a v • r) → f r = r → LinearMap.range f = ℝ ∙ r

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector.type: ℝ → CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E → CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E → CFDLean.Vector 3 → Fin 3 → Module.End ℝ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector.eq_1.type:

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift.type: ℝ → CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E → CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E → CFDLean.Vector 3 → Module.End ℝ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift.eq_1.raw_type:
