CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed.type: ℝ → CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E → CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E → CFDLean.Vector 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_basis.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_basis
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_basis.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        Eq (CFDLean.dot n n) (OfNat.ofNat 1) →
          ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (bas : Module.Basis ι Real CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (μ : ι → Real),
            (∀ (i : ι),
                Eq (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n) (DFunLike.coe bas i))
                  (HSMul.hSMul (μ i) (DFunLike.coe bas i))) →
              Eq (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y n)
                (bas.equivFun.symm.comp
                  ((CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.diagonal fun i => abs (μ i)).comp bas.equivFun.toLinearMap))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_basis.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
          ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (bas : Module.Basis ι ℝ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (μ : ι → ℝ),
            (∀ (i : ι), (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n) (bas i) = μ i • bas i) →
              CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y n =
                ↑bas.equivFun.symm ∘ₗ (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.diagonal fun i => |μ i|) ∘ₗ ↑bas.equivFun

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_eigen.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_eigen
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_eigen.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        Eq (CFDLean.dot n n) (OfNat.ofNat 1) →
          ∀ (μ : Real) (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
            Ne v (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
              Eq (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n) v) (HSMul.hSMul μ v) →
                Eq (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y n) v) (HSMul.hSMul (abs μ) v)
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_eigen.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
          ∀ (μ : ℝ) (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
            v ≠ 0 → (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n) v = μ • v → (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y n) v = |μ| • v

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_revers.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_reverse
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_revers.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y (Neg.neg n)) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y n)
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_revers.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y (-n) = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y n

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_complete_basis.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_complete_basis
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_complete_basis.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        Eq (CFDLean.dot n n) (OfNat.ofNat 1) →
          Exists fun bas =>
            ∀ (j : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 5)),
              Exists fun i =>
                Eq (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n) (DFunLike.coe bas j))
                  (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n i) (DFunLike.coe bas j))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_complete_basis.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
          ∃ bas,
            ∀ (j : Fin 5),
              ∃ i, (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n) (bas j) = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n i • bas j

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_convective_tang.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_convective_tangent_span
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_convective_tang.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    Eq (CFDLean.dot n n) (OfNat.ofNat 1) →
      ∀
        (tb :
          Module.Basis (Fin (OfNat.ofNat 2)) Real (Subtype fun x => Membership.mem (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.tangent n) x)),
        Eq
          (Submodule.span Real
            (max (singleton (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y)))
              (Set.range fun i =>
                CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) (DFunLike.coe tb i).val)))
          (Module.End.eigenspace (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n).toLinearMap
            (CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) n))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_convective_tang.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
      ∀ (tb : Module.Basis (Fin 2) ℝ ↥(CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.tangent n)),
        Submodule.span ℝ
            ({CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y)} ∪
              Set.range fun i => CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) ↑(tb i)) =
          Module.End.eigenspace (↑(CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n)) (CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) n)

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_cubic.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_cubic
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_cubic.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        Eq (CFDLean.dot n n) (OfNat.ofNat 1) →
          Eq (HPow.hPow (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift γ x y n) (OfNat.ofNat 3))
            (HSMul.hSMul (HPow.hPow (CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y) (OfNat.ofNat 2))
              (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift γ x y n))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_cubic.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
          CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift γ x y n ^ 3 =
            CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y ^ 2 • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift γ x y n

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_dimensions.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_dimensions
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_dimensions.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        Eq (CFDLean.dot n n) (OfNat.ofNat 1) →
          ∀ (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
            Eq
              (Module.finrank Real
                (Subtype fun x_1 =>
                  Membership.mem
                    (Module.End.eigenspace (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n).toLinearMap
                      (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n i))
                    x_1))
              (Matrix.vecCons (OfNat.ofNat 1)
                (Matrix.vecCons (OfNat.ofNat 3) (Matrix.vecCons (OfNat.ofNat 1) Matrix.vecEmpty)) i)
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_dimensions.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
          ∀ (i : Fin 3),
            Module.finrank ℝ
                ↥(Module.End.eigenspace (↑(CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n)) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n i)) =
              ![1, 3, 1] i

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_eigenvectors.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_eigenvectors
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_eigenvectors.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        Eq (CFDLean.dot n n) (OfNat.ofNat 1) →
          And
            (∀ (s : Real),
              Or (Eq s (Neg.neg (CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y))) (Eq s (CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y)) →
                Eq
                  (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n)
                    (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y)
                      n s))
                  (HSMul.hSMul (HAdd.hAdd (CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) n) s)
                    (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y)
                      n s)))
            (And
              (Eq
                (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n)
                  (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y)))
                (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) n)
                  (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y))))
              (∀ (t : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
                Eq (CFDLean.dot t n) (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
                  Eq
                    (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n)
                      (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) t))
                    (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) n)
                      (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) t))))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_eigenvectors.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
          (∀ (s : ℝ),
              s = -CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y ∨ s = CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y →
                (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n)
                    (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y)
                      n s) =
                  (CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) n + s) •
                    CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y)
                      n s) ∧
            (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y)) =
                CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) n •
                  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) ∧
              ∀ (t : CFDLean.Vector 3),
                CFDLean.dot t n = 0 →
                  (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) t) =
                    CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) n •
                      CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) t

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_matrix_reverse.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_matrix_reverse
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_matrix_reverse.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y (Neg.neg n)) (Neg.neg (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_matrix_reverse.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y (-n) = -CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_algeb.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_algebra
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_algeb.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        Eq (CFDLean.dot n n) (OfNat.ofNat 1) →
          ∀ (i j : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
            Eq (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n i) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n j))
              (ite (Eq i j) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n i) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_algeb.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
          ∀ (i j : Fin 3),
            CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n i * CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n j =
              if i = j then CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n i else 0

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_range.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_ranges
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_range.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        Eq (CFDLean.dot n n) (OfNat.ofNat 1) →
          ∀ (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
            Eq (LinearMap.range (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n i))
              (Module.End.eigenspace (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n).toLinearMap
                (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n i))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_range.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
          ∀ (i : Fin 3),
            LinearMap.range (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n i) =
              Module.End.eigenspace (↑(CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n)) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n i)

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_ranks.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_ranks
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_ranks.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        Eq (CFDLean.dot n n) (OfNat.ofNat 1) →
          ∀ (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
            Eq
              (Module.finrank Real
                (Subtype fun x_1 => Membership.mem (LinearMap.range (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n i)) x_1))
              (Matrix.vecCons (OfNat.ofNat 1)
                (Matrix.vecCons (OfNat.ofNat 3) (Matrix.vecCons (OfNat.ofNat 1) Matrix.vecEmpty)) i)
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_ranks.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
          ∀ (i : Fin 3),
            Module.finrank ℝ ↥(LinearMap.range (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n i)) = ![1, 3, 1] i

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_rever.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_reverse
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_rever.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y (Neg.neg n) i) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n i.rev)
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_rever.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : Fin 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y (-n) i = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n i.rev

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_sum.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_sum
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_sum.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        Eq
          (HAdd.hAdd
            (HAdd.hAdd (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
              (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
            (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
          (OfNat.ofNat 1)
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_sum.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n 0 + CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n 1 +
            CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n 2 =
          1

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_shift_reverse.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_shift_reverse
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_shift_reverse.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift γ x y (Neg.neg n)) (Neg.neg (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift γ x y n))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_shift_reverse.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift γ x y (-n) = -CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift γ x y n

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_spectral_decomp.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_spectral_decomposition
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_spectral_decomp.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        Eq (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n).toLinearMap
          (HAdd.hAdd
            (HAdd.hAdd
              (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
                (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
              (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
                (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
            (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
              (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_spectral_decomp.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        ↑(CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n) =
          CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n 0 • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n 0 +
              CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n 1 • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n 1 +
            CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n 2 • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n 2

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_speed_reverse.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_speed_reverse
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_speed_reverse.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y (Neg.neg n) i) (Neg.neg (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n i.rev))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_speed_reverse.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : Fin 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y (-n) i = -CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n i.rev

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_swap.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_swap
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_swap.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  And (Eq (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift γ y x n) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift γ x y n))
    (And
      (∀ (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
        Eq (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ y x n i) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n i))
      (Eq (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ y x n) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y n)))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_swap.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift γ y x n = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift γ x y n ∧
    (∀ (i : Fin 3), CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ y x n i = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n i) ∧
      CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ y x n = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y n

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (u t : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u t)
    (Matrix.vecCons (OfNat.ofNat 0)
      (Matrix.vecCons (t ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
        (Matrix.vecCons (t ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
          (Matrix.vecCons (t ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (Matrix.vecCons (CFDLean.dot u t) Matrix.vecEmpty)))))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear.eq_1.type: ∀ (u t : CFDLean.Vector 3), CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u t = ![0, t 0, t 1, t 2, CFDLean.dot u t]

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shearMap._proof_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shearMap._proof_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shearMap._proof_1.raw_type:
∀ (u t s : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u (HAdd.hAdd t s))
    (HAdd.hAdd (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u t) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u s))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shearMap._proof_1.type:
∀ (u t s : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u (t + s) = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u t + CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u s

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shearMap._proof_2.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shearMap._proof_2
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shearMap._proof_2.raw_type:
∀ (u : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (r : Real) (t : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u (HSMul.hSMul r t))
    (HSMul.hSMul (DFunLike.coe (RingHom.id Real) r) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u t))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shearMap._proof_2.type:
∀ (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (r : ℝ) (t : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u (r • t) = (RingHom.id ℝ) r • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u t

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear_eigen.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear_eigen
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear_eigen.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (u : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (H : Real) (n t : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.dot t n) (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
    Eq (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u t))
      (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.dot u n) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u t))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear_eigen.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n t : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.dot t n = 0 →
    (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u t) = CFDLean.dot u n • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear u t

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift.type: ℝ → CFDLean.Vector 3 → ℝ → CFDLean.Vector 3 → Module.End ℝ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (u : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (H : Real) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n)
    (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n) (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.dot u n) (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n - CFDLean.dot u n • 1

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_apply.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_apply
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_apply.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (u : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (H : Real) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3))
  (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
  Eq (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n) v)
    (HAdd.hAdd (HSMul.hSMul (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b u n) v) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vb u H))
      (HSMul.hSMul (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp γ u) v) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vp u n)))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_apply.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
  (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n) v =
    (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b u n) v • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vb u H +
      (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp γ u) v • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vp u n

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_projector.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_projector
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_projector.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (u : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (H : Real) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (c : Real),
  Eq (CFDLean.dot n n) (OfNat.ofNat 1) →
    Eq (HPow.hPow c (OfNat.ofNat 2))
        (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)) (HSub.hSub H (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.squareSum u) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))) →
      Ne c (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
        ∀ (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
          Eq
            (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n)
              (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector γ u H n c i) v))
            (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.offset c i)
              (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector γ u H n c i) v))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_projector.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    c ^ 2 = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) →
      c ≠ 0 →
        ∀ (i : Fin 3) (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
          (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n) ((CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector γ u H n c i) v) =
            CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.offset c i • (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.projector γ u H n c i) v

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_reverse.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_reverse
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_reverse.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (u : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (H : Real) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H (Neg.neg n)) (Neg.neg (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_reverse.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H (-n) = -CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_square_apply.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_square_apply
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_square_apply.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (u : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (H : Real) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (c : Real),
  Eq (CFDLean.dot n n) (OfNat.ofNat 1) →
    Eq (HPow.hPow c (OfNat.ofNat 2))
        (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)) (HSub.hSub H (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.squareSum u) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))) →
      ∀ (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
        Eq (DFunLike.coe (HPow.hPow (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) v)
          (HAdd.hAdd (HSMul.hSMul (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp γ u) v) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vb u H))
            (HSMul.hSMul (HMul.hMul (HPow.hPow c (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b u n) v))
              (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vp u n)))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift_square_apply.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    c ^ 2 = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) →
      ∀ (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
        (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n ^ 2) v =
          (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp γ u) v • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vb u H +
            (c ^ 2 * (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b u n) v) • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vp u n

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shifted_acoustic.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shifted_acoustic
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shifted_acoustic.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (u : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (H : Real) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (s : Real),
  Eq (CFDLean.dot n n) (OfNat.ofNat 1) →
    Eq (HPow.hPow s (OfNat.ofNat 2))
        (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)) (HSub.hSub H (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.squareSum u) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))) →
      Eq (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic u H n s))
        (HSMul.hSMul s (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic u H n s))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shifted_acoustic.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (s : ℝ),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    s ^ 2 = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) →
      (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic u H n s) =
        s • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic u H n s

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shifted_cubic.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shifted_cubic
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shifted_cubic.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (u : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (H : Real) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (c : Real),
  Eq (CFDLean.dot n n) (OfNat.ofNat 1) →
    Eq (HPow.hPow c (OfNat.ofNat 2))
        (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)) (HSub.hSub H (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.squareSum u) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))) →
      Eq (HPow.hPow (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n) (OfNat.ofNat 3))
        (HSMul.hSMul (HPow.hPow c (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shifted_cubic.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    c ^ 2 = (γ - 1) * (H - CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) →
      CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n ^ 3 = c ^ 2 • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.sound_parameters.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.sound_parameters
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.sound_parameters.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        And (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y))
          (Eq (HPow.hPow (CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y) (OfNat.ofNat 2))
            (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1))
              (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y)
                (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.squareSum (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y)) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.sound_parameters.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        0 < CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y ∧
          CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y ^ 2 =
            (γ - 1) * (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y - CFDLean.squareSum (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) / 2)

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.spectral_decomposit.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.spectral_decomposition
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.spectral_decomposit.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (u : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (H : Real) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (c : Real),
  Ne c (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
    Eq (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n)
      (HAdd.hAdd
        (HAdd.hAdd
          (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus γ u H n c))
          (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.zero γ u H n c)))
        (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus γ u H n c)))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.spectral_decomposit.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  c ≠ 0 →
    CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.A γ u H n =
      CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c 0 • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.minus γ u H n c +
          CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c 1 • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.zero γ u H n c +
        CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c 2 • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.plus γ u H n c

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (u n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (c : Real) (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c i) (HAdd.hAdd (CFDLean.dot u n) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.offset c i))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed.eq_1.type:
∀ (u n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ) (i : Fin 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c i = CFDLean.dot u n + CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.offset c i

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed_injective.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed_injective
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed_injective.raw_type:
∀ (u n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (c : Real),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) c → Function.Injective (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c)
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed_injective.type: ∀ (u n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ), 0 < c → Function.Injective (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.speed u n c)

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vb.eq_1.type: ∀ (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ), CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vb u H = ![1, u 0, u 1, u 2, H]

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vp.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.vp.eq_1

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.waveMap.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.waveMap
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.waveMap.type: ℝ → CFDLean.Vector 3 → CFDLean.Vector 3 → CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E →ₗ[ℝ] Fin 2 → ℝ

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.waveMap.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.waveMap.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.waveMap.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (u n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.waveMap γ u n)
    (LinearMap.pi
      (Matrix.vecCons (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b u n) (Matrix.vecCons (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp γ u) Matrix.vecEmpty)))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.waveMap.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.waveMap γ u n = LinearMap.pi ![CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.b u n, CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dp γ u]

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.waveMap_surjective.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.waveMap_surjective
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.waveMap_surjective.raw_type:

      Function.Surjective (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.waveMap γ u n))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.waveMap_surjective.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 → γ - 1 ≠ 0 → Function.Surjective ⇑(CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.waveMap γ u n)

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.zero.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.zero
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.zero.type: ℝ → CFDLean.Vector 3 → ℝ → CFDLean.Vector 3 → ℝ → Module.End ℝ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.zero.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.zero.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.zero.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (u : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (H : Real) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (c : Real),
  Eq (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.zero γ u H n c)
    (HSub.hSub (OfNat.ofNat 1)
      (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (HPow.hPow c (OfNat.ofNat 2)))
        (HPow.hPow (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n) (OfNat.ofNat 2))))
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.zero.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (u : CFDLean.Vector 3) (H : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (c : ℝ),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.zero γ u H n c = 1 - (1 / c ^ 2) • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shift γ u H n ^ 2

CFDLean.Roe.area_scale.name: CFDLean.Roe.area_scale
CFDLean.Roe.area_scale.raw_type:
∀ (a : Real) (S : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) a →
    Eq (CFDLean.Coordinates.area fun i => HMul.hMul a (S i)) (HMul.hMul a (CFDLean.Coordinates.area S))
CFDLean.Roe.area_scale.type: ∀ (a : ℝ) (S : CFDLean.Vector 3), 0 ≤ a → (CFDLean.Coordinates.area fun i => a * S i) = a * CFDLean.Coordinates.area S

CFDLean.Roe.assemble.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.assemble.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.assemble.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (r : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 5) → ContinuousLinearMap (RingHom.id Real) CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates Real),
  Eq (CFDLean.Roe.assemble r)
    (HAdd.hAdd
      (HAdd.hAdd
        (HAdd.hAdd
          (HAdd.hAdd ((CFDLean.Roe.embed ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩).comp (r ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
            ((CFDLean.Roe.embed ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩).comp (r ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
          ((CFDLean.Roe.embed ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩).comp (r ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
        ((CFDLean.Roe.embed ⟨3, Fin.instOfNat⟩).comp (r ⟨3, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
      ((CFDLean.Roe.embed ⟨4, Fin.instOfNat⟩).comp (r ⟨4, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
CFDLean.Roe.assemble.eq_1.type:
∀ (r : Fin 5 → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates →L[ℝ] ℝ),
  CFDLean.Roe.assemble r =
    CFDLean.Roe.embed 0 ∘SL r 0 + CFDLean.Roe.embed 1 ∘SL r 1 + CFDLean.Roe.embed 2 ∘SL r 2 +
        CFDLean.Roe.embed 3 ∘SL r 3 +
      CFDLean.Roe.embed 4 ∘SL r 4

CFDLean.Roe.assemble_eq_pi.name: CFDLean.Roe.assemble_eq_pi
CFDLean.Roe.assemble_eq_pi.raw_type:
∀ (r : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 5) → ContinuousLinearMap (RingHom.id Real) CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates Real),
  Eq (CFDLean.Roe.assemble r) (ContinuousLinearMap.pi r)
CFDLean.Roe.assemble_eq_pi.type: ∀ (r : Fin 5 → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates →L[ℝ] ℝ), CFDLean.Roe.assemble r = ContinuousLinearMap.pi r

CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  Eq (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y)
    (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Roe.weight x y) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.enthalpy γ x))
      (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Roe.weight y x) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.enthalpy γ y)))
CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y =
    CFDLean.Roe.weight x y * CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.enthalpy γ x +
      CFDLean.Roe.weight y x * CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.enthalpy γ y

CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y i)
    (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Roe.weight x y) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x i))
      (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Roe.weight y x) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity y i)))
CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity.eq_1.type:
∀ (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (i : Fin 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y i =
    CFDLean.Roe.weight x y * CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x i +
      CFDLean.Roe.weight y x * CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity y i

CFDLean.Roe.averages_continuousAt.name: CFDLean.Roe.averages_continuousAt
CFDLean.Roe.averages_continuousAt.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (p : Prod CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (p.1 ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) →
    LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (p.2 ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) →
      ContinuousAt (fun q => Prod.mk (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity q.1 q.2) (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ q.1 q.2)) p
CFDLean.Roe.averages_continuousAt.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (p : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates × CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  0 < p.1 0 →
    0 < p.2 0 → ContinuousAt (fun q => (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity q.1 q.2, CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ q.1 q.2)) p

CFDLean.Roe.averages_diagonal.name: CFDLean.Roe.averages_diagonal
CFDLean.Roe.averages_diagonal.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (x ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) →
    And (Eq (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x x) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x))
      (Eq (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x x) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.enthalpy γ x))
CFDLean.Roe.averages_diagonal.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  0 < x 0 →
    CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x x = CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x ∧
      CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x x = CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.enthalpy γ x

CFDLean.Roe.averages_swap.name: CFDLean.Roe.averages_swap
CFDLean.Roe.averages_swap.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  And (Eq (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity y x) (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y))
    (And (Eq (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ y x) (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y))
      (Eq (CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare γ y x) (CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare γ x y)))
CFDLean.Roe.averages_swap.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity y x = CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y ∧
    CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ y x = CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y ∧
      CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare γ y x = CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare γ x y

CFDLean.Roe.coordinateFlux_neg.name: CFDLean.Roe.coordinateFlux_neg
CFDLean.Roe.coordinateFlux_neg.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (S : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  Eq (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ (Neg.neg S) x) (Neg.neg (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ S x))
CFDLean.Roe.coordinateFlux_neg.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (S : CFDLean.Vector 3) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ (-S) x = -CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ S x

CFDLean.Roe.coordinateFlux_scale.name: CFDLean.Roe.coordinateFlux_scale
CFDLean.Roe.coordinateFlux_scale.raw_type:
∀ (γ a : Real) (S : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  Eq (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ (fun i => HMul.hMul a (S i)) x)
    (HSMul.hSMul a (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ S x))
CFDLean.Roe.coordinateFlux_scale.type:
∀ (γ a : ℝ) (S : CFDLean.Vector 3) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ (fun i => a * S i) x = a • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ S x

CFDLean.Roe.decode_neg.name: CFDLean.Roe.decode_neg
CFDLean.Roe.decode_neg.raw_type:
∀ (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  Eq (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode (Neg.neg x))
    { density := Neg.neg (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x).density,
      momentum := fun i => Neg.neg ((CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x).momentum i),
      energy := Neg.neg (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x).energy }
CFDLean.Roe.decode_neg.type:
∀ (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.Coordinates.decode (-x) =
    { density := -(CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x).density,
      momentum := fun i => -(CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x).momentum i,
      energy := -(CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x).energy }

CFDLean.Roe.decode_scale.name: CFDLean.Roe.decode_scale
CFDLean.Roe.decode_scale.raw_type:
∀ (a : Real) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  Eq (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode (HSMul.hSMul a x))
    { density := HMul.hMul a (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x).density,
      momentum := fun i => HMul.hMul a ((CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x).momentum i),
      energy := HMul.hMul a (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x).energy }
CFDLean.Roe.decode_scale.type:
∀ (a : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.Coordinates.decode (a • x) =
    { density := a * (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x).density,
      momentum := fun i => a * (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x).momentum i,
      energy := a * (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x).energy }

CFDLean.Roe.decode_zero.name: CFDLean.Roe.decode_zero
CFDLean.Roe.decode_zero.raw_type:
Eq (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode (OfNat.ofNat 0))
  { density := OfNat.ofNat 0, momentum := fun x => OfNat.ofNat 0, energy := OfNat.ofNat 0 }
CFDLean.Roe.decode_zero.type: CFDLean.Coordinates.decode 0 = { density := 0, momentum := fun x => 0, energy := 0 }

CFDLean.Roe.dissipation_of_nonnegative.name: CFDLean.Roe.dissipation_of_nonnegative
CFDLean.Roe.dissipation_of_nonnegative.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) →
          LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩) →
            LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩) →
              Eq (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y n) (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n).toLinearMap
CFDLean.Roe.dissipation_of_nonnegative.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        0 ≤ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n 0 →
          0 ≤ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n 1 →
            0 ≤ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n 2 →
              CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y n = ↑(CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n)

CFDLean.Roe.dissipation_of_nonpositive.name: CFDLean.Roe.dissipation_of_nonpositive
CFDLean.Roe.dissipation_of_nonpositive.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        LE.le (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
          LE.le (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
            LE.le (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
              Eq (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y n) (Neg.neg (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n).toLinearMap)
CFDLean.Roe.dissipation_of_nonpositive.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n 0 ≤ 0 →
          CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n 1 ≤ 0 →
            CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n 2 ≤ 0 →
              CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y n = -↑(CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n)

CFDLean.Roe.dissipation_upwind_left.name: CFDLean.Roe.dissipation_upwind_left
CFDLean.Roe.dissipation_upwind_left.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        LE.le (CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y) (CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) n) →
          Eq (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y n) (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n).toLinearMap
CFDLean.Roe.dissipation_upwind_left.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y ≤ CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) n →
          CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y n = ↑(CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n)

CFDLean.Roe.dissipation_upwind_right.name: CFDLean.Roe.dissipation_upwind_right
CFDLean.Roe.dissipation_upwind_right.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        LE.le (CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) n) (Neg.neg (CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y)) →
          Eq (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y n) (Neg.neg (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n).toLinearMap)
CFDLean.Roe.dissipation_upwind_right.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),

CFDLean.Roe.operator.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.operator.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.operator.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (u : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (H : Real) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.Roe.operator γ u H n)
    (CFDLean.Roe.assemble
      (Matrix.vecCons (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n)
        (Matrix.vecCons
          (HAdd.hAdd
            (HAdd.hAdd (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.dot u n) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
              (HSMul.hSMul (u ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
                (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n)
                  (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.dot u n) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))))
            (HSMul.hSMul (n ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
              (HSMul.hSMul (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1))
                (HAdd.hAdd
                  (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨4, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
                    (HAdd.hAdd
                      (HAdd.hAdd
                        (HSMul.hSMul (u ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
                        (HSMul.hSMul (u ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
                      (HSMul.hSMul (u ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨3, Fin.instOfNat⟩))))
                  (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.squareSum u) (OfNat.ofNat 2))
                    (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩))))))
          (Matrix.vecCons
            (HAdd.hAdd
              (HAdd.hAdd (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.dot u n) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
                (HSMul.hSMul (u ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
                  (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n)
                    (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.dot u n) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))))
              (HSMul.hSMul (n ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
                (HSMul.hSMul (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1))
                  (HAdd.hAdd
                    (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨4, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
                      (HAdd.hAdd
                        (HAdd.hAdd
                          (HSMul.hSMul (u ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩))

      ![CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n,
        CFDLean.dot u n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 +
            u 0 •
              (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n - CFDLean.dot u n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0) +
          n 0 •
            (γ - 1) •
              (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 -
                  (u 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 + u 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
                    u 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3) +
                (CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0),
        CFDLean.dot u n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
            u 1 •
              (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n - CFDLean.dot u n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0) +
          n 1 •
            (γ - 1) •
              (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 -
                  (u 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 + u 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
                    u 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3) +
                (CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0),
        CFDLean.dot u n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3 +
            u 2 •
              (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n - CFDLean.dot u n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0) +
          n 2 •
            (γ - 1) •
              (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 -
                  (u 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 + u 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
                    u 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3) +
                (CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0),
        CFDLean.dot u n •
            (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 +
              (γ - 1) •
                (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 -
                    (u 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 + u 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
                      u 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3) +
                  (CFDLean.squareSum u / 2) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0)) +
          H • (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n - CFDLean.dot u n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0)]

CFDLean.Roe.pressureGradient.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.pressureGradient.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.pressureGradient.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (z : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  Eq (CFDLean.Roe.pressureGradient γ z)
    (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)) γ)
      (HSub.hSub
        (HAdd.hAdd (HSMul.hSMul (z ⟨4, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
          (HSMul.hSMul (z ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨4, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
        (HAdd.hAdd
          (HAdd.hAdd (HSMul.hSMul (z ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
            (HSMul.hSMul (z ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
          (HSMul.hSMul (z ⟨3, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection ⟨3, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))))
CFDLean.Roe.pressureGradient.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (z : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.Roe.pressureGradient γ z =
    ((γ - 1) / γ) •
      (z 4 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0 + z 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 -
        (z 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 + z 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
          z 3 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3))

CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (S : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates γ x y S)
    (ite (Eq S (OfNat.ofNat 0)) (OfNat.ofNat 0)
      (HSub.hSub
        (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2))
          (HAdd.hAdd (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ S x) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ S y)))
        (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.Coordinates.area S) (OfNat.ofNat 2))
          (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y (CFDLean.Coordinates.unitNormal S)) (HSub.hSub y x)))))
CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (S : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates γ x y S =
    if S = 0 then 0
    else
      (1 / 2) • (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ S x + CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ S y) -
        (CFDLean.Coordinates.area S / 2) •
          (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y (CFDLean.Coordinates.unitNormal S)) (y - x)

CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates_central_o.name: CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates_central_of_zero
CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates_central_o.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (S : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        Ne S (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
          Eq (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y (CFDLean.Coordinates.unitNormal S)) (HSub.hSub y x))
              (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
            Eq (CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates γ x y S)
              (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2))
                (HAdd.hAdd (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ S x)
                  (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ S y)))
CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates_central_o.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (S : CFDLean.Vector 3),

    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        S ≠ 0 →
          (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y (CFDLean.Coordinates.unitNormal S)) (y - x) = 0 →
            CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates γ x y S =
              (1 / 2) • (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ S x + CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ S y)

  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        Eq (HPow.hPow (CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare γ x y)
CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed_sq.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),

CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare.eq_1
CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  Eq (CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare γ x y)
    (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1))
      (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y)
        (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.squareSum (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y)) (OfNat.ofNat 2))))
CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare γ x y =
    (γ - 1) * (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y - CFDLean.squareSum (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) / 2)

CFDLean.Roe.state_midpoint_jump.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (z t : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),

    (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.B γ fun i => HDiv.hDiv (HAdd.hAdd (z i) (t i)) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (HSub.hSub t z))
CFDLean.Roe.state_midpoint_jump.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (z t : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),

CFDLean.Roe.variance_identity.name: CFDLean.Roe.variance_identity
CFDLean.Roe.variance_identity.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (x ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) →
    LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (y ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) →
      Eq (CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare γ x y)
        (HAdd.hAdd
          (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Roe.weight x y) (CFDLean.Roe.endpointSoundSquare γ x))
            (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Roe.weight y x) (CFDLean.Roe.endpointSoundSquare γ y)))
          (HMul.hMul
            (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (CFDLean.Roe.weight x y))
              (CFDLean.Roe.weight y x))
            (CFDLean.squareSum fun i =>
              HSub.hSub (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity y i) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x i))))
CFDLean.Roe.variance_identity.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  0 < x 0 →
    0 < y 0 →
      CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare γ x y =
        CFDLean.Roe.weight x y * CFDLean.Roe.endpointSoundSquare γ x +
            CFDLean.Roe.weight y x * CFDLean.Roe.endpointSoundSquare γ y +
          (γ - 1) / 2 * CFDLean.Roe.weight x y * CFDLean.Roe.weight y x *
            CFDLean.squareSum fun i => CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity y i - CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x i

CFDLean.Roe.weighted_square.raw_type:
∀ (a b : Real) (v w : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (HAdd.hAdd a b) (OfNat.ofNat 1) →
    Eq (CFDLean.squareSum fun i => HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul a (v i)) (HMul.hMul b (w i)))
      (HSub.hSub (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul a (CFDLean.squareSum v)) (HMul.hMul b (CFDLean.squareSum w)))
        (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul a b) (CFDLean.squareSum fun i => HSub.hSub (w i) (v i))))
CFDLean.Roe.weighted_square.type:
∀ (a b : ℝ) (v w : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  a + b = 1 →
    (CFDLean.squareSum fun i => a * v i + b * w i) =
      a * CFDLean.squareSum v + b * CFDLean.squareSum w - a * b * CFDLean.squareSum fun i => w i - v i

CFDLean.Roe.witness_averages.name: CFDLean.Roe.witness_averages
CFDLean.Roe.witness_averages.raw_type:
And
  (Eq
    (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode CFDLean.Roe.witnessLeft)
      (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode CFDLean.Roe.witnessRight))
    (OfNat.ofNat 0))
  (And
    (Eq
      (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy (OfNat.ofNat 2) (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode CFDLean.Roe.witnessLeft)
        (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode CFDLean.Roe.witnessRight))
      (OfNat.ofNat 3))
    (Eq
      (CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare (OfNat.ofNat 2) (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode CFDLean.Roe.witnessLeft)
        (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode CFDLean.Roe.witnessRight))
      (OfNat.ofNat 3)))
CFDLean.Roe.witness_averages.type:
CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode CFDLean.Roe.witnessLeft)
      (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode CFDLean.Roe.witnessRight) =
    0 ∧
  CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy 2 (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode CFDLean.Roe.witnessLeft)
        (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode CFDLean.Roe.witnessRight) =
      3 ∧
    CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare 2 (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode CFDLean.Roe.witnessLeft)
        (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode CFDLean.Roe.witnessRight) =
      3

CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.cell_entropy.name: CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.cell_entropy_equality
CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.cell_entropy.raw_type:
∀ {I : Type u_2} (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx : Real) (v ψ : Real → Real) (nf : CFDLean.Scalar.NumericalFlux),
  CFDLean.Scalar.EntropyConservative v ψ nf →
    ∀ (u : I → Real) (i : I),
      Eq (HMul.hMul (v (u i)) (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.rhs g dx nf u i))
        (HDiv.hDiv
          (Neg.neg
            (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.entropyFlux g v ψ nf u i)
              (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.entropyFlux g v ψ nf u (g.prev i))))
          dx)
CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.cell_entropy.type:
∀ {I : Type u_2} (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx : ℝ) (v ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (nf : CFDLean.Scalar.NumericalFlux),
  CFDLean.Scalar.EntropyConservative v ψ nf →
    ∀ (u : I → ℝ) (i : I),
      v (u i) * CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.rhs g dx nf u i =
        -(CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.entropyFlux g v ψ nf u i -
              CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.entropyFlux g v ψ nf u (g.prev i)) /
          dx

CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.cell_entropy.name: CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.cell_entropy_identity
CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.cell_entropy.raw_type:
∀ {I : Type u_2} (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx : Real) (v ψ : Real → Real) (nf : CFDLean.Scalar.NumericalFlux)
  (u : I → Real) (i : I),
  Eq
    (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul (v (u i)) (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.rhs g dx nf u i))
      (HDiv.hDiv
        (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.entropyFlux g v ψ nf u i)
          (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.entropyFlux g v ψ nf u (g.prev i)))
        dx))
    (HDiv.hDiv
      (HAdd.hAdd
        (HSub.hSub
          (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub (v (u (DFunLike.coe g.next i))) (v (u i))) (nf.eval (u i) (u (DFunLike.coe g.next i))))
          (HSub.hSub (ψ (u (DFunLike.coe g.next i))) (ψ (u i))))
        (HSub.hSub (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub (v (u i)) (v (u (g.prev i)))) (nf.eval (u (g.prev i)) (u i)))
          (HSub.hSub (ψ (u i)) (ψ (u (g.prev i))))))
      (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) dx))
CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.cell_entropy.type:
∀ {I : Type u_2} (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx : ℝ) (v ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (nf : CFDLean.Scalar.NumericalFlux) (u : I → ℝ)
  (i : I),
  v (u i) * CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.rhs g dx nf u i +
      (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.entropyFlux g v ψ nf u i -
          CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.entropyFlux g v ψ nf u (g.prev i)) /
        dx =
    ((v (u (g.next i)) - v (u i)) * nf.eval (u i) (u (g.next i)) - (ψ (u (g.next i)) - ψ (u i)) +
        ((v (u i) - v (u (g.prev i))) * nf.eval (u (g.prev i)) (u i) - (ψ (u i) - ψ (u (g.prev i))))) /
      (2 * dx)

CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.cell_entropy.name: CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.cell_entropy_inequality
CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.cell_entropy.raw_type:
∀ {I : Type u_2} (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx : Real),

    ∀ (v ψ : Real → Real) (nf : CFDLean.Scalar.NumericalFlux),

                (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.entropyFlux g v ψ nf u i)
                  (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.entropyFlux g v ψ nf u (g.prev i))))
              dx)
CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.cell_entropy.type:
∀ {I : Type u_2} (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx : ℝ),

CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.coeff_sum_le.raw_type:
∀ (dx dt KL KR c d : Real),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) dx →
    LE.le (HMul.hMul dt (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 3) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (HAdd.hAdd KL KR))) dx →
      LE.le c (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv dt dx) (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 3) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) KR)) →
        LE.le d (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv dt dx) (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 3) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) KL)) →
          LE.le (HAdd.hAdd c d) (OfNat.ofNat 1)
CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.coeff_sum_le.type:
∀ (dx dt KL KR c d : ℝ),
  0 < dx → dt * (3 / 2 * (KL + KR)) ≤ dx → c ≤ dt / dx * (3 / 2 * KR) → d ≤ dt / dx * (3 / 2 * KL) → c + d ≤ 1

CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.coeff_sum_le.name: CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.coeff_sum_le_one_bounded

  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) dx →

      LE.le c (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv dt dx) (HMul.hMul (HAdd.hAdd (OfNat.ofNat 1) (HDiv.hDiv θ (OfNat.ofNat 2))) KR)) →
        LE.le d (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv dt dx) (HMul.hMul (HAdd.hAdd (OfNat.ofNat 1) (HDiv.hDiv θ (OfNat.ofNat 2))) KL)) →
          LE.le (HAdd.hAdd c d) (OfNat.ofNat 1)
CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.coeff_sum_le.type:
∀ (θ dx dt KL KR c d : ℝ),
  0 < dx →
    dt * ((1 + θ / 2) * (KL + KR)) ≤ dx →
      c ≤ dt / dx * ((1 + θ / 2) * KR) → d ≤ dt / dx * ((1 + θ / 2) * KL) → c + d ≤ 1

CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.entropyFlux.type: {I : Type u_2} → CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I → (ℝ → ℝ) → (ℝ → ℝ) → CFDLean.Scalar.NumericalFlux → (I → ℝ) → I → ℝ

CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.entropyFlux..name: CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.entropyFlux.eq_1
CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.entropyFlux..raw_type:
∀ {I : Type u_2} (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (v ψ : Real → Real) (nf : CFDLean.Scalar.NumericalFlux) (u : I → Real)
  (i : I),
  Eq (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.entropyFlux g v ψ nf u i)
    (HSub.hSub
      (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (HAdd.hAdd (v (u i)) (v (u (DFunLike.coe g.next i)))) (OfNat.ofNat 2))
        (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.interfaceFlux g nf u i))
      (HDiv.hDiv (HAdd.hAdd (ψ (u i)) (ψ (u (DFunLike.coe g.next i)))) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))
CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.entropyFlux..type:
∀ {I : Type u_2} (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (v ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (nf : CFDLean.Scalar.NumericalFlux) (u : I → ℝ) (i : I),
  CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.entropyFlux g v ψ nf u i =
    (v (u i) + v (u (g.next i))) / 2 * CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.interfaceFlux g nf u i -
      (ψ (u i) + ψ (u (g.next i))) / 2

CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.flux_left_in.name: CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.flux_left_increment
CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.flux_left_in.raw_type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (nf : CFDLean.Scalar.NumericalFlux) (φ : Real → Real → Real),
  CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.MinmodBounded φ →
    CFDLean.Scalar.MonotoneFlux nf →
      ∀ (m M KL KR : Real),
        CFDLean.Scalar.LipschitzOnBounds nf m M KL KR →
          LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) KL →
            ∀ (u : I → Real),
              Membership.mem (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.boundedStates m M) u →
                ∀ (i : I),
                  And
                    (LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0)
                      (HMul.hMul
                        (HSub.hSub
                          (nf.eval (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.leftState g φ u i)
                            (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.rightState g φ u (g.prev i)))
                          (nf.eval (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.leftState g φ u (g.prev i))
                            (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.rightState g φ u (g.prev i))))
                        (HSub.hSub (u i) (u (g.prev i)))))
                    (LE.le
                      (abs
                        (HSub.hSub
                          (nf.eval (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.leftState g φ u i)
                            (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.rightState g φ u (g.prev i)))
                          (nf.eval (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.leftState g φ u (g.prev i))
                            (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.rightState g φ u (g.prev i)))))
                      (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 3) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) KL)
                        (abs (HSub.hSub (u i) (u (g.prev i))))))
CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.flux_left_in.type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (nf : CFDLean.Scalar.NumericalFlux) (φ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
  CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.MinmodBounded φ →
    CFDLean.Scalar.MonotoneFlux nf →
      ∀ (m M KL KR : ℝ),
        CFDLean.Scalar.LipschitzOnBounds nf m M KL KR →
          0 ≤ KL →
            ∀ u ∈ CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.boundedStates m M,
              ∀ (i : I),
                0 ≤
                    (nf.eval (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.leftState g φ u i)
                          (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.rightState g φ u (g.prev i)) -
                        nf.eval (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.leftState g φ u (g.prev i))
                          (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.rightState g φ u (g.prev i))) *
                      (u i - u (g.prev i)) ∧
                  |nf.eval (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.leftState g φ u i)
                          (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.rightState g φ u (g.prev i)) -
                        nf.eval (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.leftState g φ u (g.prev i))

CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.half_slope_m.name: CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.half_slope_mem
CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.half_slope_m.raw_type:
∀ (m M v vl vr s : Real),
  LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) (HMul.hMul s (HSub.hSub v vl)) →
    LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) (HMul.hMul s (HSub.hSub vr v)) →
      LE.le (abs s) (abs (HSub.hSub v vl)) →
        LE.le (abs s) (abs (HSub.hSub vr v)) →
          And (LE.le m v) (LE.le v M) →
            And (LE.le m vl) (LE.le vl M) →
              And (LE.le m vr) (LE.le vr M) →
                And
                  (And (LE.le m (HAdd.hAdd v (HDiv.hDiv s (OfNat.ofNat 2))))
                    (LE.le (HAdd.hAdd v (HDiv.hDiv s (OfNat.ofNat 2))) M))
                  (And (LE.le m (HSub.hSub v (HDiv.hDiv s (OfNat.ofNat 2))))
                    (LE.le (HSub.hSub v (HDiv.hDiv s (OfNat.ofNat 2))) M))
CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.half_slope_m.type:
∀ (m M v vl vr s : ℝ),
  0 ≤ s * (v - vl) →
    0 ≤ s * (vr - v) →
      |s| ≤ |v - vl| →
        |s| ≤ |vr - v| →
          m ≤ v ∧ v ≤ M →
            m ≤ vl ∧ vl ≤ M → m ≤ vr ∧ vr ≤ M → (m ≤ v + s / 2 ∧ v + s / 2 ≤ M) ∧ m ≤ v - s / 2 ∧ v - s / 2 ≤ M

CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.incrementalU.name: CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.incrementalUpdate.eq_1
CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.incrementalU.raw_type:

  Eq (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.incrementalUpdate g C D u i)
    (HSub.hSub (HAdd.hAdd (u i) (HMul.hMul (C i) (HSub.hSub (u (DFunLike.coe g.next i)) (u i))))

CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.incrementalU.type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (C D u : I → ℝ) (i : I),
  CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.incrementalUpdate g C D u i =
    u i + C i * (u (g.next i) - u i) - D (g.prev i) * (u i - u (g.prev i))

CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.incrementalU.raw_type:

      LE.le (HAdd.hAdd (C i) (D (g.prev i))) (OfNat.ofNat 1) →
        (∀ (j : I), LE.le m (u j)) →
          (∀ (j : I), LE.le (u j) M) →
            And (LE.le m (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.incrementalUpdate g C D u i))
              (LE.le (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.incrementalUpdate g C D u i) M)

  0 ≤ C i →
    0 ≤ D (g.prev i) →
      C i + D (g.prev i) ≤ 1 →
        (∀ (j : I), m ≤ u j) →
          (∀ (j : I), u j ≤ M) →
            m ≤ CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.incrementalUpdate g C D u i ∧

CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.incrementalU.raw_type:

          (τ : Fin n → Real),
          (∀ (i : Fin n), M.Used i → LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) (τ i)) →
            ∀ (U : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
              CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ U →
                (∀ (b : M.Boundary),
                    Ne (CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b) CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe →

                      Eq (CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b) CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe →

CFDLean.Time.mesh_component_balance.raw_type:

    (HSub.hSub (Finset.univ.sum fun i => HMul.hMul (M.dualVolume i) (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (U i) j))

    (HSub.hSub (Finset.univ.sum fun i => HMul.hMul (M.dualVolume i) (U i).energy)
      (HMul.hMul dt
        (Finset.univ.sum fun b =>
          ite (Eq (CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b) CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe)
            (CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ (U (M.interfaces.owner b))
              (CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V b) (M.boundaryArea b) ⟨4, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
            (OfNat.ofNat 0))))
CFDLean.Time.mesh_energy_balance.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)

CFDLean.Time.mesh_local_balance.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_local_balance
CFDLean.Time.mesh_local_balance.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : Real) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)

  Eq (CFDLean.Time.amount M.dualVolume (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V τ U))
    (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Time.amount M.dualVolume U)
      (HAdd.hAdd
        (Finset.univ.sum fun e =>
          HSMul.hSMul (HSub.hSub (τ (M.interfaces.tail e)) (τ (M.interfaces.head e)))
            (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer M.interfaces γ U M.edgeArea e))
        (Finset.univ.sum fun b => HSMul.hSMul (τ (M.interfaces.owner b)) (CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V U b))))
CFDLean.Time.mesh_local_balance.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)

  CFDLean.Time.amount M.dualVolume (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V τ U) =
    CFDLean.Time.amount M.dualVolume U -
      (∑ e,
          (τ (M.interfaces.tail e) - τ (M.interfaces.head e)) •
            CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer M.interfaces γ U M.edgeArea e +
        ∑ b, τ (M.interfaces.owner b) • CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V U b)

CFDLean.Time.mesh_momentum_balance.raw_type:

  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3))

  Eq

    (HSub.hSub (Finset.univ.sum fun i => HMul.hMul (M.dualVolume i) ((U i).momentum j))
      (HMul.hMul dt
        (Finset.univ.sum fun b =>
          ite (Eq (CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b) CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe)
            ((CFDLean.Coordinates.decode
                  (CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ (U (M.interfaces.owner b))
                    (CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V b) (M.boundaryArea b))).momentum
              j)
            (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ (U (M.interfaces.owner b))) (M.boundaryArea b j)))))

      dt *
        ∑ b,
          if CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe then

  [inst_2 : Fintype B'] (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (nodeEq : Equiv (Fin n) N') (e : Equiv M.Edge E')
  (b : Equiv M.Boundary B') (γ : Real) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (τ : Fin n → Real)
  (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (i : Fin n),
  Eq
    (CFDLean.Time.heldStep (fun x => M.Used (DFunLike.coe nodeEq.symm x))
      (fun x => M.dualVolume (DFunLike.coe nodeEq.symm x)) (fun x => τ (DFunLike.coe nodeEq.symm x))
      (CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual (M.interfaces.reindex nodeEq e b) γ
        (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k (DFunLike.coe b.symm x))
        (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V (DFunLike.coe b.symm x)) (fun x => U (DFunLike.coe nodeEq.symm x))
        (fun x => M.edgeArea (DFunLike.coe e.symm x)) fun x => M.boundaryArea (DFunLike.coe b.symm x))
      (fun x => U (DFunLike.coe nodeEq.symm x)) (DFunLike.coe nodeEq i))
    (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V τ U i)
CFDLean.Time.mesh_step_reindex.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} {N' : Type u_4} {E' : Type u_5} {B' : Type u_6} [inst : DecidableEq N'] [inst_1 : Fintype E']
  [inst_2 : Fintype B'] (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (nodeEq : Fin n ≃ N') (e : M.Edge ≃ E')
  (b : M.Boundary ≃ B') (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (τ : Fin n → ℝ) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (i : Fin n),
  CFDLean.Time.heldStep (fun x => M.Used (nodeEq.symm x)) (fun x => M.dualVolume (nodeEq.symm x))
      (fun x => τ (nodeEq.symm x))
      (CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual (M.interfaces.reindex nodeEq e b) γ
        (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k (b.symm x)) (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V (b.symm x))
        (fun x => U (nodeEq.symm x)) (fun x => M.edgeArea (e.symm x)) fun x => M.boundaryArea (b.symm x))
      (fun x => U (nodeEq.symm x)) (nodeEq i) =

CFDLean.Time.mesh_step_used.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_step_used
CFDLean.Time.mesh_step_used.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : Real) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (τ : Fin n → Real)
  (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (i : Fin n),
  M.Used i →
    Eq (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V τ U i)
      (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode
        (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (U i))
          (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (τ i) (M.dualVolume i)) (CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V U i))))
CFDLean.Time.mesh_step_used.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (τ : Fin n → ℝ) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (i : Fin n),
  M.Used i →
    CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V τ U i =
      CFDLean.Coordinates.decode
        (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (U i) - (τ i / M.dualVolume i) • CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V U i)

CFDLean.Time.weighted_residual.name: CFDLean.Time.weighted_residual
CFDLean.Time.weighted_residual.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype N] [inst_2 : Fintype E]
  [inst_3 : Fintype B] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (τ : N → Real)
  (f : E → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (g : B → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => HSMul.hSMul (τ i) (CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i))
    (HAdd.hAdd (Finset.univ.sum fun e => HSMul.hSMul (HSub.hSub (τ (m.tail e)) (τ (m.head e))) (f e))
      (Finset.univ.sum fun b => HSMul.hSMul (τ (m.owner b)) (g b)))
CFDLean.Time.weighted_residual.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype N] [inst_2 : Fintype E]
  [inst_3 : Fintype B] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (τ : N → ℝ)
  (f : E → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (g : B → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  ∑ i, τ i • CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i = ∑ e, (τ (m.tail e) - τ (m.head e)) • f e + ∑ b, τ (m.owner b) • g b

CFDLean.Time.weighted_residual._simp_1_1.raw_type:

  (y : M), Eq (HSub.hSub (HSMul.hSMul r y) (HSMul.hSMul s y)) (HSMul.hSMul (HSub.hSub r s) y)
CFDLean.Time.weighted_residual._simp_1_1.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Ring R] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_2 : _root_.Module R M] (r s : R)
  (y : M), r • y - s • y = (r - s) • y

CFDLean.Verification.BurgersB0Challenge..raw_type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} (next : Equiv I I) (dx : Real) (numericalFlux : Real → Real → Real) (u : I → Real) (i : I),
  Eq (CFDLean.Verification.BurgersB0Challenge.rhs next dx numericalFlux u i)
    (HDiv.hDiv
      (Neg.neg
        (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Verification.BurgersB0Challenge.interfaceFlux next numericalFlux u i)
          (CFDLean.Verification.BurgersB0Challenge.interfaceFlux next numericalFlux u
            (CFDLean.Verification.BurgersB0Challenge.prev next i))))
      dx)
CFDLean.Verification.BurgersB0Challenge..type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} (next : I ≃ I) (dx : ℝ) (numericalFlux : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (u : I → ℝ) (i : I),
  CFDLean.Verification.BurgersB0Challenge.rhs next dx numericalFlux u i =
    -(CFDLean.Verification.BurgersB0Challenge.interfaceFlux next numericalFlux u i -
          CFDLean.Verification.BurgersB0Challenge.interfaceFlux next numericalFlux u
            (CFDLean.Verification.BurgersB0Challenge.prev next i)) /
      dx

        (HAdd.hAdd (CFDLean.Verification.BurgersB1Challenge.burgersFlux uL)
          (CFDLean.Verification.BurgersB1Challenge.burgersFlux uR))
        (OfNat.ofNat 2))
      (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.Verification.BurgersB1Challenge.rusanovWaveSpeed uL uR) (OfNat.ofNat 2))
        (HSub.hSub uR uL)))
CFDLean.Verification.BurgersB1Challenge..type:

  CFDLean.Verification.BurgersB1Challenge.rusanov uL uR =
    (CFDLean.Verification.BurgersB1Challenge.burgersFlux uL + CFDLean.Verification.BurgersB1Challenge.burgersFlux uR) /
        2 -
      CFDLean.Verification.BurgersB1Challenge.rusanovWaveSpeed uL uR / 2 * (uR - uL)

CFDLean.Verification.BurgersB1Challenge..raw_type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} (next : Equiv I I) (dx dt : Real) (u : I → Real) (i : I),
  Eq (CFDLean.Verification.BurgersB1Challenge.rusanovStep next dx dt u i)
    (HAdd.hAdd (u i)
      (HMul.hMul dt
        (HDiv.hDiv
          (Neg.neg
            (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Verification.BurgersB1Challenge.rusanov (u i) (u (DFunLike.coe next i)))
              (CFDLean.Verification.BurgersB1Challenge.rusanov (u (DFunLike.coe next.symm i)) (u i))))
          dx)))
CFDLean.Verification.BurgersB1Challenge..type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} (next : I ≃ I) (dx dt : ℝ) (u : I → ℝ) (i : I),
  CFDLean.Verification.BurgersB1Challenge.rusanovStep next dx dt u i =
    u i +
      dt *
        (-(CFDLean.Verification.BurgersB1Challenge.rusanov (u i) (u (next i)) -
              CFDLean.Verification.BurgersB1Challenge.rusanov (u (next.symm i)) (u i)) /
          dx)

      momentum := fun i =>
        HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul (U.momentum i) (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.dot U.momentum S) U.density))
          (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ U) (S i)),

      momentum := fun i =>
        U.momentum i * (CFDLean.dot U.momentum S / U.density) + CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ U * S i,
